title.en: Into the Wind, Into the Frigid North

description.zh: 终于，你和派蒙准备启程前往旅途的下一站——至冬…
description.en: Finally, you and Paimon prepare to set off for your next stop, Snezhnaya...

text.zh: 转眼已经到至冬了啊，我有种刚刚才离开挪德卡莱的感觉。
text.en: And just like that, we're in Snezhnaya! Feels like we only just left Nod-Krai.

text.zh: 还记得吗？我们离开之前在那夏镇，朋友们为我们送行…
text.en: Remember back in Nasha Town, how all our friends came to see us off before we left?

text.zh: 终于要出发去见至冬女皇了，她究竟想干什么，又为什么需要神之心，马上就会有答案。
text.en: The day's finally come. We're off to meet the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya! What is she planning, and why does she need the Gnoses? Soon, we'll have our answers.

text.zh: #这应该也是你的血亲所说的「旅途的终点」，{M#她}{F#他}想要让你见证什么呢…
text.en: #Guess this'll be the "end of your journey" that {M#your sister}{F#your brother} mentioned... What is {M#she}{F#he} expecting you to find there?

text.zh: 哎，只要还没到至冬，就觉得路还很长很长，吃喝玩乐的时候也没什么负担。
text.en: *sigh* Snezhnaya still feels like a long way away. Hopefully, there'll be plenty of time to relax, eat some good food, and have fun before we arrive.

text.zh: 但一想到终点就在眼前，这些问题就都会涌进脑袋里，一下子就紧张起来了。
text.en: ...But whenever Paimon gets thinking about how our destination is right around the corner, all these questions come flooding into Paimon's head. It makes her so nervous...

text.zh: 也是时候了。
text.en: It's sure been a long time coming.

text.zh: 我也会有点忐忑。
text.en: I'm a little nervous too.

text.zh: 嗯，不过现在我也想通了，用这样的心态踏上最后一段旅程是不对的！
text.en: Yeah... Anyway, enough about all that. We can't start the final leg of our journey with that kind of mindset!

text.zh: 我们对抗过魔龙和海怪，击败过神明的造物，直面过预言与深渊的危机，现在更是连月亮都去过了。
text.en: Just think — we've fought dragons and sea monsters, defeated creations of the gods, faced prophecies of doom and the threat of the Abyss... Heck, we've even been to the moon.

text.zh: 还有什么是我们没见过，没经历过的呢？
text.en: With all that experience under our belts, how could we be any more prepared?

text.zh: 有道理，谢谢你帮我打气。
text.en: Great point. Thanks for the pep talk.

text.zh: 不用客气，那就跟紧你的超级好向导派蒙，一鼓作气冲向终点吧，我们出发！
text.en: Sure thing! Now, stick close to Paimon, the best guide you could ever ask for, and let's charge straight for the finish line! Off we go!

text.zh: 没有想我的事？
text.en: What about me? Do I get a callout?

text.zh: 呜哇，哥伦比娅？你还是这么神出鬼没…
text.en: Whoa! Columbina? You kinda snuck up on us there...

text.zh: 你怎么知道我在这里…
text.en: How did you know I was here?

text.zh: 我应该没告诉任何人…
text.en: I don't think I told anyone...

text.zh: 别、别看我，这次我可没有出卖你！
text.en: D—Don't look at Paimon! Paimon didn't sell you out this time!

text.zh: 原来是你啊，好吧，那确实瞒不住。
text.en: Oh, so it was you! Alright, guess there's no hiding it now.

text.zh: 朋友们都聚在「旗舰」，想要为你送行。
text.en: All your friends have gathered at The Flagship to see you off.

text.zh: 我也邀请了桑多涅，可是她好像有事要忙，先回至冬去了。
text.en: I invited Sandrone too, but she said she had to go back to Snezhnaya. She must be busy.

text.zh: 临走之前，还留下了几句难听的话，关于你们的，想听吗？
text.en: She had some nasty things to say about you before leaving. Would you like to hear them?

text.zh: 呃，她还是老样子。说说看吧…
text.en: Ugh, she hasn't changed a bit. Alright, let's hear it...

text.zh: #「{M#他}{F#她}们去至冬，十有八九是去给女皇陛下找麻烦，我才不要和这样的人显得很熟络呢。」
text.en: "If they're heading to Snezhnaya, I'll bet it's to cause trouble for Her Majesty the Tsaritsa. Attending a farewell party for people like that would not be a good look for me right now."

text.zh: #「也麻烦你转告{M#他}{F#她}们，不要理所当然地认为在至冬也能得到愚人众执行官的帮助。」
text.en: "Also, please tell them not to count on getting help from a Fatui Harbinger in Snezhnaya."

text.zh: 「虽然我们合作的这段时光…还算不错吧，但毕竟立场不同，届时别搞得双方都很为难。」
text.en: "Our time working together was... not terrible, precisely, but we're on different sides. So when you get there, don't do anything to make life difficult for both of us."

text.zh: 怎么说呢，很像是她会说的话，无论是态度还是道理…好吧，我们会尽量和她保持距离的。
text.en: Well, that definitely sounds on-brand for her. The attitude, the reasoning... Alright, we'll do our best to keep our distance then.

text.zh: 不，我觉得她这段话的意思是，想让你们去见她。
text.en: No, you've misunderstood. I think she means that she'd like you to go see her.

text.zh: 为、为什么？
text.en: Uh... How'd you figure that?

text.zh: 只要不做到「双方都为难」这一步就好了。
text.en: As long as you don't make things difficult for both of you, you'll be fine.

text.zh: 原来还可以这么理解啊…
text.en: Huh. You really have to read between the lines with Sandrone...

text.zh: 快去「旗舰」吧，大家都已经陆续到齐了。我告诉菈乌玛，曾经你为我准备过印象深刻的一餐。
text.en: Go on, get to the The Flagship — everyone should be there by now. I told Lauma that you once treated me to a truly unforgettable meal...

text.zh: 今天，也想借这个机会还给你。嗯…不对，想要「送」给你。
text.en: Today, I want to return the favor. It's... my gift to you.

text.zh: 嘿嘿，这种时候还想着「有借有还」，也太见外啦。
text.en: Hehe, it's definitely nice to be treated. But hopefully by this point, you know that you don't owe us any favors.

text.zh: 确实，没必要算那么清楚。
text.en: Yeah, friends don't keep score.

text.zh: 我还会回来看看的。
text.en: I'll come back to visit.

text.zh: 嗯，挪德卡莱的月亮也永远欢迎你。
text.en: Mm. The moon of Nod-Krai will always give you a warm welcome.

text.zh: 与朋友享用美食，追忆冒险时光，时间过得格外快。
text.en: Time flies when you're having fun, enjoying delicious food with friends, and reminiscing about past adventures.

text.zh: 将欢笑与温暖收进行囊，旅途又翻开了全新的一页。
text.en: After a lovely meal filled with laughter and warmth, it's time to start the next chapter of your journey.

text.zh: 也是时候了。
text.en: It's sure been a long time coming.

text.zh: 我也会有点忐忑。
text.en: I'm a little nervous too.

text.zh: 你怎么知道我在这里…
text.en: How did you know I was here?

text.zh: 我应该没告诉任何人…
text.en: I don't think I told anyone...

text.zh: 确实，没必要算那么清楚。
text.en: Yeah, friends don't keep score.

text.zh: 我还会回来看看的。
text.en: I'll come back to visit.

text.zh: #哇，一片白茫茫的，好漂亮。{NICKNAME}，快跟上来吧。
text.en: Wow, pure white as far as the eye can see! It's so pretty... Come on, keep up!

text.zh: 我来看看你的留影技术是不是有进步了…嗯，等等，我好像看见了什么。
text.en: Let's see how your Kamera skills are these days... Whoa, wait a sec, Paimon sees something.

text.zh: 快来，快来，这好像是个车厢！
text.en: Come on, quick! It looks like a train carriage!

text.zh: 我听说至冬有很多铁轨和列车，这个应该就是吧！只是不知道为什么被废弃了…
text.en: Paimon's heard that Snezhnaya has loads of railways and trains. This must be one of them! But... why is it abandoned?

text.zh: 唔唔，还是好冷。
text.en: It's still so cold...

text.zh: 是因为刚刚被雪埋了吗？
text.en: Still feeling chilly from getting buried in the snow?

text.zh: 不知道，有可能，而且我觉得雪是不是越来越大了。
text.en: Dunno... maybe? Also, is it just Paimon, or is the snow getting heavier?

text.zh: 在挪德卡莱都不会这样啊。
text.en: This never happened in Nod-Krai.

text.zh: 嗯，所以我感觉不是温度的原因…
text.en: Yeah. So it can't just be because of the cold...

text.zh: 冷的话可以靠近一点点哦…
text.en: If you're cold, come a little closer.

text.zh: 虽然你这么说我很高兴，不过不是因为冷啦…
text.en: Aw, thanks for offering. But this isn't just the weather...

text.zh: 嗯…就是有种，很奇怪的感觉…之前没有过。
text.en: Ugh... It's hard to describe, but Paimon feels so weird... She's never felt like this before.

text.zh: 身体…变得有点重，头也感觉有点晕…
text.en: Everything feels heavy... Getting kinda dizzy, too...

text.zh: 要不然先回头？
text.en: Should we turn back?

text.zh: 没有没有，一点点，一点点而已，只是感觉有点没力气，不是大事，不用耽误行程。
text.en: Oh, no need. Paimon's just feeling a little low on energy, that's all. It's nothing serious. Not worth ruining our travel plans over.

text.zh: 别逞强哦？
text.en: Well, don't push yourself, okay?

text.zh: 情况加重的话马上要告诉我。
text.en: If you start feeling worse, tell me right away.

text.zh: 嗯！至冬，我们来啦！
text.en: Yep, sure thing! Snezhnaya, here we come!

text.zh: 在挪德卡莱都不会这样啊。
text.en: This never happened in Nod-Krai.

text.zh: 冷的话可以靠近一点点哦…
text.en: If you're cold, come a little closer.

text.zh: 别逞强哦？
text.en: Well, don't push yourself, okay?

text.zh: 情况加重的话马上要告诉我。
text.en: If you start feeling worse, tell me right away.

text.zh: —检测到接近者：权限…通过，原初的…正在启动…
text.en: Incoming entity detected. Authorization... granted. Initiating original...

text.zh: 您好，已然接近「明日」的超越…降临者，「灰{RUBY#[D]格赖埃之眼}眸」为您服务…
text.en: Hello, Transcend... Descender, who has reached the eve of Tomorrow. Eye of Graeae, at your service.

text.zh: 距离上次启动已有…时间计量因…影响不可用，总之，应该是很长的时间了。
text.en: Time since last activation: ... Time measurement unavailable due to the influence of... Anyway, it must have been a very long time.

text.zh: 你是…什么东西？
text.en: Um... What are you?

text.zh: 我是…我是为了使命而诞生的，为了抵达「明日」…
text.en: I am, uh... I was born to fulfill a mission: to reach Tomorrow.

text.zh: 为此必须…奇怪，必须做什么，我…我的身体为什么…
text.en: To this end, I must... I must... Strange, what was it...? Wait, my body...

text.zh: 咦…我的身体怎么会是这个样子…
text.en: Huh? Why is my body like this?

text.zh: 我也想问呢？
text.en: I was about to ask you.

text.zh: 抱歉，似乎由于太久没有启动，所以很多内容佚失了。
text.en: Apologies. After a long period of inactivity, it appears that a lot of data has been lost.

text.zh: 原来不是出生就这样哦？
text.en: Oh... so you weren't born like this?

text.zh: 在被造出来的时候我是这样…但我也有曾经拥有形体的记忆和意识，与现在的状态相悖…
text.en: I have been like this since I was created... And yet, I also have memories and an awareness of a physical form that I once had. But this contradicts my current status...

text.zh: 总之，我是为了人类能够抵达「明日」而被制造出来的…只是具体的内容暂时无法载入…
text.en: Anyway, I was created so that humanity could reach Tomorrow... But I am unable to load further details at this moment.

text.zh: 不过比起那些，为「人类」服务仍然是我首要的目的，检测到您身躯表面失温，无法维持该状态行动太久…
text.en: Nevertheless, serving humanity remains my primary objective. I have detected a drop in your surface body temperature. You cannot remain active in this state for much longer...

text.zh: 按被设定好的流程，在再次启动的时候，我要向唤醒我的人作这样的问询：
text.en: In accordance with my preset programming, upon reactivation, I must ask the one who awakened me the following question:

text.zh: 您愿意接收我吗，超越之人，我将协助您，佑护您，达成使命，直至抵达「明日」——
text.en: Will you accept me, Transcender? I will assist you, protect you, and fulfill my mission until we reach Tomorrow...

text.zh: 欸，我不要，好怪…
text.en: Uh, no thanks. This is all a bit too strange for me...

text.zh: 我能理解您的想法，不过，出于您现在的身体状况，我不觉得这是一个好的建议。
text.en: I understand your position. However, given your current physical condition, I must suggest that you reconsider.

text.zh: 在启动之前，您曾经呼唤过一个名字，那应该是您失散的同伴…
text.en: Before I was activated, you called out a name. Presumably that of your missing companion?

text.zh: 如果您同意接收，我也可以协助您走出此处时，检索与标记对方的位置。
text.en: If you agree to accept me, after helping you get out of here, I will search for said companion and pinpoint their location.

text.zh: …你真的可以做到？
text.en: ...Really? You can do that?

text.zh: 回答是：是的。
text.en: To answer your question: Yes.

text.zh: …那我接收。
text.en: ...Then I accept.

text.zh: 您做出了十分明智的选择。
text.en: You have made a very wise decision.

text.zh: 我愿意接收。
text.en: I will accept you.

text.zh: 您做出了十分明智的选择。
text.en: You have made a very wise decision.

text.zh: 那么，检测到您在之前呼唤过一个名字，那应该是您失散的同伴…
text.en: Now, I detected that you called out a name earlier. Presumably that of your missing companion?

text.zh: 其名为「派蒙」，我将协助您走出此处，为您检索附近符合需求的目标并标记其位置。
text.en: The name was "Paimon." After helping you get out of here, I will search for a match in the nearby area and pinpoint their location.

text.zh: 你…还能做到这样的事？
text.en: Wait... You can do that?

text.zh: 这只是冰山一角。
text.en: Merely the tip of the iceberg.

text.zh: 如是，接收协议已经达成，您将是我新的使用者，请问您的名字是…
text.en: Now that we have reached an accord, you will be my new user. May I ask your name?

text.zh: #{NICKNAME}。
text.en: #{NICKNAME}.

text.zh: #好的，{NICKNAME}，直到完成使命之前，我都会记住这个名字。
text.en: Very well. I will remember this name until the mission is complete.

text.zh: 使命？
text.en: What is your mission, exactly?

text.zh: 是的…我需要…我需要找回我的身躯，寻回开启「明日」的力量，使受苦的众生抵达虚舟漂泊的彼岸…
text.en: I need to... I need to recover my body, retrieve the power to unlock Tomorrow, and help the suffering masses to reach the far shores where the Empty Ark floats...

text.zh: 我能感受到我的力量散落在这片冰芒覆盖的土地之上，甚至有模糊的方向…不过现在，那不是关键。
text.en: I can sense my power scattered across this ice-covered land. I even have a vague sense of where it might be found... But right now, that is not essential.

text.zh: #{NICKNAME}，现在的关键是您—— 您要存活，并且与您的同伴重新相遇。
text.en: The key right now is you. You must survive and reunite with your companion.

text.zh: 我也想问呢？
text.en: I was about to ask you.

text.zh: 原来不是出生就这样哦？
text.en: Oh... so you weren't born like this?

text.zh: 欸，我不要，好怪…
text.en: Uh, no thanks. This is all a bit too strange for me...

text.zh: 我愿意接收。
text.en: I will accept you.

title.en: Find a path that leads out

text.zh: 检测到周围环境…必要出口已被冰封绝…
text.en: Scanning local environment... Exit has been sealed off with ice...

text.zh: 或许可以用火…
text.en: Maybe we can use Pyro?

text.zh: 那并不是具备效率的做法，稍等…附近检测到可用「造物蓝图」…
text.en: That would not be an efficient approach. One moment... Usable Construct Blueprint detected nearby...

text.zh: 可以利用那个更快地清理眼前的坚冰。
text.en: You can use this to clear the solid ice ahead of you more quickly.

title.en: Find a path that leads out

text.zh: 检索到「克什尼克晶矿」，建议进行采集…
text.en: Kresnik Kristall located. Please collect at your earliest convenience.

text.zh: 刚才的造物就是利用了「克什尼克晶矿」的性质，才能如此高效地进行供暖。
text.en: The recent construct you built provides highly efficient heating by utilizing the unique properties of Kresnik Kristall.

text.zh: 只可惜临时的「臻冰造物」维持时间太短，无法在开拓时期保持稳定，正因为这个，才开放了「克什尼克晶矿」的使用权。
text.en: Unfortunately, Prime Ice Constructs have a very short lifespan and cannot be stabilized during the development period. Hence, the authorization to use Kresnik Kristall was granted.

text.zh: …不过我已经忘了，「暖和」是什么感觉了。
text.en: ...That said, I have already forgotten what warmth feels like.

text.zh: 或许等拿回身体…
text.en: Maybe when you get your body back...

text.zh: 是的，说不定到时候就能和您一起在炉边烤火了。
text.en: Yes. Perhaps then, we can warm ourselves by the fireside together.

text.zh: 总之，收集克什尼克晶矿，我就可以提取其中的能量，维持您体表的温度，现在，记住这个就好。
text.en: But for now, all you need to remember is this: If you collect Kresnik Kristall, I can extract the energy within and use it to maintain your body's surface temperature.

title.zh: 前往派蒙可能在的屋子
title.en: Go to the house where Paimon might be

text.zh: 我们正逐渐接近目标所在地。检测生体反应数量…数量为…二？
text.en: Approaching the target location. Scanning for signs of life... Lifeforms detected: ...Two?

text.zh: 除了派蒙还有其他人？
text.en: Does that mean someone else is there besides Paimon?

text.zh: 正如您所说，但我的疑惑另有原因——数据库记录此地为列车车站，生体数量不应如此之少。
text.en: Affirmative — however, that is not the reason for my confusion. According to my database, this location is a train station, meaning the number of lifeforms is unusually low.

text.zh: 依照实时收集的环境情报，此地或许已遭废弃。但无论情况如何，请您警惕。
text.en: Real-time environmental data suggests that the train station may no longer be in use. But whatever the situation, please exercise caution.

text.zh: 去屋子里看看再说。
text.en: Let's head inside and take it from there.

text.zh: 派蒙！
text.en: Paimon!

text.zh: …你是谁？
text.en: ...Who are you?

text.zh: 不用担心，只是睡着了。
text.en: Don't worry. She's only sleeping.

text.zh: #看来你就是{NICKNAME}了，她在风雪里乱闯的时候一直在喊你的名字。
text.en: #You must be {NICKNAME}. She called your name repeatedly while attempting to battle her way through the blizzard.

text.zh: 初来乍到的旅客本就难以适应至冬的严寒，恰逢近日有强大的魔物唤来了暴雪，就连本地人也要挣扎度日。
text.en: Newcomers to Snezhnaya struggle to adapt to the sheer cold at the best of times. Lately, even the locals are suffering, with a powerful monster having summoned a bitter snowstorm.

text.zh: 你们应该是非常重要的伙伴，不要轻易走散了。
text.en: You two must be very important to one another. You should take more care not to get separated.

text.zh: 你的眼睛…你是…坎瑞亚人？
text.en: Your eyes... are you... Khaenri'ahn?

text.zh: 世间尚且留存一些躲过浩劫的坎瑞亚人，这对你来说应该不是新鲜的情报。
text.en: There are indeed some Khaenri'ahns left in this world who survived the cataclysm. But I doubt that is news to you.

text.zh: 在此地深究我的身份并不明智，你应该把精力放在她身上。
text.en: It would be unwise to interrogate my identity here. Focus your attention on your travel companion instead.

text.zh: 很快我们就会再见。
text.en: We will meet again very soon.

text.zh: 检测到目标离开。对方似乎来历非凡，可我并未搜索到相关数据，再次遍历数据库…
text.en: The unidentified subject has now left the area. He appears to be an individual of great significance, but my search has yielded no relevant data. I will try searching the database again...

text.zh: 我大概有些猜想…
text.en: I have a rough idea...

text.zh: 是直接帮女皇办事的大人物吧。
text.en: He's probably some big shot who works for the Tsaritsa.

text.zh: 万幸之事，您的同伴平安，那个人还留下了毛毯。
text.en: Against the odds, your companion is safe and sound. The other person even left a blanket for her.

text.zh: 我去烧点水。
text.en: I'll boil some water.

text.zh: 唔…唔…
text.en: *groaning*...

text.zh: #啊，是{NICKNAME}！你没事，太好了！我急得到处找你…咳咳咳！
text.en: #Ah, {NICKNAME}! Thank goodness you're okay! Paimon was so worried. She looked everywhere for you... *coughing*!

text.zh: 没关系，不用着急，你的身体还好吗？
text.en: It's okay, take it easy. Are you feeling alright?

text.zh: 还是和刚到至冬的感觉差不多，应该是着凉了，头晕晕的，实在没顶住就睡了一觉…
text.en: Um, pretty much the same as when we first got to Snezhnaya... Paimon must've caught a cold. She was feeling so faint, she just couldn't keep going any longer, so she had to lie down and sleep it off...

text.zh: 欸，「丑角」去哪里了？
text.en: Wait... Where did The Jester go?

text.zh: 「丑角」？那个人就是「丑角」？
text.en: "The Jester"? That was The Jester?

text.zh: 对啊，愚人众的统括官，「丑角」皮耶罗。你遇见他了？
text.en: Yep, the Director of the Fatui, "The Jester" Pierro. So you met him?

text.zh: 嗯，说了几句话…
text.en: Yeah, we spoke briefly...

text.zh: 但他没有亮明身份。
text.en: But he didn't reveal his identity.

text.zh: （「丑角」一定知道至冬女皇的所有计划，但他不会轻易告诉我，最后很有可能演变为冲突…）
text.en: (The Jester must know everything about the Tsaritsa's plans, but there's no way he'd tell me just like that. We might well have ended up clashing...)

text.zh: （嗯…至少他的判断没错，于我而言，眼下最重要的是照顾好不太舒服的派蒙。）
text.en: (Hmm... Well, he was right about one thing. Right now, the most important thing for me is to take care of Paimon while she's unwell.)

text.zh: 他无意言述动机，离去得很匆忙。
text.en: He had no intention of explaining his motives, and he left in something of a hurry.

text.zh: 呜哇，谁、谁在说话？
text.en: Eek! What the... who was that!?

text.zh: 这是我在冰洞里找到的。
text.en: Oh, I found this in an ice cave.

text.zh: 看起来像是…一副眼镜，好神奇，居然这样的东西有自我意识，还能说话…
text.en: It looks like a... pair of goggles. How amazing... A self-aware, talking pair of goggles...

text.zh: 至冬曾是妖精的国度，留存了许多先古造物，足以让您大开眼界。不过如您这般的生物…也在扩充我的资料库…
text.en: Snezhnaya was once the land of the fae. There are many ancient creations here that I'm sure would broaden your mind further still. Mind you, my database is also expanding as we speak — you must be a rare creature yourself.

text.zh: 就是因为有它的帮助…
text.en: The Eye of Graeae helped me find you.

text.zh: 我才能顺利从冰洞里脱险。
text.en: That's how I made it safely out of that cave.

text.zh: 这样啊，那太谢谢你了！我要把我最喜欢的糖…呃，看上去你好像没办法吃糖。
text.en: Oh, wow! Well, thank you so much! You've earned yourself some of Paimon's favorite candy! ...Oh, but by the looks of it, you probably can't eat that, can you?

text.zh: 检测到对象表达好意，提供最偏爱策略：请帮我定期清洁，保持运行效率。
text.en: Goodwill detected. Instead of candy, perhaps I can suggest my preferred strategy: Please clean me regularly to keep me operating at peak efficiency.

text.zh: 嘿嘿，有道理，毕竟你是「眼镜」啊。那一言为定！
text.en: Hehe, that makes sense — every pair of goggles needs wiping clean once in a while. Sure thing, Mister!

text.zh: 对了，我想起来了，「丑角」还留下了一个让我很费解的问题。
text.en: Anyway, back to The Jester for a second. Paimon's still confused about something...

text.zh: 在雪里遇见他的时候，他知道我叫派蒙，而且一副我应该认识他的样子…
text.en: When he first showed up, he already knew Paimon's name — and he acted like he expected Paimon to know who he was, too...

text.zh: 可是我只能从眼睛看出来他是个坎瑞亚人，似乎很有来头，但不知道他就是「丑角」。
text.en: Paimon could tell that he was Khaenri'ahn from his eyes, and he definitely seemed like someone pretty important. But beyond that, Paimon didn't know anything about him.

text.zh: 后来他把我从雪里救了出来，介绍了一下自己，我才知道这些信息。
text.en: It was only later, after he rescued Paimon from the snow, that he properly introduced himself. That's the only reason Paimon knows he was The Jester.

text.zh: 他认识你？
text.en: So he knows you?

text.zh: 不会是专门来找你的吧？
text.en: Is that why he was here? He came looking for you?

text.zh: 应该不会吧，他是顺着我的声音冲进雪里来的，表情很着急，不像是事先知道我会在这里的样子…
text.en: Seems unlikely... He ran into the snow following the sound of Paimon's voice with a really anxious expression on his face. He didn't act like someone who knew she would be here in advance...

text.zh: 而且他把我救到这里之后就在看雪，没对我做过任何事，甚至都不怎么和我说话，我的问题他也不回答。
text.en: And after bringing Paimon here, he just stared out at the snow. He didn't do anything to Paimon at all. In fact, he barely said anything. Wouldn't even answer any of Paimon's questions, either.

text.zh: 我从他的身上感觉不到危险和恶意，而且他要是愿意理理我的话，说不定我也不会睡过去了…
text.en: Paimon didn't feel unsafe around him, and he didn't seem to have any ulterior motives. For all we know, he might have just ignored Paimon's questions so she'd give up and go to sleep...

text.zh: 请容我打断片刻，「愚人众」，以及「统括官」，于我而言都是陌生词汇，可否询问更详细的信息？
text.en: Please allow me to interrupt. "Fatui" and "Director" are unfamiliar terms. May I ask for clarification?

text.zh: 你居然不知道愚人众…愚人众就是，嗯，至冬女皇的左膀右臂，非常厉害的人物吧。而统括官就是他们的头头！
text.en: Wait, you've seriously never heard of the Fatui? Huh. They're like, uh... the Tsaritsa's inner circle. Really powerful people. And the Director is their boss!

text.zh: 了解。既然身居高位，常伴神明左右，做事理应体面。另，我与派蒙女士意见一致，未能检测到对方含有恶意。
text.en: Understood. Since they hold elite positions and serve their god directly, it stands to reason that they would conduct themselves with due decorum. I am inclined to agree with your assessment, Miss Paimon: I did not detect any ill will from the gentleman in question.

text.zh: 有道理。
text.en: I see what you mean.

text.zh: 下次遇见他，和他道个谢吧。
text.en: We'll remember to thank him next time we see him.

text.zh: 咳咳咳…
text.en: *coughing*...

text.zh: 抱歉，让你说太多话了。
text.en: Sorry, I shouldn't have encouraged you to talk so much...

text.zh: 派蒙，我有个想法，我们暂时从至冬撤出去，等天气转好，你的身体也康复，我们再出发。
text.en: Paimon, new plan. Let's get out of Snezhnaya for now. We can come back after the weather clears up and you're all better.

text.zh: 丑角提到了眼前的暴雪似乎是因魔物所致，就算强行前往至冬堡，可能也无法展开探索。
text.en: The Jester mentioned that this snowstorm, being the work of a monster, is worse than most. Even if we made it to Snezhnograd, we'd still have to wait out the storm before we could do any exploring.

text.zh: 我知道你在为我着想，但是…咳咳，我不想拖你的后腿…
text.en: Aw... Well, it's really nice of you to look out for Paimon, but... *cough* she doesn't wanna hold you back...

text.zh: 启程的时候我们对这趟旅途充满了期待，有太多问题都要在这里找到答案，这一等，又不知道要到什么时候。
text.en: We were really psyched up for this journey when we first set off. Just think of all the burning questions we have... If we turn back now, who knows how long it'll take before we finally get answers?

text.zh: 魔物之事还需更多情报，我们眼前另一个客观问题更值得重视——
text.en: Further information is required regarding the monster situation. But objectively speaking, there is another, more pressing issue at hand.

text.zh: 我们已经在风雪中行进了很远，从这里撤出至冬的路同样艰难，更何况我们必须徒步。
text.en: At this point, we have traveled a significant distance into the blizzard. Were we to turn back now, the road would be extremely treacherous — especially since we would need to travel on foot.

text.zh: 但如果前进的话，我有更好的方法。
text.en: If, however, we continue onward, there may be a better solution.

text.zh: 还记得吗？我和您说过这里是个车站。虽然此地遭到废弃的原因不明，但铁轨依然留存于此。
text.en: Do you remember what I said as we neared this location? I told you that this is a train station. While it has evidently fallen into disuse for unknown reasons, the tracks remain intact.

text.zh: 驾驶列车，我们就能冲破风雪，开向前方。这是至冬人的一贯做法。
text.en: We can break through the blizzard and forge ahead by driving a train. That is the Snezhnayan way.

text.zh: 前方存在一座小镇，很适合让派蒙女士暂住休整。
text.en: There is a small town up ahead, which would be the perfect place for Miss Paimon to rest and recover.

text.zh: 我觉得「眼镜」说的很有道理，嘿嘿，就这么办吧。
text.en: Paimon thinks Goggles here makes a great point, hehe. Let's do that!

text.zh: 如果真的很难受就不要逞强。
text.en: Are you sure you're up to this? I don't want you to push yourself.

text.zh: 哎呀，放心啦，你想想看这一路走来我也没怎么生过病，我的身体好着呢，精神不好只是暂时的。
text.en: Ah, c'mon, don't worry! Think of all the traveling we've done so far — when has Paimon ever gotten sick before? Practically never, 'cause she's in great shape! Sure, she's a little tired right now, but it's sure to clear up on its own.

text.zh: 好吧。
text.en: Fair enough.

text.zh: 那我们先去镇上住一天。
text.en: We'll stay the night in the town, then take it from there.

text.zh: 好的。后续冒险中如果需要我的帮助，请随时呼叫「灰眸」。
text.en: Affirmative. Should you ever need my assistance during your future adventures, please call for the "Eye of Graeae" whenever you wish.

text.zh: 除此之外的时间我会保持静默，避免不必要的麻烦。现在，请您随我到铁轨旁。
text.en: Otherwise, I will remain silent to avoid causing any unnecessary distraction. Now, please follow me to the train tracks.

text.zh: 我大概有些猜想…
text.en: I have a rough idea...

text.zh: 是直接帮女皇办事的大人物吧。
text.en: He's probably some big shot who works for the Tsaritsa.

text.zh: 嗯，说了几句话…
text.en: Yeah, we spoke briefly...

text.zh: 但他没有亮明身份。
text.en: But he didn't reveal his identity.

text.zh: 就是因为有它的帮助…
text.en: The Eye of Graeae helped me find you.

text.zh: 我才能顺利从冰洞里脱险。
text.en: That's how I made it safely out of that cave.

text.zh: 他认识你？
text.en: So he knows you?

text.zh: 不会是专门来找你的吧？
text.en: Is that why he was here? He came looking for you?

text.zh: 有道理。
text.en: I see what you mean.

text.zh: 下次遇见他，和他道个谢吧。
text.en: We'll remember to thank him next time we see him.

text.zh: 好吧。
text.en: Fair enough.

text.zh: 那我们先去镇上住一天。
text.en: We'll stay the night in the town, then take it from there.

text.zh: 在屋中与派蒙顺利会合…
text.en: You meet up with Paimon in the house...

title.en: Drive the train out of the blizzard

text.zh: 从这里向北，我们很快就会抵达…
text.en: Heading north from here, we will soon arrive at...

text.zh: 稍等，有报错提示…无法检测到通畅的铁轨？
text.en: Wait, there's an error message... "Could not detect clear tracks"...?

text.zh: 嗯，什么叫通畅的…
text.en: Um, what exactly does "clear" mean...?

text.zh: 朋友们，做好防冲击准备！即将进入预期外的飞行模式——
text.en: Brace for impact, friends! Preparing to enter impromptu flight mode...

title.en: Talk to Paimon and the Eye of Graeae

text.zh: 真是奇怪，不仅是车站情况和记录有很大差距，就连铁路与地形都发生了改变…
text.en: How strange. Not only was the station's status different from my records, but even the railroads and the terrain itself have changed substantially...

text.zh: 派蒙，没事吧？
text.en: Paimon, are you okay?

text.zh: 嗯，多亏你反应快…
text.en: Yeah, thanks to your quick reflexes...

text.zh: 抱歉，把您卷入危险中，我也对现状一头雾水…
text.en: My sincere apologies for putting you in danger. I'm afraid I'm as confused by all this as you are...

text.zh: 该找机会更新数据了。
text.en: We need to find a way to update your databanks...

text.zh: 可惜了这辆列车。
text.en: Shame about the train.

text.zh: 您说得对，应该是铁路数据信息过期所致。只是和老旧数据相比，变化比我想象中要更大…
text.en: Agreed — this is likely a consequence of outdated railroad data. The discrepancies between the old data and present reality are far greater than I anticipated...

text.zh: 不过幸运的是，按照数据，我们的坠落地就在小镇附近。
text.en: Fortunately, our crash landing has at least brought us much closer to the town. According to the data, anyway.

text.zh: 又是「按照数据」…
text.en: Your data had better be right this time...

text.zh: 这次肯定不会错，请您看向这个方向，那就是克什尼克之炬！
text.en: I can assure you, it certainly is. Please look this way, and you will see a Kresnik's Torch.

text.zh: 从结果来说，我们因祸得福，走了一条最近的路。
text.en: It seems our ill-fated train ride was a blessing in disguise. We have taken the shortest possible route.

text.zh: 只是这条路实在不算平稳。
text.en: It wasn't what you'd call comfortable, though...

text.zh: 请您放心，下次我会考虑到用户偏好的，下次一定——
text.en: Rest assured that I will take user preferences into account next time I plan a route. Next time, I will get it right...

text.zh: 该找机会更新数据了。
text.en: We need to find a way to update your databanks...

text.zh: 可惜了这辆列车。
text.en: Shame about the train.

description.zh: 几经颠簸，你们用不太常规的方式抵达了凝露镇附近…
description.en: After several twists and turns, you finally reach the vicinity of Sretomorozsk via somewhat unorthodox means...

text.zh: 在凝露镇结识阿罗夏，并成功修好了列车。
text.en: You meet Alyosha at Sretomorozsk and successfully repair the train.

text.zh: 顺利离开影域后，「灰眸」在曙光车站将列车翻新，接下来可以前往至冬堡了。
text.en: After you successfully leave the Shadow Realm, the Eye of Graeae renovates the train at Rankova Zorya. Now, you can head to Snezhnograd.

title.en: Find Paimon a place to shelter from the snow

text.zh: 你好，请问镇上还有正在营业的旅店吗？
text.en: Hi there. Do you know if there are any inns still taking guests in this town?

text.zh: 我想应该都歇业了。每家每户都缺克什尼克晶矿，没法取暖，更做不了生意。
text.en: Doubt it. They're probably all closed. No one has enough Kresnik Kristall to heat their own homes, let alone a business.

text.zh: 唉，居然会这样…
text.en: *sigh* What a bummer...

text.zh: 刚刚就留意到你们了，是冒险家？如今很少有人往至冬内陆走。
text.en: I clocked you a while back. You adventurers, or something? We don't get many tourists in inland Snezhnaya these days.

text.zh: 为什么啊，是因为暴风雪吗？
text.en: Why's that? Because of the snowstorm?

text.zh: 不仅如此，更重要的原因是「严冬计划」。既然是女皇陛下的意思，不管愿不愿意，我们没得选。
text.en: In part, but the bigger reason's Project Stuzha. Since it's Her Majesty's will, we have to put up with it whether we like it or not.

text.zh: 我不太了解「严冬计划」是什么。
text.en: I don't really know what Project Stuzha is.

text.zh: 抱歉，还以为早「声名远扬」了呢。简单点说，女皇陛下要做一件大事，这件事要消耗非常非常多的能源。
text.en: Oh, sorry. I assumed it was common knowledge by now. Basically, the Tsaritsa is planning something big — something that requires an enormous amount of energy.

text.zh: 即便用上至冬所有富余的克什尼克晶矿，都无法满足这个需求。
text.en: Even if they used all the surplus Kresnik Kristall in Snezhnaya, it still wouldn't be enough to meet demand.

text.zh: 所以，评议会决议要求缩减工厂与民众日常生活的能源开销，这便被称为「严冬计划」。
text.en: So, the Veche passed a resolution requiring all factories and households to reduce their energy consumption. The policy has been charmingly named Project "Stuzha," meaning "bitter cold."

text.zh: 是…让大家一起过冬的意思吗？
text.en: Bitter cold? So like... "It's gonna be a cold winter, folks — you're all gonna have to find a way to get through it." That kind of idea?

text.zh: 差不多吧，人是有「弹性」的。没钱了就省省，冷了就挤挤，日子总能过…
text.en: Pretty much. When you're broke, you scrimp and save. When it's cold, you huddle together for warmth. There's always a way to stretch things out to make ends meet...

text.zh: 只是时间长了还能不能恢复原状…哎，算了，你们跟我来看看就明白了。
text.en: Trouble is, if you stretch someone out like an elastic band for too long, who knows if they can ever bounce back... *sigh* You know what? Come with me, and see for yourself.

text.zh: 为什么这次的晶矿价格又涨了三分之一，而且限额还变少了？
text.en: Can you please explain to me why the price of Kresnik Kristall has gone up by a third again, even as our purchase quota's gone down?

text.zh: 你们一个月才来两次，现在的晶矿限额，就连一周都顶不住！
text.en: You only come here twice a month! This won't even last us a week!

text.zh: 克什尼克晶矿的供给与定价，都是根据目前的产量与价格数据制定的。
text.en: The supply and pricing of Kresnik Kristall are based on current production volumes and price data.

text.zh: 我们「愚人众」仅承担运送和治安任务，无法为你解答背后的计算逻辑，但你眼前的数字就是现实且公正的。
text.en: We Fatui are only responsible for delivery and security. I'm not in a position to explain to you how the figures are calculated, but I assure you they are as fair and reasonable as possible.

text.zh: 这不是没把我们的死活放在眼里吗？要是没法取暖，谁能在这样的大雪里活过哪怕一晚！
text.en: Oh, so our lives mean nothing to you? How can you expect anyone to survive a single night in this weather without heating!?

text.zh: 我实在不想每次来这里都重复相同的话：克什尼克晶矿并非垄断经销，你们大可在市场上采购不足的份额。
text.en: Since you insist on making me repeat myself every single visit, I will remind you again: There is no monopoly on the trade of Kresnik Kristall. You are free to purchase the shortfall from elsewhere on the market.

text.zh: 现在哪里还能买得到？有也是十倍八倍的价格，和抢劫有什么区别？
text.en: What market? Nobody else is selling — and when they do, they charge eight times the normal rate! It's robbery, is what it is!

text.zh: 所以，若不是皇都评议会通过了支援边境的议案，你们连眼前这部分晶矿都买不到。
text.en: Which is why the Snezhnograd Veche passed a resolution to support border communities — without which, you wouldn't even be able to buy Kristall from us to begin with.

text.zh: 如果只是来吵架的，就把位置让出来给后面的人，大家都还在挨冻呢。
text.en: So if you're here just to argue, move aside and let the next person in line come forward. Everyone's feeling the cold here.

text.zh: 你…你…
text.en: You... You...!

text.zh: 哎，大家都冷静冷静吧，听我说两句。我们同为女皇陛下的臣民，都是为了她的伟业在奉献。
text.en: Alright, everyone, let's calm down for a second. A few words, if I may. We're all subjects of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and I'm sure every one of us is dedicated to her great cause.

text.zh: 我们都知道天气冷，越是下雪日子越不好过，大家都有难处，我们也没必要为难对方。
text.en: We all know how cold it is, and the more it snows, the harder life gets. Everyone's struggling already — let's not make things even more difficult for each other.

text.zh: 希什金联络官，这次的份额绝对有问题！我在海屑镇的亲戚说，他们能买到的晶矿是我们的两倍还多。
text.en: But Liaison Shishkin, there's clearly something wrong with this quota! I have a family in Morepesok who tell me they can buy at least double our Kristall allotment.

text.zh: 这个嘛，我和你一样，拿到数字的时候还以为自己眼花了，还专门写信去确认，结果…哎，就是很少啊。
text.en: Oh, believe you me, I had the same reaction when I first saw the numbers... Couldn't believe what I was reading. I even wrote a letter to confirm the true figures, but... *sigh* I'm afraid the quota really is as low as you've been advised.

text.zh: 不过你也要理解，能源供给的计算方式很复杂，要考虑人口，城镇面积，产业类型…
text.en: Still, you must understand that calculating these energy quotas is a complicated balancing act. They have to factor in population, town size, industrial application...

text.zh: 先要保证最大的克什尼克之炬持续燃烧，才能把剩下的晶矿销售给家家户户，还得考虑公平。
text.en: Our top priority must be to keep the largest Kresnik's Torch burning continuously. Only then can we sell the remaining Kristall for household use, and in doing so, we must make sure that everyone is treated fairly.

text.zh: 就像这位军人先生所说，他们只承担了运送工作，需要如实记录，也确实没有修改数据的权限。
text.en: As our Fatui comrade said, they are only responsible for delivering the goods. They need to keep accurate records, and they do not have any authority to modify the rates or quotas.

text.zh: 嗯，我们的职责就是秉公办事。
text.en: That's right. Our duty is to do things by the book.

text.zh: 哎…
text.en: *sigh*...

text.zh: 要不然这样，大家都听我说，我知道各位都很焦急和生气，我刚刚已经和镇长商量过了。
text.en: ...Tell you what. Listen, I know how anxious and upset everyone is. As a matter of fact, I was just discussing it with the mayor.

text.zh: 克什尼克之炬的底层燃烧室，将为大家开放。各位可以来我这里注册登记，我来分配使用时段。
text.en: What we can do is open the lower combustion chamber of the Kresnik's Torch to the public. You can come to me directly to register, and I will allocate time slots accordingly.

text.zh: 虽然不能保证各位家里都有能源用，但每天烧水做饭是能够保证的，我们一起坚持坚持，行吗？
text.en: I can't guarantee there'll be ample energy for household use. But we can at least make sure you'll be able to boil water and cook food each day. Let's hang in there and make this work together, alright?

text.zh: 好吧，也没有其他更好的办法了。
text.en: Fine. I don't see any alternative...

text.zh: 原来如此，这也难怪没人做生意，就连日子都要过不下去了。
text.en: So this is Project Stuzha in action, huh... No wonder nothing's open for business. People are barely getting by.

text.zh: 好像没有什么我们能做的…
text.en: It seems like there's nothing we can do...

text.zh: 现在该怎么办…
text.en: So, where do we go from here?

text.zh: 我记得，你是打算给这位…妖精朋友寻一间旅店？
text.en: You were looking for an inn, right? For your, uh... fae friend?

text.zh: 我不是妖精啦，叫我派蒙就好。我刚刚到至冬，好像是不太适应这边的气候，太冷了…
text.en: Oh, Paimon's not a fae, hehe. Just Paimon. She must've caught a cold or something. We only just got to Snezhnaya, and we're still getting used to the climate...

text.zh: 我在凝露镇这里有个临时的落脚处，只是我也不常住那里，条件比较简陋。
text.en: I have a small place in Sretomorozsk. I don't stay there very often, though, so it's pretty basic.

text.zh: 但如果不嫌弃的话，可以在那里先休息休息，毛毯和火炉还是有的。
text.en: But if you're not picky, you're welcome to rest there for now. It's not much, but I've got blankets and a warm fire.

text.zh: 真的吗？太谢谢你了。
text.en: Are you sure? That's really kind of you...

text.zh: 非常感谢，帮了大忙。
text.en: Thank you so much. This is an enormous help.

text.zh: 嗯，那跟我走吧。
text.en: Alright then. This way.

text.zh: 好像没有什么我们能做的…
text.en: It seems like there's nothing we can do...

text.zh: 现在该怎么办…
text.en: So, where do we go from here?

text.zh: 暖暖的，好舒服，从头到脚都热乎起来了。
text.en: Ohh, so cozy and warm... Paimon's getting nice and toasty.

text.zh: #对了，刚刚只介绍了我自己，这位是我最好的伙伴，{NICKNAME}。
text.en: #Oh, wait, Paimon only introduced herself so far, didn't she? This is Paimon's best friend, {NICKNAME}.

text.zh: 幸会，叫我阿罗夏吧。
text.en: Good to meet you. I'm Alyosha.

text.zh: 有很多初到至冬的旅者都不适应这里的气候，但只要注意保暖，就不是什么大事。
text.en: Most travelers find the Snezhnayan climate to be a shock to the system at first. But as long as you keep yourself warm, you should be fine.

text.zh: 不过也不能因此怠慢了处理，有人太不把「受寒」当回事，最后落下了病根。
text.en: Still, you should keep an eye on your condition. When people are too quick to dismiss a cold, it can easily end up turning into something more serious.

text.zh: 别、别吓唬人啊，我还很年轻呢…
text.en: Don't say that! Paimon's too young for chronic health issues...

text.zh: 凝露镇有医生吗？
text.en: Is there a doctor in Sretomorozsk?

text.zh: 现在不在镇上，一时半会儿也回不来。能源跟不上之后，列车站也停运了。
text.en: They aren't in town right now, and they won't be back anytime soon. The train station has been closed ever since these power shortages began.

text.zh: 我常年在外打猎，总和风雪作伴，但这种天气别说人了，闯进去的猎物都活不下几只。
text.en: I do a lot of hunting, so I spend most of my time exposed to the elements. But even the animals wouldn't survive long in a storm like this, let alone a hunter.

text.zh: 在雪变小之前，我们都只能老老实实待在镇里。
text.en: Nothing to do but sit tight in town until the weather improves.

text.zh: 有可能让车站恢复吗？
text.en: Is there any possibility of getting the train station running again?

text.zh: 我理解你急迫的心情，但车站恢复也不意味着有车能坐，我们要做好长期滞留的准备…
text.en: I get that you're in a hurry, but even if the station were open, that doesn't mean there'd be any trains. We could end up stuck here for a long time, I'm afraid...

text.zh: 其实…我就有一辆列车。
text.en: Actually... I, uh, have my own train.

text.zh: 什么？我没听错吧，难道说…突然从空中坠落，摔在冰面上的，就是你们的列车？
text.en: What? Your own train? Wait, hold on... THAT train? The one that suddenly fell out of the sky and crash-landed on the ice?

text.zh: 嘿嘿，我们运气好，在山洞里找到的，但驾驶的时候出了点小意外。
text.en: Hehe, we got lucky and found it in a cave. ...Then our luck ran out, and we had a little accident.

text.zh: 还是去至冬堡找个医生更放心。
text.en: I'd really like to get to Snezhnograd and find a doctor.

text.zh: 没想到山里还能捡到这种东西。如果解决了车的问题，那想去至冬堡，说不定还真有办法。
text.en: Pretty crazy for a random find in the mountains... Well, as long as your train's good to roll, you might get to Snezhnograd after all.

text.zh: 我之前在调查的时候发现，凝露镇的这场能源危机，其实是因为有部分晶矿被私藏了起来。
text.en: I've been doing some digging recently. Turns out, the real reason for the current energy crisis in Sretomorozsk is that some of the supply is being seized for a private stockpile.

text.zh: 但想要揭发这一切，还得人赃俱获才行，所以我现在就打算去「抓兔子」。
text.en: But to expose what's going on, I need to catch them in the act. So, I'm heading off to catch a rabbit.

text.zh: 欸？居然是兔子偷的吗？
text.en: Huh? Wait, a rabbit stole the Kristall?

text.zh: …比方而已，真兔子没这个本事，而且晶矿对兔子的吸引力还不如胡萝卜。
text.en: ...It's a figure of speech. Real rabbits couldn't pull this off. They'd prefer carrots to Kresnik Kristall anyway.

text.zh: 你有怀疑目标了吗？
text.en: Do you have a suspect in mind?

text.zh: 嗯，就是那个负责打圆场，看来态度很好的希什金。
text.en: Shishkin. Mr. "Positive Attitude, Let's All Get Along, Now Shall We?"

text.zh: 居然是他啊…
text.en: Him, really? Paimon never would have guessed...

text.zh: 我跟你去吧，现在就去。
text.en: I'll come with you. Let's go.

text.zh: 欸，你也要去？
text.en: Huh? You're coming with?

text.zh: 解决了这件事就能让车站复原。
text.en: Solving the energy crisis will help get the station running again.

text.zh: 就能去至冬堡了。
text.en: Then we can go to Snezhnograd.

text.zh: 那、那我也…
text.en: Ah... O—Okay then, just give Paimon a second to get ready—

text.zh: 派蒙就在这里休息吧。
text.en: You stay here and rest, Paimon.

text.zh: 身体不要继续变差了。
text.en: We don't want your condition getting any worse.

text.zh: 好吧，太逞强了也不好，那我等你们回来。要小心点哦。
text.en: Alright, guess there's no point pushing myself. Paimon will stay here and hold the fort, then.... Be careful, you two!

text.zh: 对了，还没介绍过。图加林，进来。
text.en: Oh yeah, there's one more introduction to do. Tugarin, get in here.

text.zh: 哇，是狗狗！
text.en: Aww, a doggie!

text.zh: 汪汪——
text.en: Woof woof!

text.zh: 好凶哦，还不让摸。
text.en: Oof, angry doggie... Tugarin doesn't like being petted, then?

text.zh: 它是这样的，有点傲。平时和我一起打猎，等会儿会配合我们行动。
text.en: He likes to think he's above that kind of thing. He's my hunting partner, so he'll be joining us when we head out.

text.zh: 除了必要的「胡萝卜」，我们的动作还要避开视线，不能打草惊蛇，否则谁知道兔子会躲回哪个洞里。
text.en: "Carrots" aside, we'll need to stay completely undetected. We can't risk spooking our rabbit, or there's no telling which burrow he'll scurry back into.

text.zh: 我们先要想办法去一趟被封锁的车站，看看有没有真实的货运数据，希什金手里的那个不可信。
text.en: First, we need to find a way into the train station and see if we can find any real freight data. Shishkin's figures can't be trusted.

text.zh: 然后，就需要图加林靠它的鼻子追查晶矿是怎么被运走的…
text.en: Then, we get Tugarin to catch a scent and find out which way the Kristall went...

text.zh: 你怎么就吃上了？
text.en: ...What are you eating?

text.zh: 你看，这些肉干就是它的「胡萝卜」。
text.en: Check it out. When you're all out of carrots, try jerky!

text.zh: 汪汪汪——
text.en: Woof, woof, woof!

text.zh: 乖狗狗，乖狗狗。
text.en: Good doggie, good doggie!

text.zh: 看来你也很喜欢狗啊。
text.en: A fellow dog lover, huh?

text.zh: 兔子我也喜欢，胡萝卜我也喜欢！
text.en: Yup! And rabbit-lover! Carrots are great too, y'know!

text.zh: 行吧。图加林，吃饱了就要好好帮忙哦。
text.en: ...Good to know. Eat up, Tugarin. We got a lot of work to do.

text.zh: 解决了这件事就能让车站复原。
text.en: Solving the energy crisis will help get the station running again.

text.zh: 就能去至冬堡了。
text.en: Then we can go to Snezhnograd.

text.zh: 派蒙就在这里休息吧。
text.en: You stay here and rest, Paimon.

text.zh: 身体不要继续变差了。
text.en: We don't want your condition getting any worse.

text.zh: 果然，这里有清单。是愚人众在管这个，希什金没机会动。
text.en: There we go: a freight list. Straight from the Fatui, so Shishkin won't have had the chance to doctor the figures.

text.zh: 纸新得就像刚印出来一样，看来除了别有用心之人，谁都懒得翻看这东西。
text.en: Looks as new as the day it was printed. I guess no one bothers reading these unless they have ulterior motives.

text.zh: 不然也没有空子可钻。
text.en: If they did, there'd be no loophole for him to exploit.

text.zh: 嗯，有这个就足够了。走吧，先离开这里，我们去追查晶矿的下落。
text.en: Yeah, this is all we need. C'mon, let's get out of here, then go track down the Kristall.

text.zh: 该怎么做呢？
text.en: How do we do that?

text.zh: 图加林是非常可靠的猎犬，抓兔子是它的绝活了。
text.en: Tugarin's a keen hunter, and catching rabbits is his specialty.

text.zh: 找到了，「兔子窝」。干得不错，图加林。
text.en: This must be the rabbit's warren. Good job, boy.

text.zh: 果然，有条地道。我下去看看，你帮我望风吧。
text.en: Sure enough, there's a tunnel. You stay here and keep watch — I'm gonna take a look inside.

text.zh: 调查结束，你和阿罗夏秘密通知了愚人众，查获了遗失的部分晶矿。
text.en: With the investigation complete, you and Alyosha secretly notify the Fatui and recover some of the missing Kristall.

text.zh: 而这个地道的入口所在地，就是希什金的住处。现在该去正面对峙了。
text.en: Tellingly, the entrance to the tunnel is right at Shishkin's residence. Now, it's time to confront him.

text.zh: 谢谢你能帮我们打点好，哎，日子越来越难过了。
text.en: Thanks for looking out for us. *sigh* Things are getting tougher by the day.

text.zh: 没事没事，不用客气，女皇陛下在上，一切的奉献都是有意义的。
text.en: No need to thank me — it's my pleasure. Sure as Her Majesty the Tsaritsa watching over us, every sacrifice will be worthwhile.

text.zh: 咬咬牙等暴雪天过去，这种苦日子就结束了。
text.en: Let's grit our teeth until the blizzard passes. These days of hardship will be over soon.

text.zh: 别人不知道，希什金联络官，你的日子倒是一点也不苦。
text.en: Maybe for everyone else, Liaison Shishkin. But for you, the hard times have only just begun.

text.zh: 啊，你们是谁？怎么了？
text.en: Hmm? Who are you? What's the matter?

text.zh: 我只是想问，为什么日子已经这么苦了，竟然还有人囤积了多到用不完的克什尼克晶矿呢？
text.en: I just had a question for you. Why, when times are as tough as this, would someone hoard more Kresnik Kristall than they could ever use?

text.zh: 这里的箱子，全都是这一批运过来的，并没有被拿到这里卖，而是被私藏了起来。
text.en: All the crates here are from the most recent shipment, but they weren't brought here for sale. Instead, they were secretly stashed away.

text.zh: 请问，希什金先生，你知道是怎么回事吗？
text.en: Would you be able to shed any light on the situation, Mr. Shishkin?

text.zh: 嗯？我不知道啊，怎么会有这么多晶矿，这是好事啊，这样大家都有晶矿可以用了。
text.en: Me? Why, I have no idea... But look at how much there is! It's quite a godsend. Now, there will be plenty to go around.

text.zh: 这些晶矿，都是在阿罗夏先生举报之后，从你住所旁的地下室里找到的。
text.en: This "godsend" was found in a cellar adjacent to your residence following a tip from Mr. Alyosha.

text.zh: 这里只有一部分，更多的正由我们清点，稍后会统计出正式的数量。
text.en: And this is only a fraction of what we found down there. We're still taking a full inventory. The official figures will be finalized shortly.

text.zh: 我很感谢你每次调解我们和凝露镇镇民的矛盾，联络官先生，但是现在看来，这些矛盾就是由你引起的。
text.en: I've always been grateful for your efforts to mediate between us and the townspeople of Sretomorozsk. But now, Mr. Shishkin, it appears you were the source of the conflict all along.

text.zh: 没想到你会做这样的事…
text.en: How... How could you do this to us...?

text.zh: 亏我们这么相信你！原来都是在骗我们吗？
text.en: We trusted you to have our backs! You've been lying to us this whole time!?

text.zh: 我、我…
人赃俱获，老实交代吧。
text.en: The jig's up. Time to come clean.

text.zh: 抱歉…抱歉各位，我很对不起你们。
text.en: I... owe you all an apology. I'm sorry... I'm so very sorry.

text.zh: 但请你们相信我，我真的是第一次做这样的事…
text.en: This isn't who I am. Please believe me, this was a one-time mistake that I will never repeat...

text.zh: 你们也知道，严冬计划持续到现在，所有地方的能源都越来越紧缺，大家日子都很难过。
text.en: We all know how difficult life has been since Project Stuzha came into force. Energy is an increasingly scarce resource. People everywhere are getting desperate. But some places have been hit harder than others...

text.zh: 我从小在一个叫「苍石村」的小村子里长大，那里不通列车，现在晶矿根本送不进去，大家都要冻死了。
text.en: I grew up in Alatyr, a small village with no train station. Deliveries of Kresnik Kristall have ceased there entirely. If nothing is done, they're all going to freeze to death...

text.zh: 你们买不到晶矿，我又何尝不是如此，想想我的爸爸，我的妈妈，我就特别着急…
text.en: You know as well as I do how downright impossible it is to buy Kristall these days. The thought of my poor mother and father with no one to help them... Oh, I felt so afraid...

text.zh: 能源只会越来越不够用，但救人又急如救火，看着眼前这些晶矿，我才心生歹念…
text.en: I watched as energy grew scarcer by the week, all the while knowing that their lives were at risk. Then, one day, I looked at the Kristall shipment in front of me and a terrible, selfish thought entered my mind...

text.zh: 哎，看来我真的不擅长干坏事吧，对不起…等下愚人众统计出来就知道了，和他们的运单是能对上数目的。
text.en: *sigh* Looks like I'm just not cut out to be a criminal. I'm so sorry... Once the Fatui have finished their count, you'll see that the numbers match their waybill.

text.zh: 我这里也有至冬官方计算出的真实限额，之前已经买过能源的，都到这里重新交易一下吧…
text.en: I have the official Snezhnayan quotas here. Anyone who has already purchased energy, please make your way over here to correct your transactions...

text.zh: 另外，我再出三个月工资，买下来的晶矿都免费送给大家…至于苍石村，我会去另想办法。
text.en: I'll make a batch purchase of Kristall worth three months' salary for you all to use free of charge. As for Alatyr... I'll think of something else.

text.zh: 也、也不必如此吧…
text.en: Y—You don't have to go that far...

text.zh: 认错就行了，钱我也不想收，毕竟你还是干过那么多好事。
text.en: Yeah, owning up to your mistake is enough for me. You've done plenty of good for the community in the past. I'm not looking for a handout.

text.zh: 别再演了。
text.en: Drop the act.

text.zh: 为什么你的地下室里只有这次的晶矿，因为你有共犯。
text.en: You claim this was a one-time mistake, but the real reason there's only one shipment's worth of stolen Kristall in your basement is that you have an accomplice.

text.zh: 报告长官，镇长的屋子已经搜查完毕，果然找出了大量晶矿箱，有半数甚至保留着运送时的原箱。
text.en: Reporting in, Sir. We've conducted a full search of the mayor's house. As expected, we found many crates full of Kristall, half of which were still in their original shipping containers.

text.zh: 你根本就不是第一次，而是早就和凝露镇的镇长串通好了。
text.en: This wasn't your first time at all. You've been colluding with the mayor of Sretomorozsk for a long time now.

text.zh: 列车站长期停运，只有在运送能源的列车驶入时会短暂启用，那时候，你都会在现场盘点并安排工人卸货。
text.en: The train station's currently out of service, but it does open for a short window every time there's an energy delivery. And every time a train pulls in, you're there on-site to take inventory and oversee the workers unloading the cargo.

text.zh: 这些工人是镇长直接安排的人，在夜里，他们又会从地道把晶矿运送到镇长家，再经由他手销售至外地。
text.en: The mayor handpicks said workers. Per his instructions, they transport the Kristall by tunnel at night to the mayor's house, and he sells it out of town.

text.zh: 因为不能调用列车，只能用其他方式运送出去，所以销售的速度很慢，这也让我抓住了人赃俱获的机会。
text.en: But since he can't get the goods out of town by train, he had to arrange an alternative method of transportation. This meant slower sales, which gave me plenty of opportunity to catch him in the act.

text.zh: 原来，镇长也…
text.en: Wait. The mayor's involved in this, too?

text.zh: 这种事…你有什么证据！
text.en: Preposterous... What proof do you have of any of this?

text.zh: 很简单，因为我在暴风雪里，数过很多次车厢。
text.en: Basic math. I've spent a lot of time lately counting carriages as the snowstorm rages.

text.zh: 车厢？
text.en: Counting carriages? What?

text.zh: 列车运行消耗的能源和总重量有关，眼下每一份能源都很宝贵，列车理应将每个车厢都尽量装满。
text.en: The energy consumed by a train depends on its total weight. And since energy is a limited resource right now, it's fair to assume that every carriage is packed full.

text.zh: 嗯，然后用克什尼克之炬的消耗量，加上你给出的销售数量，和列车理论载货量对比就能发现…
text.en: So, if we take the energy required for the Kresnik's Torch, add the sales figures you provided, then compare that figure to the train's theoretical cargo capacity, guess what?

text.zh: 总是对不上，有少一车的，两车的，这次甚至少了快三车。
text.en: The numbers never match — it's always off by one or two carriages' worth. This time, you set a new record — three carriages missing.

text.zh: 这么大的雪，怎么可能有人能蹲守在外面…！
text.en: Hah! You mean to tell me that you sat around outside counting carriages, in this weather!?

text.zh: 不打猎的猎人，是会饿死的。
text.en: I'm a hunter. I have two options: hunt, or starve.

text.zh: 情况已经基本查明，人赃俱获，把希什金和镇长都带走吧，送回至冬堡。
text.en: Well, I've heard enough. The evidence speaks for itself. Take Shishkin and the mayor into custody and escort them back to Snezhnograd.

text.zh: 该死，该死，可恶的小兔崽子断我财路！你给我等着——！
text.en: Argh! You cocky little brat, ruining my business! Just you wait...!

text.zh: 原来你调查很久了。
text.en: So you've been investigating this for a while, huh?

text.zh: 嗯，算是直觉吧。我不是很擅长算数，这些都是我爹教我的，统计这些数字，感觉比开枪难不知道多少倍。
text.en: Yeah. Something felt off, so I just followed my gut. Math isn't my strong suit, though. I'm lucky my dad made me learn enough to get by, but... All this number-crunching was a million times harder than the "aim-and-fire" work I'm used to.

text.zh: 感谢你的协助，真是个勇敢的小伙子。
text.en: Thank you for your assistance. You're a brave lad.

text.zh: 希什金这个人很狡猾，相信你们也感受到了，他竟然就在我们的眼皮底下做这种事，我们还都没发现。
text.en: Shishkin was quite the cunning criminal, as I'm sure you can tell. He did all of this right under our noses, and we never suspected a thing.

text.zh: 嗯，因为他从来不展示他充满恶意的那一面，很会伪装。
text.en: Mm. A wolf in sheep's clothing. He had everyone fooled.

text.zh: 他演苦情戏的时候，应该也不只是为了混淆视听，而是想要把镇长隐藏起来。
text.en: Even with that sob story he fed us... He was probably trying to keep the mayor out of it, not just mask his own motives.

text.zh: 要是没有你提供的确凿线索，可能还真被他蒙混过去了。
text.en: Without the compelling case you put together, even I might have fallen for it.

text.zh: 你叫阿罗夏对吧，你真的是个猎人吗？
text.en: Alyosha, was it? Tell me, are you really a hunter?

text.zh: 去有动物的地方开上两枪，你便知真假。
text.en: We can go find some wild animals if you want. I'll fire off a couple of shots and you'll see whether I'm the real deal.

text.zh: 没有怀疑你的身份是假的，只是最近那个名声很盛的「呼啸社」，也聚集了这么一帮能人异士。
text.en: I didn't mean to cast suspicion on your identity. It's just... Well, I'm sure you've heard of the Rokot? Recently, they've been recruiting people with your kind of talent...

text.zh: 用表面的身份伪装自己，以此进行一些对抗严冬计划，甚至是直接反对女皇陛下的行动…
text.en: They hide in plain sight under false identities, working against Project Stuzha, sometimes directly opposing the Tsaritsa herself...

text.zh: 虽不是暴力组织，出发点也是为了民众的生活，但作为「愚人众」的一份子，不盯紧了可不行啊。
text.en: They aren't a violent organization, and their goal is to improve the lives of the common folk. But still, as a member of the Fatui, I wouldn't be doing my job if I didn't keep tabs on them.

text.zh: 是吗，城里的事我不熟。
text.en: Huh. First I've heard of this. I don't really keep up with what goes on in the city.

text.zh: 我只知道，人去了城里还要管闲事，就会怕这怕那。
text.en: All I know is, people who don't mind their own business in the city end up paranoid about everything.

text.zh: 我只是看不惯希什金那家伙而已，我就是从苍石村走出来的，那地方的人早就全搬走了，没人的地方怎么会需要晶矿呢？
text.en: As for me? I just couldn't stand Shishkin. I'm from Alatyr myself, and I can tell you, nobody's lived there in years. Why would an abandoned village need Kristall?

text.zh: 当然，没什么人会在意苍石村是不是还存在，你们都不知道吧。
text.en: Of course, no one really cares about the fate of that place. I'm guessing today is the first you've heard of it.

text.zh: 原来如此，听上去有点伤感啊。总之，再次感谢你的协助，也感谢你这位朋友与你一同调查。
text.en: I... see... It does sound quite tragic, really. Well, thanks again for your assistance, and your friend here too.

text.zh: 我会向至冬堡方面汇报本次事件，在新的官员上任前，「愚人众」方面会暂时接管能源分配，车站也会尽快恢复运营。
text.en: I will report this incident to Snezhnograd. The Fatui will take over energy distribution until new officials are appointed. We'll also ensure that the train station resumes normal service as soon as possible.

text.zh: 哈哈哈，就像你说的，我从小也讨厌算数，这下轮到我咯。
text.en: Haha, looks like it's my turn to brush up on math now. I never liked it as a kid either.

text.zh: 我也要感谢你。
text.en: Thanks from me too, Alyosha.

text.zh: 别客气，唉…负责押运的军人理应有核查晶矿总额的职责，谁知道他是冒失，还是吃了好处。
text.en: Don't mention it. *sigh*... Isn't the soldier overseeing the delivery supposed to verify the quantity of the goods? Was he just careless, or was he being paid off, too? Who knows...

text.zh: 打扰了，克什尼克晶矿，也给我一份。
text.en: Excuse me. I'll take a share of Kresnik Kristall too. Thanks.

text.zh: 调查结束，你和阿罗夏秘密通知了愚人众，查获了遗失的部分晶矿。
text.en: With the investigation complete, you and Alyosha secretly notify the Fatui and recover some of the missing Kristall.

text.zh: 谢谢你能帮我们打点好，哎，日子越来越难过了。
text.en: Thanks for looking out for us. *sigh* Things are getting tougher by the day.

text.zh: 请在这里等我一会儿，老人她…现在已经不太认得清人了。
text.en: Hang tight for a moment. This old lady... she doesn't really know who's who anymore.

text.zh: 欸，啊…是孙子啊，今天真冷啊，没挨冻吧？
text.en: Wh? Ah... grandson. It's so cold today, you must be freezing...

text.zh: 老太太，我是阿罗夏。
text.en: Ma'am, it's me, Alyosha.

text.zh: 阿罗夏？谁啊…
text.en: Alyosha? ...Alyosha who?

text.zh: 就是…今天刚刚帮您清了火炉里的积灰，换了更厚的被褥，还帮您擦了背的阿罗夏。
text.en: You know me... I came by earlier today. Cleaned the ashes out of your stove, gave you some warmer bedding, and washed your back.

text.zh: 嗯…嗯…
text.en: Oh... Uh...

text.zh: 想不起来啦。
text.en: ...I'm sorry, I don't remember.

text.zh: 孙子啊，你好不容易回来一趟，别忙来忙去了，你坐着，我去给你做点吃的。
text.en: Now, how often do I get to see my grandson, hmm? Come on, take a seat and relax while I fix you something to eat.

text.zh: 您休息就好，我没事的。
text.en: It's okay, you just rest. I'm fine.

text.zh: 你说你啊，多回来看看不是挺好的吗？凝露镇是个好地方，热闹，什么都有，当官的也负责…
text.en: Oh, you. It's nice to come and visit your old granny once in a while, isn't it? Sretomorozsk's a good town. All sorts of things to do and people to meet, and the local officials are good to us...

text.zh: 你坐着，来这儿坐着。我记得，还有点水果，我去给你拿。
text.en: Sit down, come on, take a seat. I still have some fruit left. Let me get it for you.

text.zh: 您休息就好，别乱走动…哪里有水果？
text.en: Please, don't get up on my account, you need to rest... Where's the fruit?

text.zh: 就在门口的篓子下面，呃…还是床边的柜子来着…
text.en: Right under the basket by the door. Um... or maybe it was on the bedside cabinet...

text.zh: 孙子啊，好吃吗？
text.en: Well, grandson dear? Do you like it?

text.zh: 很好吃，老太太。
text.en: Very much, Ma'am. It's delicious.

text.zh: 那就好，那就好…
text.en: Good, good... Wonderful...

text.zh: 下次别给我留了哦，有水果就尽快吃掉，新鲜的水果现在很珍贵。
text.en: You don't need to save anymore for me next time, alright? Fresh fruit is hard to come by at the moment. You should eat it as soon as you get it.

text.zh: 我不用，没事的，你要是觉得好吃，下次还回来啊。
text.en: Oh, I don't need it. I'm fine. But if you like it, come back for some more soon.

text.zh: 聊天又进行了好一会儿，阿罗夏为老太太收拾完房间这才离开，手里还拿着一袋早就坏掉的莓果。
text.en: After a long chat, Alyosha tidies up the old lady's room before finally leaving, still holding the bag of long-spoiled berries in his hand.

text.zh: 估计是好心人送来的，但这种东西老太太都不舍得吃。
text.en: Some kind soul must've given these to her. But she always saves the nicer things for special occasions.

text.zh: 她是你的什么人吗？
text.en: How do you know her?

text.zh: 在市场上认识的，那时候她还很健康，是个很爽朗的老太太，和我是同乡。
text.en: I met her at the market back before her health began declining. She was a lovely old lady. We're from the same hometown.

text.zh: 苍石村不是个出名的地方，就算有人知道，大概也是因为坏名声…那里出过一帮路匪。
text.en: Not many people have heard of Alatyr — and if they have, it's usually for all the wrong reasons... there's a gang of highwaymen that came from there.

text.zh: 现在村子没了，还有人能聊聊对家乡的好印象，实在很难得，后来我们就保持书信联系。
text.en: Now that it's an abandoned village, it's rare to find anyone who shares fond memories of our hometown. So after we got talking and realized we were from the same place, we decided to keep in touch by letter.

text.zh: 凝露镇的能源问题，最一开始也是我从信件里察觉到的，后来老太太身体变差，我就经常回来看她。
text.en: I first learned of Sretomorozsk's energy supply problems from a passing comment in one of her letters. Then, after her health went downhill, I started visiting more often to check in on her.

text.zh: 镇子每况愈下，可她因为什么都认不清楚了，所以总觉得这里还是当初那个又热闹又繁荣的凝露镇。
text.en: The town's been in decline for a while now. But because of her memory problems, she thinks of it as the bustling, prosperous Sretomorozsk, still in its heyday.

text.zh: 即便是这样，一个乐观的人，在这冰天雪地里，还是很难得啊。
text.en: That said, I kinda appreciate her optimism. There's not much of it going around in this world of ice and snow.

text.zh: 抱歉，或许我不该问。
text.en: Sorry, maybe I shouldn't have asked...

text.zh: 没事，人总会有这么一天。
text.en: It's fine. Everyone grows old.

text.zh: 在至冬有这样的传说，在弥留之际，人会突然感知到有熟悉的身影来到他的身边。
text.en: In Snezhnaya, some people believe that in your final moments, you'll sense a familiar presence by your side.

text.zh: 可是脸是模糊的，怎么都看不清楚，当他努力地想要看清，终于看清的那一瞬间——
text.en: You turn to look at them, but their face is blurry. So you focus hard, trying to make out who it is. When you finally see their face...

text.zh: 「死神」就会出手，夺走他的性命。
text.en: The Grim Reaper reaches out and takes your life.

text.zh: 她还能叫我「孙子」，至少说明我在她的世界里，还不是模糊的。
text.en: She still calls me "grandson," though, so at least I'm not a blurry face in her world just yet.

text.zh: 走吧，该回去看看派蒙的状况是不是好点了。
text.en: C'mon, let's get back and see how Paimon's doing.

text.zh: 我们回来了，派蒙，身体舒服些了吗？
text.en: Paimon, we're back. Are you feeling any better?

text.zh: 嗯，已经不冷了，只是头还有点晕，估计飞的时候还控制不好平衡。
text.en: Yup, Paimon's not cold anymore, but she's still a little dizzy. Flying probably isn't a good idea right now — Paimon might lose her balance.

text.zh: 嘿嘿，我觉得不用担心，可能只是被刚进至冬的那团雪砸到脑袋了吧。
text.en: Hehe, but Paimon's sure she'll be fine. It's probably just from getting hit on the head by that pile of snow when we first arrived in Snezhnaya.

text.zh: 感觉她的气色也恢复了不少，继续观察吧。
text.en: Her complexion's looking much better. Let's keep an eye on her.

text.zh: 还是要找个医生看看。
text.en: I still think we should see a doctor when we get the chance.

text.zh: 嗯，比起这个，你们怎么样，顺利吗？遇到什么麻烦了吗？
text.en: Sure. But enough about that — how did everything go on your end? Are you all set? Did you have any trouble?

text.zh: 我来讲吧，稍微有点长。
text.en: I'll explain. It's a bit of a long story...

text.zh: 居然发生了这么多事，联络官和镇长狼狈为奸，两个坏蛋，幸好把他们给抓出来了。
text.en: Geez, you guys got pretty busy! Sounds like the liaison officer and the mayor were running quite an operation... Hmph, good riddance to both of 'em. It's a good thing you managed to catch them.

text.zh: 大家都有晶矿可以用了，车站也马上就会恢复，对吧？
text.en: So, you said the train station will open again soon, right? And everyone has enough Kristall now?

text.zh: 嗯，但毕竟还是有「严冬计划」在，大家还是要勒紧裤腰过日子。
text.en: Yeah. Well, enough to survive, at least. Project Stuzha isn't going away any time soon. People will still have to scrimp and save to make ends meet.

text.zh: 之前就想问了…
text.en: I've been meaning to ask...

text.zh: 女皇她具体想做什么？
text.en: What exactly is the Tsaritsa trying to achieve?

text.zh: 不知道，「严冬计划」的目的在于为女皇陛下收集能量，但这些能量的去向，基于保密的考量从未公开过。
text.en: Don't know. The goal of Project Stuzha is to gather energy for the Tsaritsa, but no one knows where that energy's going. It's never been made public.

text.zh: 可是关键在于，明明说好了「严冬计划」只会持续半年的时间，谁能想到接下来就是一次又一次的延期…
text.en: The thing is, we were told that the project would only last for six months. But time and time again, they keep extending it...

text.zh: 延期？是因为女皇想做的事不是很顺利吗？
text.en: Extending it? Does that mean the Tsaritsa's plan isn't going very smoothly?

text.zh: 嗯，大家都是这么猜的。理论上来说，延期也需要提出议案，并在皇都评议会上得到半数以上的赞成票。
text.en: That's what everyone suspects. In principle, any proposed extension needs to pass by majority vote in the Snezhnograd Veche.

text.zh: 虽然越来越多的人想要反对，可是最终都被「公鸡」普契涅拉的政治影响力压了下来，没能成功。
text.en: But even though opposition has been growing, any detractors end up caving in to political pressure from "The Rooster," Pulcinella.

text.zh: 他是皇都评议会的主持者，同时也是票决中的重要成员之一，背后还站着许多有权有势的人物。
text.en: He's the chair of the Snezhnograd Veche and a key figure in the voting process. He has the backing of many powerful and influential people.

text.zh: 又是愚人众…
text.en: Sounds like par for the course for the Fatui...

text.zh: 怎么到了至冬，愚人众还是在和普通人作对啊？
text.en: How come the Fatui are picking on ordinary people even here in Snezhnaya?

text.zh: 话也不能这么说，愚人众无论何时都会站在女皇陛下的立场上思考和行动。
text.en: I don't see it like that. Fundamentally, the Fatui will always think and act in the Tsaritsa's interests.

text.zh: 但这不代表他们不在乎普通人的死活——现在凝露镇还能收到晶矿，就是因为「公鸡」当初的支援提案。
text.en: But that doesn't mean they don't care about the plight of the common folk. The only reason Sretomorozsk still receives Kristall shipments is because of a relief proposal put forward by The Rooster himself.

text.zh: 愚人众士兵也在至冬全境四处跑，哪怕是向来保守与冷漠的北国银行，也拿出了赈灾的摩拉。
text.en: Then there's the Fatui soldiers providing support in every corner of the nation... Even the Northland Bank provided some Mora for disaster relief, and they're as conservative and indifferent as they come.

text.zh: 只是，这些大人物在奢华宫殿中看到的「世界」，和我们总归是不同的。产生矛盾也在所难免。
text.en: It's just that the rich and powerful in their fancy palaces live in a completely different world from us. There's always gonna be some conflict when those worlds collide.

text.zh: 我想起了愚人众提到的…
text.en: I'm reminded of something that Fatui officer mentioned...

text.zh: 「呼啸社」。
text.en: "The Rokot."

text.zh: 嗯，即便我们都相信女皇陛下，该如何克服眼前的困局，也还是会有很多很多的分歧。
text.en: Yeah, well, even though we all believe in Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, there are still many differences of opinion on how best to tackle the big issues of the day.

text.zh: 普通人很难在至冬堡发出有力的声音，而有权有势的人又会因为各种复杂的原因不愿或不敢发出声音。
text.en: Regular folk don't have an easy way of getting their voices heard in Snezhnograd, while the rich and powerful are either unwilling or afraid to speak out for all sorts of complicated reasons.

text.zh: 「呼啸社」为这些人提供了一个虚假的身份，让他们的不满有一个释放的出口。
text.en: "The Rokot" provides the disaffected with false identities and an outlet to vent their frustrations.

text.zh: 当然，这种组织存在于灰色地带，一旦被议员们认为偏离了轨道，随时都可能被取缔…
text.en: Of course, an organization like that exists in a gray area. The moment the Veche think they've crossed a line, there's sure to be a crackdown...

text.zh: 但只谈现状，他们做的事还是在尽力帮助普通人。
text.en: But so far, they've been doing their best to help the common folk.

text.zh: 和你在做的事很像。
text.en: They sound a lot like you.

text.zh: 你不也参与了吗？我能看出来，你是个老手。
text.en: Like us, don't you mean? You didn't hesitate to join in. You're not new to this, I can tell.

text.zh: 因为是冒险家嘛，冒险家的工作就是帮人处理委托，探索事件真相。
text.en: That's 'cause we're adventurers! It's our job to help people out with commissions and get to the bottom of things.

text.zh: 和实际到手的报酬相比。
text.en: It's less about the money...

text.zh: 「冒险」本身就有很强的意义。
text.en: ...And more about the adventure itself.

text.zh: 看来我们合得来。
text.en: Sounds like we're going to get along.

text.zh: 如果不是为了带她看病，你去至冬堡做什么？
text.en: So, what's your business in Snezhnograd? Aside from taking your friend to see a doctor, of course.

text.zh: 我要去见女皇，原因很复杂…一路走来我已经和许多执行官打过交道，我很需要知道女皇究竟在做什么。
text.en: I want to meet the Tsaritsa. It's complicated... I've had run-ins with many of the Harbingers along the way, and I really need to know what the Tsaritsa is up to.

text.zh: 女皇的目标，神之心的意义…既然我的旅途已经走到这里，无论用什么方法，我都要问出这个真相。
text.en: Her ultimate goal, what the Gnoses mean in all of this... Since I've made it this far in my journey, I have to find the truth, whatever it takes.

text.zh: 不会吧，你…难道是传闻中那个…
text.en: Wait, so... No way. Are you... who I think you are?

text.zh: 看来你听说过我们，嘿嘿，我们真是越来越有名了。
text.en: Sounds like you've heard of us, then! Hehe, we're getting more famous by the day.

text.zh: 当然我知道这件事不容易。
text.en: Of course, I know it won't be easy.

text.zh: 所以我也没打算硬来。
text.en: So I'm not planning to get there by force.

text.zh: 没想到你们来头这么大。
text.en: I didn't realize I was in the company of giants.

text.zh: 说实话，没人不好奇女皇陛下究竟想做什么，我们又是为了什么在这冰天雪地里受冻。
text.en: Honestly, we're all as curious as you are about what the Tsaritsa's planning, and why it has to involve us freezing to death in the snow.

text.zh: 但想要见到她并不容易，普通人没有与她会面的资格且不说，她现在应该前往东方讨伐魔物了，不在至冬堡。
text.en: But getting in the same room as her won't be easy. The common folk aren't permitted to meet her at the best of times — and right now, she's probably not even in Snezhnograd. Word is, she's heading east on a campaign to slay a monster.

text.zh: 能唤来暴雪的那个魔物？
text.en: The one that's been summoning blizzards?

text.zh: 嗯，看来你也有所耳闻了。它具有唤起暴风雪的能力，行动也极为狂躁，无法预知。
text.en: Yeah. So you've heard of it. A wild, unpredictable monster with the power to summon snowstorms.

text.zh: 它还能将周遭的所有物体都吸入体内，每时每刻都在生长，现在已经变成女皇陛下眼中的头号威胁。
text.en: It also absorbs everything around it into its body, so it's growing constantly. Now, it's so big that the Tsaritsa has deemed it the number one threat.

text.zh: 所幸，伴随着身体膨胀，它的行动变得越来越迟缓，暂时还不会威胁到这里和至冬堡。
text.en: Luckily, as it grew, it became increasingly less mobile, so it doesn't pose an immediate threat to this town or to Snezhnograd.

text.zh: 以女皇陛下与她手下直属卫队「冬契军」的实力，讨伐魔物应该不成问题，只是要花费多久就不得而知了…
text.en: I'm sure the Tsaritsa and her personal guard, the Druzhna, won't have any trouble defeating the creature between them. It's just a question of how long it'll take...

text.zh: 想要见她，最早也得等她归来…
text.en: Suffice to say, you won't be seeing her any time soon. You'll have to wait until she gets back.

text.zh: 没关系，给派蒙看病要紧。
text.en: That's fine. Getting Paimon treated is more urgent right now.

text.zh: 如果到时候还没回来，我就去找她。
text.en: If it comes to it, I'll just have to go to her.

text.zh: 嗯，愚人众会暂时接管这里的车站，估计明天就会准备好。
text.en: Fair. Well, the Fatui will be taking over management of the train station for the time being. Things should be up and running by tomorrow.

text.zh: 等车站恢复了，我们可以去和他们交涉，让他们帮忙把你们的列车拖到车站里去。
text.en: Once it's open, we can see about getting your train towed to the station.

text.zh: 哇，那应该需要不少人吧？
text.en: Whoa, that's gotta take a lot of manpower... Are you sure we can talk them into it?

text.zh: 整件事愚人众也不算干净，我们还帮了他们的忙，这件事应该不难谈。
text.en: The Fatui aren't exactly spotless in this whole mess, plus we helped them out. Should be easy enough to negotiate.

text.zh: 我更在意列车行驶需要什么手续…
text.en: I'm more concerned about what paperwork I need to drive the train...

text.zh: 我听说这些手续好像都是在制造完成时一并颁发的，从没见人查过，不用担心。
text.en: As far as I know, all the paperwork is dealt with upon manufacture. I've never seen anyone check it, so I wouldn't worry.

text.zh: 有了列车就简单了，我们很快就能抵达至冬堡，正好我也要过去，用猎货换些摩拉。
text.en: Having a train makes everything much easier. We'll reach Snezhnograd in no time. I need to head there myself anyway — got some game to trade for Mora.

text.zh: 我在城里认识靠谱的医生，到时候帮你们介绍。
text.en: I know a good doctor in the city. I'll introduce you when we get there.

text.zh: 谢谢你！那就休息一晚上，明天一起走吧。
text.en: Thanks so much! Let's get a good night's sleep ahead of our big trip tomorrow.

text.zh: 之前就想问了…
text.en: I've been meaning to ask...

text.zh: 女皇她具体想做什么？
text.en: What exactly is the Tsaritsa trying to achieve?

text.zh: 我想起了愚人众提到的…
text.en: I'm reminded of something that Fatui officer mentioned...

text.zh: 「呼啸社」。
text.en: "The Rokot."

text.zh: 和实际到手的报酬相比。
text.en: It's less about the money...

text.zh: 「冒险」本身就有很强的意义。
text.en: ...And more about the adventure itself.

text.zh: 当然我知道这件事不容易。
text.en: Of course, I know it won't be easy.

text.zh: 所以我也没打算硬来。
text.en: So I'm not planning to get there by force.

text.zh: 没关系，给派蒙看病要紧。
text.en: That's fine. Getting Paimon treated is more urgent right now.

text.zh: 如果到时候还没回来，我就去找她。
text.en: If it comes to it, I'll just have to go to her.

text.zh: 和愚人众士兵说明情况后，对方很乐意帮忙，顺利将坠落的列车拖拽至铁轨之上。
text.en: After explaining the situation to the Fatui soldiers, they readily agree to help. Soon, the derailed train is back on the tracks.

text.zh: 下次小心点啊，不要再把列车开到那种地方去了。
text.en: Drive carefully, alright? You don't wanna end up in this situation again.

text.zh: 这是什么新制式吗？我好像从来都没见过。
text.en: ...Also, I don't think I've seen a train like this before. Is it a new model or something?

text.zh: 算是吧。
text.en: Yeah, I guess.

text.zh: 哈哈，看来你不太喜欢聊天。这个你也收着，这个是目前的至冬列车路线图。
text.en: Hahaha, not a fan of small talk, are you? Anyway, take this — it's an up-to-date map of the Snezhnayan rail network.

text.zh: 只要你们在行驶，轨道就会自动进行分轨调度，不用担心发生事故。
text.en: All the track-switching is automated, so as long as the train's moving, you don't need to worry about collisions or anything.

text.zh: 车况你们就自己检查一下吧，最好是没有故障，我估计凝露镇也没有会修这种新制式列车的工程师。
text.en: We'll leave you to examine the train's conditions yourselves. Fingers crossed nothing's broken — I doubt Sretomorozsk has any engineers with experience working on this model.

text.zh: 这个我们自己来处理，谢谢你。
text.en: Shouldn't be a problem. Thanks for everything.

text.zh: 那就预祝你们一路顺利，记得确认万无一失再出发啊。
text.en: Alright then. Have a safe journey, and make sure to check everything's working before you set off.

text.zh: 这样目的地应该就设置好了，出发之前再检查一下吧。眼镜眼镜，轮到你登场啦。
text.en: Alright, looks like our destination settings have been applied. Let's give this thing a final once-over and then head out. Goggles, your time to shine!

text.zh: 交给你了。
text.en: Over to you.

text.zh: 收到，正在进行车况检测。
text.en: Affirmative. Running vehicle diagnostics.

text.zh: 这是什么？
text.en: What's this?

text.zh: 你可以理解成是列车的驾驶系统。
text.en: Think of it as a kind of autopilot system.

text.zh: 引擎正常，车轮正常，车体结构…略有损坏，但不影响行驶。
text.en: Engine: Green. Wheels: Green. Frame: ...Minor damage, but no impact on function.

text.zh: 确认完毕，可以正常运行！
text.en: Diagnostics complete. All systems nominal.

text.zh: 好方便啊，这么好用的眼镜，居然是可以在洞里捡到的。
text.en: Neat! Paimon still can't get over the fact that you just found this tech lying around in a random cave.

text.zh: 也是机缘巧合…
text.en: Yeah, I definitely lucked out there...

text.zh: 生活在至冬这么久，还没听说过有像这样又会说话，又能驾驶列车的东西。
text.en: I've lived in Snezhnaya my whole life, and I've never heard of an interactive, talking train autopilot.

text.zh: 严格来说，我的设计目的并不只是用于驾驶列车，不过我想您对那篇几乎不具备可读性的操作指南没有兴趣。
text.en: Strictly speaking, I wasn't designed purely to drive trains, though I doubt you have any interest in navigating the practically unreadable operator's manual yourself.

text.zh: 好了，设置也全部完成，有需要请再度呼唤「灰眸」。
text.en: All configurations are complete. Should you require any further assistance, please call for the Eye of Graeae.

text.zh: 谢谢。
text.en: Thanks.

text.zh: 发车咯——
text.en: Away we gooooo!

text.zh: 不行，我得找个暖和一点的地方坐着…
text.en: Nope, Paimon's gonna find a warmer seat...

text.zh: 欸，怎么回事？
text.en: Huh? What's going on?

text.zh: 不好！
text.en: Oh no!

text.zh: 我会好好休息的，你们小心点哦。
text.en: Paimon's just gonna stay here and get some good rest. You guys be careful out there!

text.zh: #唔…这是，这是什么地方？{NICKNAME}，你没事吧？
text.en: #...Wh—What is this place? {NICKNAME}, are you okay?

text.zh: 我还好…你呢，派蒙？
text.en: I'm alright... You okay, Paimon?

text.zh: 唔，虽然现在飘着，也感觉像是在很黏很黏的水里游…很不舒服…
text.en: Uhh... Paimon's still airborne... But it feels like swimming through thick, gloopy water... Ugh, it's horrible...

text.zh: 真不凑巧，怎么会进到这种鬼地方…
text.en: Just our luck... Of all the things that could have gone wrong...

text.zh: 阿罗夏，你不是至冬本地人吗，你知道这是什么地方吗？
text.en: Alyosha, you're Snezhnayan right? Any idea what the heck this place is?

text.zh: 这里是名为「影域」的特殊空间，没有风也没有元素，没有光也没有时间，一切仿佛静止的世界…
text.en: It's called the "Shadow Realm." A place where no wind blows, no light shines, and no elemental energy flows... even time itself doesn't exist here. It's a world where everything seems to come to a standstill.

text.zh: 我很少见到，甚至进来也只是第一次。「影域」很危险，被吞入「影域」的人很少能回来…
text.en: I've only seen it a few times before, and this is my first time inside. It's a dangerous place. Most people who get sucked into the Shadow Realm are never seen again...

text.zh: 即使回来也都…精神不太正常。
text.en: And the few who do make it back... They're never quite the same.

text.zh: 啊？那现在怎么办？
text.en: Huh? Then... What the heck do we do now?

text.zh: 对了，眼镜是不是知道什么？眼镜？
text.en: Oh, maybe Goggles knows something. ...Goggles?

text.zh: 看来它…好像不在？
text.en: I don't see it anywhere...

text.zh: 怎么会这样…
text.en: Great, now we're done for...

text.zh: 冷静一些，现在还没到慌的时候，我记得…以前听过的故事里，只要找到出口，就能从「影子的世界」逃脱。
text.en: Hold it together. Let's not get ahead of ourselves. I heard a story once about the "World of Shadows"... If it's true, there's a way to escape. We just need to find the exit.

text.zh: 我们先往前看看吧！
text.en: C'mon. Let's explore.

title.en: Examine your surroundings within the Shadow Realm

text.zh: 等等，那个蓝色一团是…是「眼镜」？
text.en: Wait, what's that blue thing? Is that... Goggles?

text.zh: 看来我们得先想办法过去。
text.en: Guess we'd better find a way over.

title.en: Meet up with the Eye of Graeae

text.zh: 眼镜！
text.en: Goggles!

text.zh: 您好，看到三位平安无事真是太好了。
text.en: Hello. I am glad to see the three of you safe and sound.

text.zh: 只是现在的局面可不太好。
text.en: For now, at least. But things aren't looking too good.

text.zh: 是的，这个区域名叫「影域」，本该是至高的视线亦不愿投入，壳中至暗的空间。
text.en: Correct. We are now inside what is known as the Shadow Realm — the darkest space in the shell, where even the most high is loath to cast its gaze.

text.zh: 在此处时间与空间都没有意义，只是似浮出水面的气泡一样偶尔与光界的世界交叠。
text.en: Time and space hold no meaning here. It intersects with the world of the Light Realm only rarely, like an air bubble that rises to the water's surface.

text.zh: 我们得在这个空间重新沉入水底前从这里离开。
text.en: We must leave this place before it sinks back down into the depths once more.

text.zh: 听上去你有办法？
text.en: Sounds like you have a plan.

text.zh: …是的，也许我被制造出来原本就是为了…从影域中…
text.en: ...Yes. In fact, the very purpose of my creation was likely to... ... ...from the Shadow Realm.

text.zh: 似乎无法访问相关的数据，不过现在也不是尝试访问的时机。
text.en: ...It appears that key data is currently inaccessible. But now is not the time to resolve that problem.

text.zh: #此处影域的出口已为您标记，以及，{NICKNAME}，在影域中穿行的装备已为您准备…
text.en: #I have marked the exit to the Shadow Realm for your convenience. In addition, I have prepared some equipment to aid you as you traverse the Shadow Realm, {NICKNAME}...

text.zh: 在影域中穿行的装备？
text.en: There's specialist equipment for this?

text.zh: 你怎么会有这样的东西？
text.en: How do you have that at the ready?

text.zh: 可能这是我原本就有的用处之一…已完成扫描，即将为您构造…
text.en: It may well be one of my core functions... Scan complete. Construction in progress...

text.zh: 启动密令：「我等昔日从阴影的残垣中窥得过往，此为黄金之城亥珀波瑞亚的遗余」。
text.en: Activation code: "We once peered into the past from the ruins of the shadows. This is what remains of the Golden City, Hyperborea."

text.zh: 哇！
text.en: Whoa!

text.zh: 「去吧，穿戴属灵的衣装与武具，攻破诸壁垒，灭尽一切恶者的箭火。」
text.en: "Now go, arm yourselves with weapons of the spirit, bring down the walls of the stronghold, and extinguish the flaming arrows of the wicked."

text.zh: 这是…这是一把枪？
text.en: Is this... a gun?

text.zh: 在「人」无法自如调用元素力的影域里…曾经有人经过了许多的尝试和研究，这就是最有效的攻击手段。
text.en: In the Shadow Realm, where humans cannot channel the elements... There once was one who, after much research and many attempts, found this to be the most effective means of attack.

text.zh: 出发吧，我们没有太多的时间了。
text.en: Let's go, we don't have much time.

text.zh: 在影域中穿行的装备？
text.en: There's specialist equipment for this?

text.zh: 你怎么会有这样的东西？
text.en: How do you have that at the ready?

text.zh: 检测到大量敌意单位的靠近…
text.en: Many hostile units approaching...

text.zh: 或许可以利用掩体进行战术调整，以逐个击破…
text.en: I suggest a new strategy: Take cover, and pick them off one by one.

text.zh: 唔，这下要怎么过去？
text.en: Huh, how do we get over there now?

text.zh: 推荐利用一下这个「钩镰炮」，这是本来用于在「影域」固定结构的机关。
text.en: I recommend using this Grappling Gun. Such devices were originally used to secure structures in the Shadow Realm.

text.zh: 拆卸掉与之相连的「钩」，「钩镰炮」就会自动发射长索到附近的另外的「钩」上…
text.en: If you detach the connected Hook, the Grappling Gun will automatically fire a rope to another nearby Hook...

text.zh: 嗯…总之，要把在这里的这个「钩」拆掉，对吧。
text.en: Kay... So we just remove this hook, right?

text.zh: 唔…总觉得周围是不是摇晃得有点厉害…
text.en: Huh? W—Why is everything shaking so much?

text.zh: 看来这边的影域马上就要…要「沉入水底」了。
text.en: Looks like the Shadow Realm is about to "sink back down into the depths."

text.zh: 出口就在这里…
text.en: The exit is right here...

text.zh: 出口就是这个，这个奇怪的气泡？…等等，呃，我们要怎么…
text.en: You mean this... this weird bubble thing? ...Wait, um, how exactly do we—

text.zh: 没时间犹豫了，这种时候就该直接上手…
text.en: No time to think — we just gotta go for it...

text.zh: 看来我…蒙对了！
text.en: Whew... Looks like I was right!

title.en: Tidy things up a bit at Rankova Zorya

text.zh: 影域居然直接出现在了铁轨上，这可是非常少见的情况…
text.en: I can't believe the Shadow Realm manifested right on the railroad tracks. It's almost unheard of...

text.zh: 多亏有你和那把神奇的枪，我们才能化险为夷。
text.en: Lucky we made it out. All thanks to you and that awesome gun.

text.zh: 你在影域里提到了亥珀波瑞亚…
text.en: While we were in there, you mentioned Hyperborea...

text.zh: 原来您也听过黄金之城的名号。
text.en: Ah, so you have heard of the Golden City before?

text.zh: 在挪德卡莱听过很多次了，没想到他们还留下了像你这么厉害的眼镜。
text.en: Yeah, it came up a whole bunch in Nod-Krai. You're a pretty neat surprise in that sense, aren't ya, Goggles? We had no idea they left cool gadgets like you behind.

text.zh: 这次多亏了「灰眸」帮忙。
text.en: Thanks for saving us again, Eye of Graeae.

text.zh: 准确说是合作，您第一次使用枪械就有如此出色的发挥，这也在我预期之外。
text.en: Make no mistake, it was a team effort. For a first-time firearm user, your performance was quite outstanding. Far beyond my expectations.

text.zh: 正如阿罗夏所说，影域通常不会在这种地方出现，但我们必须提防类似的情况。
text.en: As Alyosha said, it is highly unusual for the Shadow Realm to manifest in a place like this. But we should still watch out for similar dangers ahead.

text.zh: 不要啊，列车再出问题的话，我真的要有阴影了…
text.en: Let's hope not... If anything else goes wrong with this trip, Paimon's gonna have train-trauma for life...

text.zh: 也不一定是在列车上，影域可能出现在任何地方，我的建议是有备无患。
text.en: The Shadow Realm can appear anywhere, not just on the railroad. I am simply advising that we take sensible precautions.

text.zh: 如果您想调试与改造枪械，可以在那边进行操作，但前提是收集到合适的零件。
text.en: Now, if you wish to further calibrate and upgrade your firearm, you may do so over there, provided you have the necessary components.

text.zh: 现在请各位休息片刻，我将进行列车的框架修缮工作，这样派蒙也会温暖一些。
text.en: Please take a moment to catch your breath while I repair the body of the train. Amongst other things, this will ensure Paimon is a little warmer while onboard.

text.zh: 谢谢眼镜啦，你真可靠…呃，是否「可靠」先放在一边，至少很称职…
text.en: Thanks, Goggles! You're a trusty train conductor. ...Uh, well maybe "trusty" isn't quite the right word, considering... Anyway, at least you get the job done!

text.zh: 枪居然还能改造吗？
text.en: So the gun can be upgraded?

text.zh: 嗯，当然。正如「灰眸」，它一定会成为将来您在冒险中的好帮手…至少是「称职」的帮手！
text.en: Yes, of course. And just like the Eye of Graeae, I am sure it will be a great asset to you in your future adventures — if not the trustiest, then it will at least get the job done.

text.zh: 既然「灰眸」要修列车，我们出去透透气吧。
text.en: Let's get some fresh air while the Eye of Graeae fixes the train.

text.zh: 派蒙没问题吗？
text.en: Will you be okay, Paimon?

text.zh: 嗯，没事，我也想出去转转。影域里奇奇怪怪的，赶紧忘了最好。
