text.en: Yeah, sure. Paimon wants to forget all about the Shadow Realm — it was so creepy in there. Stretching our legs might help take our mind off things.

text.zh: 明明是车站，这附近居然没人住，全是废弃的房子…
text.en: It's so quiet here for a train station... Not a person in sight, just abandoned houses.

text.zh: 欸？！这哪里是修缮，简直就是换了一台车吧！
text.en: Huh!? So much for "repair"... You've swapped our train out for a whole new model!

text.zh: 原计划就是尽快恢复其在记录中的模样，修缮后的列车不仅优化了性能，还大幅提升了「潮流度」。
text.en: My plan was to restore the train to its original appearance per my records as quickly as possible. Now that the repairs are complete, the train offers optimized performance and a significantly improved "trendiness" level.

text.zh: 为什么把潮流说的像是一种数字…
text.en: Didn't know "trendiness" was a parameter...

text.zh: 根据演算，这是「灰眸」最有效率理解「潮流」这个概念的方式。
text.en: According to my calculations, parameterization is the most effective way for the Eye of Graeae to understand trendiness.

text.zh: （「亥珀波瑞亚」吗？好像在故事里听过…真是个不可思议的小东西…）
text.en: ("Hyperborea," huh? I'm sure I've heard of that in a story somewhere... What an incredible little gadget you are.)

description.zh: 脱离影域之后，你们在曙光车站稍作休整，打算驾驶列车前往至冬堡。
description.en: After you successfully escape the Shadow Realm, you rest for a while at Rankova Zorya and decide to drive your train to Snezhnograd.

title.en: Board the train and head for Snezhnograd

text.zh: <color=#37FFFF>强化「星锋剑」</color>
text.en: <color=#37FFFF>Enhance Exaiphanes Blade</color>

text.zh: 到了，这里就是至冬堡的列车站，也是境内最大的交通枢纽。
text.en: Here we are. Welcome to Snezhnograd train station — the biggest transport hub in the nation.

text.zh: 真气派啊！我感觉从左飞到右都要飞得气喘吁吁的…
text.en: Wow, it's so majestic! Just flying from one side to the other would probably leave Paimon out of breath...

text.zh: 呵呵，这是为了保证运输的效率，只不过换乘的时候确实有点辛苦。
text.en: Heh, it's built for maximum efficiency. But yes, transferring trains here can be a little tiring.

text.zh: 你们之后也可以借用这个车站去往至冬各处。现在跟我走吧，先把派蒙安顿下来。
text.en: In the future, you can use this train station to travel anywhere you want in Snezhnaya. For now, though, come with me. Let's get Paimon checked out.

text.zh: 走这边，有直接可以通往极星区的「升降厢车」。
text.en: This way. There's a lift car that goes straight to Zapolyarny.

text.zh: 哇，不愧是至冬堡啊…看到这么壮观的城市，感觉一路上吃的苦头都有回报了。
text.en: Wow, Snezhnograd is stunning... Seeing it with our own eyes makes all the trouble we went through to get here worth it.

text.zh: 我第一次来这里的时候也觉得很气派，只是后来发现，这里的东西不仅很漂亮，价格也高得不可思议。
text.en: I found it pretty stunning when I first came here, too. But I soon found out that stunningly beautiful means stunningly expensive... The prices here are crazy.

text.zh: 我做的只是不怎么起眼的猎货生意，所以大多时间都在炉灰区活动。
text.en: I'm just a small-time hunter, so Zolnyy is where I spend most of my time.

text.zh: 这个方向是「老庭院餐厅」，同时提供住宿服务，等会儿你们就在这里落脚吧，我会把医生叫过去。
text.en: This way will take us to Podvorye Restaurant. They offer food and lodging there, so you can get settled in while I fetch the doctor.

text.zh: 那…会不会也很贵…
text.en: Um... is that gonna be stunningly expensive too...?

text.zh: 不用担心。
text.en: Don't you worry about that.

text.zh: 暖和更重要。
text.en: Keeping you warm and comfortable is all that matters.

text.zh: 嗯，虽然炉灰区也有能住的地方，但估计带你们去看了，你们也不会满意的。
text.en: Yeah... I mean, there are places to stay in Zolnyy, but I highly doubt they'd meet your standards.

text.zh: 炉子里不一定有晶矿，窗户也漏风，晚上还会有「四脚的客人」来房间散步，用房梁或者地板磨磨牙齿。
text.en: Most of the stoves are out of Kristall, the windows are drafty... and at night, four-legged roommates come out to play, sharpening their claws on the roof beams and floorboards.

text.zh: 不不不，我害怕这个…住宿费我掏一半吧，我还有一点积蓄。
text.en: Yep, no way. Not a chance Paimon's staying anywhere like that... Maybe we can split the cost of the room between us? Paimon still has some savings left.

text.zh: 怎么和我客气起来了。
text.en: What happened to sponging off me? Come on, it's tradition.

text.zh: 哼，那你请我！我的钱拿去买小蛋糕…
text.en: Hmph, fine then! It's your treat! Paimon will save her money for buying a nice little cake...

text.zh: 放心啦，也会有你的一份。
text.en: ...Don't worry, you'll get some too.

text.zh: 看你精神起来，我也放心多了。
text.en: I'm glad to see you've perked up.

text.zh: 如果等会儿想逛逛的话，有几个可以去的地方。
text.en: If you find yourselves in the mood for some sightseeing later, there's a few places around here worth seeing.

text.zh: 这个方向通往女皇陛下的觐见室，也就是至冬宫，那里也是她的寝宫。
text.en: This way leads to Zapolyarny Palace, which serves as the Tsaritsa's audience chamber and also her personal quarters.

text.zh: 而侧边的建筑群，或者说一座小型的城中城，就是愚人众的总部「格鲁波夫」。
text.en: The adjacent block is kind of a city in its own right. That's Glupov, the headquarters of the Fatui.

text.zh: 这其中有座名为「军械宫」的兵工厂，源源不断地为愚人众生产各种装备，许多重要实验也在其内部进行。
text.en: Inside, there's a munitions factory known as the "Armory Palace" producing a constant supply of all kinds of equipment for the Fatui. A lot of important research happens there, too.

text.zh: 那边则是至冬皇都评议会，许多大人物会定期在那里召开会议，决定诸多国家级的事项。
text.en: And over there is the Snezhnograd Veche, where all the big shots meet regularly to make policy decisions.

text.zh: ——这几个地方只适合远观，相信我不用解释缘由了。
text.en: These places are best admired from a distance. I'm sure I don't need to explain why.

text.zh: 嗯，估计会有很严格的安保措施，我们也不想找麻烦。
text.en: Yeah, they probably have super strict security. We're not looking for trouble right now.

text.zh: 靠近极星区中心的位置是商业区，餐厅、书店、礼品店都分布在这里。
text.en: The downtown area is near the center of Zapolyarny. That's where you'll find the restaurants, bookstores, and gift shops.

text.zh: 比较知名的建筑还有北国银行，在这个方向。
text.en: Another place of interest is the Northland Bank, which is over this way.

text.zh: 相信你们还需要和冒险家协会接触，到这里来就可以了。
text.en: Oh, and I'm sure you'll want to make contact with the Adventurers' Guild at some point, right? That's right here.

text.zh: 哦，说到冒险，我们还经常会用到炼金术，合成台在什么地方啊？
text.en: Ooh, speaking of adventuring, we use alchemy quite a lot. D'you know where we can find a Crafting Bench?

text.zh: 嗯…至冬堡没有经营炼金术的店铺。据说是因为历史上的某些原因。
text.en: Um... No one practices alchemy in Snezhnograd, I'm afraid. Apparently, there's some historical reason for it.

text.zh: 那看来只能用车上那个了，唉，有点不方便呢。欸？但为什么车上就有呢，不都是至冬的东西…
text.en: Oh. We'll just have to use the one on the train, then... *sigh* Kinda inconvenient. ...Wait, how come there's one on the train if that's Snezhnayan too?

text.zh: 我也觉得奇怪…
text.en: Yeah, that's weird...

text.zh: 之后去了解下「历史原因」吧。
text.en: Maybe we can look into the "historical reasons" later.

text.zh: 嗯，这方面我也不太了解。但就算大家都不用炼金术，生活也没觉得有什么不方便。
text.en: Yeah, I dunno. Not my area of expertise. Still, I wouldn't say the absence of alchemy makes life here any less convenient.

text.zh: 最后，从那个方向可以前往炉灰区，炉灰区大多是居住建筑和工厂，有零星的店铺，有兴趣的话可以去看看。
text.en: Anyway — finally, there's Zolnyy in that direction. It's mostly residential buildings and factories, but there's a few shops too. Worth a look around if you're interested.

text.zh: 那么，我先去和医生朋友取得联络，你们快去办理入住吧。
text.en: That's about it. You guys go ahead and get checked in while I track down my doctor friend.

text.zh: 好的，谢谢你介绍。吹了一会儿冷风，我又有点头痛了。
text.en: Sounds good. Thanks for all the recommendations. It'll be good to get out of the cold wind — Paimon's starting to feel another headache coming on.

text.zh: 那赶紧走吧。
text.en: Let's get you inside.

text.zh: 嗯，「老庭院餐厅」就在这个方向。
text.en: Podvorye Restaurant is right this way.

text.zh: 不用担心。
text.en: Don't you worry about that.

text.zh: 暖和更重要。
text.en: Keeping you warm and comfortable is all that matters.

text.zh: 我也觉得奇怪…
text.en: Yeah, that's weird...

text.zh: 之后去了解下「历史原因」吧。
text.en: Maybe we can look into the "historical reasons" later.

text.zh: 办理好手续后，你和派蒙来到了住宿的房间里。
text.en: After checking in, you and Paimon arrive at your room.

text.zh: 一分钱一分货真是有道理，我喜欢这个房间！
text.en: Looks like you get what you pay for, huh! Paimon likes this room a lot!

text.zh: 身体好些了吗？
text.en: Feeling better now?

text.zh: 嗯，不冷了。你太照顾我了，让我觉得有点不好意思…
text.en: Yeah, much better now that we're out of the cold. Thanks for taking such good care of Paimon. Honestly, she feels kinda bad for throwing a wrench in the works...

text.zh: 要是像其他国家那样，现在我们一定展开调查和冒险了，现在却要在这里等医生。
text.en: If this were anywhere else, we'd be out investigating and adventuring by now. But instead, we're stuck here waiting for a doctor.

text.zh: 反正也没有什么要紧的事。
text.en: It's okay. We aren't under any time pressure.

text.zh: 早点养好，早点一起行动。
text.en: The sooner you recover, the sooner we can start exploring.

text.zh: 你说得对，不该逞强的时候就不能逞强。
text.en: ...You're right. No need to push ourselves too hard for no reason.

text.zh: 进城的路上遇到了这么多事，我们先整理一下信息吧，顺便可以想想接下来去干什么。
text.en: A lot happened on our way into the city. Let's review what we've learned so far and try to figure out what to do next.

text.zh: 最让人好奇的事，应该还是女皇想做什么吧…所有的疑问都是从这件事上长出来的。
text.en: Obviously, the million-Mora question is: "What is the Tsaritsa planning?" Everything else leads back to that.

text.zh: 这本来就是我们来至冬的目的。
text.en: Yeah, that was our main goal in coming to Snezhnaya.

text.zh: 嗯，你说得对。现在我们知道了，她这个计划不仅需要七颗神之心，还需要大量的能源。
text.en: Sure was. And so far, we've learned that in addition to the seven Gnoses, her plan also requires a ton of energy.

text.zh: 可是我们暂时见不到她，阿罗夏说，女皇去东边讨伐那个突然出现的魔物了。
text.en: But we won't get to see her anytime soon. Alyosha said that she went east to fight that big monster.

text.zh: 估计那个魔物也十分强大，不然没办法让至冬全境的暴风雪都变得如此严重。
text.en: It must be a pretty powerful one if it can blanket the whole of Snezhnaya in a snowstorm this awful.

text.zh: 这也是需要面对的威胁之一。
text.en: Mm-hmm. It's one of the threats we'll need to face, I think.

text.zh: 这么一想，我们现在缺少的，还是信息啊，那种不会在市面上流通的，只有身居要职的人知道的信息。
text.en: ...To be honest, what we're really lacking right now is information. The kind of information that only the higher-ups in the government would know, not "word-on-the-street" type of info.

text.zh: 我脑海中倒是浮现了好几个似乎能帮到我们的人，但…
text.en: Paimon can think of a few people who might be able to help us, but...

text.zh: 都是愚人众，对吧。
text.en: They're all Fatui.

text.zh: 嗯，离开挪德卡莱的时候，桑多涅就和我们说过，来到至冬之后需要注意我们彼此的立场问题。
text.en: Right. And when we left Nod-Krai, Sandrone specifically left a message reminding us which side we're on...

text.zh: 这种事关女皇大业的机密，他们应该是不会告诉我们的。
text.en: So it's unlikely they'd tell us anything confidential about the Tsaritsa's grand plan.

text.zh: 但还是有去问问的价值。
text.en: It's still worth asking.

text.zh: 知晓一些不涉及机密的事。
text.en: Maybe we can learn some non-confidential info.

text.zh: 也是啊，都到这里了，那个什么…格鲁波夫就在面前，不去白不去。
text.en: Yeah, fair point. Besides, that Glupov place is right nearby. We've got nothing to lose, so it'd be a waste not to go.

text.zh: 最愿意和我们沟通的人…大概是阿蕾奇诺，桑多涅…唔，或许还有达达利亚吧。
text.en: There's gotta be someone there willing to talk to us, right? Maybe Arlecchino or Sandrone... Hmm, or possibly Tartaglia.

text.zh: 但是我们的心机不太可能瞒得过阿蕾奇诺，桑多涅就更不用说了，注意立场的话就是她讲的…
text.en: But it's unlikely we could sweet-talk Arlecchino. Let alone Sandrone... she basically told us to stay in our lane already.

text.zh: 也挺久没见达达利亚了。
text.en: Well, it's been a while since we last saw Tartaglia.

text.zh: 确实，大概是自枫丹那件事之后吧。听说他也到挪德卡莱帮了忙，可惜没能见上一面。
text.en: Yeah, the last time was all the way back in Fontaine, right? Too bad we missed him in Nod-Krai. Apparently, he came to help out.

text.zh: #你好，是{NICKNAME}和派蒙住在这里吗？
text.en: #Hello, is there a {NICKNAME} and Paimon in there?

text.zh: 是阿罗夏的声音，请进！
text.en: That's Alyosha! Come in!

text.zh: 两位好，我是医生卢涅娃，听阿罗夏说这里有人水土不服，有些头晕。
text.en: Hello, I'm Doctor Luneva. Alyosha mentioned that one of you is feeling a little under the weather?

text.zh: 拜托你检查一下。
text.en: We'd be grateful if you could take a look at her.

text.zh: 好，就是这位患者吧，看上去是…妖精？
text.en: I see. So you're my patient today, yes? And you're a... fae, I presume?

text.zh: 不知道，我也说不清我是什么，但应该…和在车站见过的那些妖精不一样吧。这会有什么问题吗？
text.en: Good question... Paimon's not too sure either, but she's definitely not the same kind of fae as the ones we saw at the train station. ...Is that gonna be an issue?

text.zh: 嗯，怎么说呢，我们一般都只会遇到人类患者，妖精大多数比最健康和长寿的人类都硬朗得多呢。
text.en: Not exactly, it's just... I'm used to treating human patients. Fae tend to be far more resilient than even the healthiest and most long-lived of humans.

text.zh: 不过放心，我也有给妖精看病的经验，此外给猫猫狗狗做诊断的经验也有很多，可以说学得相当杂了，哈哈。
text.en: But don't worry, I do have some experience treating fae. I've even diagnosed plenty of cats and dogs in my time. Safe to say, I have a fairly eclectic range of expertise.

text.zh: 没事，我觉得我和人类没什么区别！
text.en: It'll be fine! Paimon's basically the same as a human.

text.zh: 对吧？你应该不觉得我和你有什么不一样吧？
text.en: Right? We're no different when it comes down to it, are we?

text.zh: 味觉不太一样。
text.en: Our taste in food is a little different.

text.zh: 这说明我比你更会吃，哼。
text.en: Hmph! That's just 'cause Paimon knows how to eat!

text.zh: 食欲不太一样。
text.en: The biggest difference is probably your appetite...

text.zh: 那是你吃得太少啦，你要是愿意多说点话，吃得也就多了。
text.en: More like you don't eat enough. The more talking you do, the more you need to eat.

text.zh: （这…没联系吧？）
text.en: (I'm not convinced by that logic...)

text.zh: 呵呵，那请坐到这里来吧。
text.en: Hehe. Now, please take a seat.

text.zh: 嗯，各种体征和检查数据都是正常的，我想没什么问题，很可能只是着凉了。
text.en: Okay, vital signs are good, test results are all within normal ranges... I don't think it's anything serious. More than likely, you've just caught a cold.

text.zh: 我给你开点药，只要好好休息一两天，应该就会有好转。这两天注意监控自己的体温。
text.en: I can give you some medicine to tide you over, but as long as you rest properly for the next couple of days, you should feel better. Make sure to keep an eye on your temperature, though.

text.zh: 假如长期低烧，或者不舒服的感觉没有改善，再来联系我。
text.en: If you find yourself with a persistent low-grade fever or if your symptoms don't improve, just contact me again.

text.zh: 看来不需要担心了。
text.en: Sounds like there's no cause for alarm.

text.zh: 嗯，先观察观察吧。
text.en: Yeah. Let's see how it goes over the next few days.

text.zh: 谢谢医生。
text.en: Thank you, Doctor.

text.zh: 不客气，应该做的，那我就先走了，还要去下个病人那里。
text.en: You're very welcome. Just doing my job. I'll leave you in peace now — time to visit my next patients.

text.zh: 请慢走。
text.en: Take care.

text.zh: 那我建议就听医生的话，在这里静养两天，先别到外面去走动了。
text.en: You heard the doctor. Best you rest up here for a couple days. No sightseeing for the time being.

text.zh: 我就在附近逛逛。
text.en: I'll stick to the local area, then.

text.zh: 不用担心。
text.en: Don't you worry about that.

text.zh: 嗯，好吧，只能这样了。就当是难得的休假吧！
text.en: Alright then, guess we've got no choice. Let's just treat it as a short vacation!

text.zh: 我也先回去了，如果之后找我有事，或者要再联络医生的话，来炉灰区的猎货贸易站，老板知道怎么联系我。
text.en: I have to get back to it. If you need anything else from the doctor or me, go to the Hunter Trade Station in Zolnyy. The boss there knows how to reach me.

text.zh: 谢谢你帮了这么多的忙。
text.en: Thanks for everything.

text.zh: 你在影域里可是救了我的命，小事一桩，应该的。回见。
text.en: Hey, no big deal. You saved my life in the Shadow Realm. This is the least I could do. See ya around.

text.zh: 反正也没有什么要紧的事。
text.en: It's okay. We aren't under any time pressure.

text.zh: 早点养好，早点一起行动。
text.en: The sooner you recover, the sooner we can start exploring.

text.zh: 但还是有去问问的价值。
text.en: It's still worth asking.

text.zh: 知晓一些不涉及机密的事。
text.en: Maybe we can learn some non-confidential info.

text.zh: 味觉不太一样。
text.en: Our taste in food is a little different.

text.zh: 食欲不太一样。
text.en: The biggest difference is probably your appetite...

text.zh: 我就在附近逛逛。
text.en: I'll stick to the local area, then.

text.zh: 不用担心。
text.en: Don't you worry about that.

title.en: Go to Glupov to see Childe

text.zh: 稍等，请您出示邀请函或通行证。
text.en: Hold on. Please display your invitation letter or permit.

text.zh: 我是来找人的。
text.en: I'm looking for someone.

text.zh: 能直接帮我传达一下吗？
text.en: Could you pass along the message?

text.zh: 格鲁波夫不接受未经预约的会面请求，还请按照公示的预约流程进行申请，等待邀请函的下达。
text.en: Glupov does not accept meeting requests without a prior appointment. You'll have to apply per the advertised booking process and wait until your invitation letter is issued.

text.zh: 我们算是老友会面。
text.en: But we're old friends.

text.zh: 对方会想要见我的。
text.en: I know they'll want to see me.

text.zh: …请问你想要拜访的是？
text.en: ...Might I ask who you're hoping to visit?

text.zh: 执行官「公子」，达达利亚。
text.en: Harbinger "Childe," Tartaglia.

text.zh: （怎么总是有这种不懂规矩，口气又大的人来闯，执行官大人哪有这么容易见…）
text.en: (Another one who thinks the rules don't apply to them... I don't understand why people think they can talk their way in here. You don't just show up and land a meeting with a Harbinger...)

text.zh: （哎，还得按制度敷衍一下，真是的，问了也是白问啊。）
text.en: (Ugh, but I have to go through the motions, for protocol's sake. Honestly, it's such a waste of time asking when I already know what the answer's gonna be.)

text.zh: 稍等，我去传达。倘若「公子」大人不方便见面，还请走正规的预约手续。
text.en: Wait a moment — I'll pass on your message. If Childe is unavailable, you'll have to go through the proper procedure.

text.zh: 在格鲁波夫门前与这位愚人众度过了一段稍显尴尬的等待时光，却始终不见达达利亚的身影。
text.en: After a slightly awkward wait outside Glupov with an unimpressed Fatui guard, there is still no sign of Tartaglia.

text.zh: 「公子」大人事务繁忙，估计此时不在格鲁波夫之内。我看也没有必要再等待下去了。
text.en: Lord Childe is a busy man. He's probably not in Glupov at present. If I were you, I'd cut your losses. No point waiting any longer.

text.zh: 好像确实不巧啊。
text.en: Guess I picked a bad time.

text.zh: 即便真的是老友会面，也请理解愚人众执行官公务繁忙，不会一直坐守格鲁波夫之中。
text.en: Even if you two are old friends as you claim, please understand that the Fatui Harbingers are often busy with their official duties. They tend not to stay at Glupov for extended periods.

text.zh: 遵守此地的规则，也是行你我之便…嗯？
text.en: Next time, stick to the rules. You'll make life easier for both of us... Hmm?

text.zh: 您好，「木偶」大人。
text.en: Greetings, Lady Marionette.

text.zh: 桑多涅？
text.en: Sandrone?

text.zh: #这位客人就由我来接待吧，{M#他}{F#她}第一次来至冬，不懂这里的规矩也情有可原。
text.en: #I'll take care of our guest here. It's {M#his}{F#her} first time in Snezhnaya, so it's no surprise that {M#he}{F#she} doesn't know the rules yet.

text.zh: 应该没有出言不逊，或者引起什么矛盾吧？
text.en: I trust no choice words have been exchanged? No misunderstandings I should be aware of?

text.zh: 报告「木偶」大人，并没有此类情况出现。
text.en: No, Lady Marionette. No incidents to report.

text.zh: （好险，好险…幸好没有显得不耐烦…）
text.en: (Phew, that was a close call... Good thing I played it cool...)

text.zh: 本就是我突然来访…
text.en: I'm the one who showed up unannounced...

text.zh: 这位先生已经足够通融了。
text.en: This gentleman has been very accommodating.

text.zh: 是嘛，那就好。嗯…等等，派蒙呢？
text.en: Is that right? Good to know. Hmm... wait, where's Paimon?

text.zh: 她有点水土不服。
text.en: She's a little under the weather.

text.zh: 正在「老庭院餐厅」休息。
text.en: She's recovering at Podvorye Restaurant.

text.zh: 她会水土不服？我还以为她随时随地都那么精神呢…
text.en: Under the weather? Huh, that's hard to imagine. She's always buzzing with energy...

text.zh: 不过的确，这里比挪德卡莱更冷一些，很多人到这里都需要适应。找医生了吗？我可以安排。
text.en: I take it she's still adapting to the climate? Happens to a lot of people. It's even colder here than in Nod-Krai. Has she seen a doctor? I can get you one if you need.

text.zh: 已经看过了，说应该没有大碍。
text.en: She's already seen a doctor. He said it's nothing serious.

text.zh: 休息两天再观察一下。
text.en: She just needs to rest for a couple of days.

text.zh: 那就行，假如后续有什么麻烦，联系我吧。
text.en: Alright then. Well, let me know if you run into any other problems.

text.zh: 难道你是专门出来见我的？
text.en: Did you come out here specifically to see me?

text.zh: #不然呢，我正好在点心时间，听说有个没预约的人在外面说{M#他}{F#她}和达达利亚是老友，要见他。
text.en: Why else? I was just about to sit down for some much-needed tea time when I heard that an old friend of Tartaglia's had shown up outside, no appointment, nothing.

text.zh: 要是一直等，等不到，那多可怜啊，我只好放下我没能品完的热茶，出来看看到底是哪位冒失的客人…
text.en: And, as obnoxious as it may be to show up uninvited at Glupov, I couldn't help but take pity on the poor soul who was waiting outside in vain. So, I had no choice but to abandon my freshly brewed, piping-hot tea and come to see this mystery guest for myself...

text.zh: 你早猜到了是我，对吧。
text.en: You already guessed it was me, didn't you?

text.zh: 哼，念我们在挪德卡莱合作过一段时间的情分上，我也不方便让你一直在外面吹冷风。
text.en: Hmph. Well, I felt our time working together in Nod-Krai warranted some courtesy. I couldn't exactly let you freeze to death out here in the wind.

text.zh: 很遗憾，我没办法邀请你进去，身为执行官要以身作则，不能坏了格鲁波夫的规矩。
text.en: Unfortunately, I can't invite you inside either. The rules of Glupov wouldn't allow it, and as a Harbinger, I have to lead by example.

text.zh: 但至冬堡和穷酸的那夏镇不同，「火炬书行」的茶点非常合我心意，我们可以到那里叙叙旧。
text.en: On the plus side, Snezhnograd actually has some class — unlike Nasha Town. Torchlight Books has a very nice selection of teas and cakes, so we can catch up there.

text.zh: 当然，是你请我。
text.en: Your treat, of course.

text.zh: 为什么？
text.en: What? Why?

text.zh: 为什么？你欠了我那杯热茶啊。
text.en: Because I already wasted one perfectly good cup of tea today. That's why.

text.zh: 我是来找人的。
text.en: I'm looking for someone.

text.zh: 能直接帮我传达一下吗？
text.en: Could you pass along the message?

text.zh: 我们算是老友会面。
text.en: But we're old friends.

text.zh: 对方会想要见我的。
text.en: I know they'll want to see me.

text.zh: 本就是我突然来访…
text.en: I'm the one who showed up unannounced...

text.zh: 这位先生已经足够通融了。
text.en: This gentleman has been very accommodating.

text.zh: 她有点水土不服。
text.en: She's a little under the weather.

text.zh: 正在「老庭院餐厅」休息。
text.en: She's recovering at Podvorye Restaurant.

text.zh: 已经看过了，说应该没有大碍。
text.en: She's already seen a doctor. He said it's nothing serious.

text.zh: 休息两天再观察一下。
text.en: She just needs to rest for a couple of days.

title.zh: 与木偶同行前往「火炬书行」
title.en: Go with Sandrone to Torchlight Books

text.zh: 我已经点好了，全都是我推荐的种类，没问题吧？我想你信得过我的品味。
text.en: I've ordered for the both of us. No objections, I assume? I'm sure you trust my taste.

text.zh: 交给你就好…
text.en: No problem...

text.zh: （其实只是你想吃吧…）
text.en: (Though I'm sure you mostly ordered for yourself...)

text.zh: 话归正题，我没猜错的话，你找达达利亚应该也没有什么要紧的事，只是想询问一些消息？
text.en: Okay, let's get down to business. I'm guessing you don't actually have any urgent business with Tartaglia, per se. You just want information, right?

text.zh: 嗯，是这样的…
text.en: Yup, you got it... But how's he doing, anyway?

text.zh: 他最近在忙什么？
text.en: What's he been up to lately?

text.zh: 猜猜看呢？
text.en: Wanna take a guess?

text.zh: 大概，又在忙着和谁约架？
text.en: Um... Has he been picking fights again?

text.zh: 呵呵，我就知道你会这么说，真是小瞧了「达达利亚议员」啊。
text.en: Heh, of course you'd say that. You shouldn't underestimate Councilor Tartaglia, you know...

text.zh: 议员？
text.en: "Councilor"?

text.zh: 皇都评议会这个组织，我想你多多少少也听过了，现在他正在筹备下一次议会召开时需要的材料。
text.en: That's right. I'm sure you've heard of the Snezhnograd Veche by now? Well, he's busy preparing some paperwork for their next meeting.

text.zh: 下一次议会，又要讨论严冬计划是否应该延期的问题，这已经成了近期议会上的绝对焦点。
text.en: They'll be discussing yet another extension to Project Stuzha. It's basically all anyone cares about in the Veche these days.

text.zh: 议员…一下子有点难接受…
text.en: Tartaglia, a councilor... Sorry, it's just a little hard to imagine...

text.zh: 和他给人的印象差距太远了。
text.en: He doesn't exactly strike me as pen-pusher.

text.zh: 是啊，他看上去就是个战斗狂，什么事都不会想太多，对吧？
text.en: Yeah, he's more of the "shoot first, ask questions later" sort, isn't he?

text.zh: ——起因还是「队长」卡皮塔诺，在前往纳塔之前，给「丑角」皮耶罗留下了一封内容详实的信件。
text.en: It all started with a very detailed letter that Capitano left for "The Jester," Pierro, before leaving for Natlan.

text.zh: 里面提及了所有部下的后续安排，而其中作为顶梁柱的那一批人，都被分配到了达达利亚的麾下。
text.en: In that letter, he detailed the future arrangements for his subordinates. All of his key people were reassigned to Tartaglia.

text.zh: 我想，在那个时候他就已经做好了永远离开的准备。只是直到纳塔的事件结束，皮耶罗才公开了信件。
text.en: I guess he'd already prepared to leave us for good all the way back then. But Pierro didn't reveal the contents of the letter until the events in Natlan had concluded.

text.zh: 为什么是达达利亚？
text.en: Why Tartaglia?

text.zh: 呵呵，你问这个问题的表情，和那时候的达达利亚一模一样，「为什么是我？」
text.en: Heh, that was his reaction, too. "Why me," with a bewildered look on his face.

text.zh: 在他眼中，卡皮塔诺惜字如金，不愿意道出心中所想，像是瞧不上他…
text.en: He'd always assumed Capitano looked down on him. He was a man who kept his thoughts to himself and barely spoke to him the whole time they'd known each other.

text.zh: 但以前卡皮塔诺来参加我茶会时，会时不时带上达达利亚。我们都能看出来，卡皮塔诺相当器重这个年轻人。
text.en: But he occasionally brought Tartaglia along to my tea parties back in the day. So to the rest of us, it was clear that Capitano had quite a lot of respect for his young comrade.

text.zh: 我们，指的是几位茶会的常客，阿蕾奇诺，罗莎琳，还有…算了，哥伦比娅大概不懂这种事，除外吧。
text.en: ...By "the rest of us," I mean my tea party regulars: Arlecchino, Rosalyne, and... actually, not Columbina. She was probably oblivious to it.

text.zh: 所以后来璃月的事情，卡皮塔诺很罕见地震怒…这个就不方便我来讲，有机会你直接问达达利亚吧。
text.en: Anyway, then the Liyue situation happened... Normally, it took a lot to get under Capitano's skin, but that time he was furious... It's not really my place to talk about it, though. You can ask Tartaglia about it sometime.

text.zh: 总之，达达利亚可能一直对卡皮塔诺留存着某种误会，直到皮耶罗拿出了这封留下来的信。
text.en: Basically, Tartaglia probably had the wrong idea about Capitano all along, right up until Pierro revealed the letter he'd left behind.

text.zh: 卡皮塔诺认为达达利亚尚不成熟，但有很强的潜力，并且拥有愚人众成员很稀缺的特质——纯粹。
text.en: Capitano believed that despite Tartaglia's immaturity, he showed great potential — plus, he possessed a kind of purity rarely seen among members of the Fatui.

text.zh: 这个确实…
text.en: That makes sense.

text.zh: 单论这一点，我觉得这两个人确有相似之处，不过卡皮塔诺会做出这样的托付，还有另一个原因。
text.en: Yeah, it's one of the few things that I'd agree those two have in common. But there's one other reason why Capitano chose Tartaglia to assume command of his troops.

text.zh: 他知道在他离开后，由他管理的武装部队会受到数个执行官的觊觎。
text.en: He knew that after he was gone, several of the others would swoop in on his army like vultures...

text.zh: 最直接的受益者，显然就是「公鸡」普契涅拉和「富人」潘塔罗涅。
text.en: With the ones who stood to benefit the most being "The Rooster," Pulcinella, and "Regrator," Pantalone.

text.zh: 在瓜分了武装部队之后，他们的势力会进一步壮大，而且再无敌手。
text.en: Once they'd divided Capitano's troops between them, they'd be more powerful than ever. No one would be able to stop them...

text.zh: 听到这里，你应该也能明白为什么卡皮塔诺选择将信件交给了皮耶罗吧？
text.en: ...So, you can see why Capitano chose to hand that letter to Pierro, right?

text.zh: 「丑角」需要制衡？
text.en: Because The Jester needs to maintain a balance of power?

text.zh: 没错，皮耶罗也需要尽快扶持一个执行官，综合考虑，达达利亚是最合适的人选。
text.en: Exactly. Pierro also needed to back a Harbinger as soon as possible. And all things considered, Tartaglia was the best choice.

text.zh: 虽然过去很长一段时间达达利亚背后站着的都是北国银行，但他和潘塔罗涅总归不是一路货色。
text.en: Even though Tartaglia has had the support of Northland Bank for a long time, he and Pantalone are ultimately not cut from the same cloth.

text.zh: 只能说卡皮塔诺确实没看错人啊，要是一般人遇到这种局面，可能只会觉得被架在火上烤了吧。
text.en: I'd say Capitano made a good judgment call. Anyone else caught in this situation would probably feel like they'd been hung out to dry.

text.zh: 拼命地撇清关系，继续维持与潘塔罗涅的「友谊」，同时争取普契涅拉的支持才是上上之举。
text.en: His best course of action will be to distance himself from any shady business while still maintaining friendly relations with Pantalone, but seeking Pulcinella's support at the same time.

text.zh: 和我讲这些内幕没问题吗？
text.en: Are you sure it's okay to tell me all this inside information?

text.zh: 呵，茶会就是因为这些「茶点」，才会更有滋味啊。
text.en: Heh, what's the point in having a tea party if you don't spill a little tea?

text.zh: 而且这算哪门子内幕，随便抓一个八卦记者，都比我讲得更绘声绘色。
text.en: Besides, none of this is confidential anyway. Ask any journalist out there — they'll give you all the lurid details.

text.zh: 只要去皇都评议会旁听一次，你就知道势力间的明刀暗枪，是怎么在那个小房间里上演的了。
text.en: You'll see it firsthand if you ever sit in on a session of the Snezhnograd Veche. All the factional strife, whether open or unspoken — it plays out for all to see in that one little room.

text.zh: 只有能在评议会说上话的人，才能将政策引导至有利于自己的方向，站在那里的每一个人，都是集体的缩影。
text.en: Having a voice in the Veche is the only way to steer policies in your favor. So, every person in that room represents a particular interest group.

text.zh: 用你知道的人来打比方吧，潘塔罗涅代表了金融行业，达达利亚代表了愚人众的士兵们…
text.en: Pantalone, for instance, represents the financial sector, and Tartaglia represents the Fatui soldiers.

text.zh: 我虽然对议会纷争不感兴趣，但手下总归还是有一批工程师和研究员，我需要传达他们的声音。
text.en: Personally, I have no interest in political jousting, but since I have a number of engineers and researchers under my command, I have to make their voices heard.

text.zh: 而站在评议会最中央的普契涅拉，代表的就是「政治」本身。
text.en: Then there's Pulcinella, the linchpin of the Veche. He represents "politics" itself.

text.zh: 一切都与他有关，什么都绕不过他，所有的问题，他都有调和的方案。这也是女皇陛下最看重的他的能力。
text.en: Everything involves him, so nothing can bypass him. Any issue that comes up, he knows how to mediate. That's what the Tsaritsa values most about him.

text.zh: 原来如此…
text.en: This explains a lot...

text.zh: （桑多涅这么一说，好像更能理解为什么大家对现状不太满意，却又没什么办法了…）
text.en: (I'm starting to see why everyone is so frustrated with the way things are, but also powerless to change it...)

text.zh: （各方利益错综复杂地交织在一起，最上面还坐着一个女皇陛下，实在是难以得出一个十全十美的方案。）
text.en: (A complex web of interests connects all parties involved, and the Tsaritsa sitting at the top adds another layer of complexity. It must be nearly impossible to come up with a perfect solution.)

text.zh: 我讲了这么多，是不是轮到你回答我的问题了？
text.en: Alright, I'm done carrying this conversation. Time for you to answer a question of mine.

text.zh: 既然你在我这里也能听到有价值的情报，为什么你第一个想见的不是我，而是达达利亚？
text.en: You must have known that you can get the info you needed from me. So why was Tartaglia the first person you asked to see, and not me?

text.zh: 怎么突然问这个？
text.en: What makes you ask that?

text.zh: 只是无法理解啊，好奇心需要被质疑吗？
text.en: I just don't understand, that's all. Anyway, do I really need a reason?

text.zh: 不会是嫉妒了吧？
text.en: You're not... jealous, are you?

text.zh: 啊？你在说什么胡话，怎么可能！
text.en: Huh? Jealous!? Pff. As if!

text.zh: 等等，我好像有点明白了…你从挪德卡莱出发的时候，哥伦比娅应该把我留下的话转告给你了吧？
text.en: Wait... Oh, I think I know what it is... Columbina passed on my message to you before you left Nod-Krai, right?

text.zh: 就是注意立场之类的话，你不会是在意那个所以没打算找我？
text.en: I only meant you should be mindful of which side you're on... Is that actually why you didn't ask for me? Because you took that to heart?

text.zh: 有这部分原因吧。
text.en: I guess that's part of the reason.

text.zh: 不然感觉会不太尊重你…
text.en: I wanted to make sure I wasn't being disrespectful...

text.zh: 你…！哎，算了，恐怕是我自己最近和政治家打太多交道，说话都变得绕弯子了。
text.en: You...! Ugh, fair enough, it's not your fault. I blame all these politicians I've been hanging around with lately. Always beating about the bush when they talk — I guess it must've rubbed off on me...

text.zh: 总之你我之间这点小忙还是能帮的，之后也别那么客气。
text.en: Anyway, just ask for my help next time, okay? Little things like this are no problem.

text.zh: 「木偶」大人。
text.en: Lady Marionette.

text.zh: 怎么了，现在是休息时间！提交文件的话放我桌上，我待会儿再看…
text.en: What now? Can't you see I'm on my break!? Whatever it is, just leave it on my desk! I'll look at it later...

text.zh: 抱歉，打扰「木偶」大人休息，但的确是紧急事态…
text.en: Sorry to disturb you during your break, Ma'am, but I'm afraid it's an emergency...

text.zh: 哎，紧急紧急，又是紧急，我说过修轨道和运冰块可算不上紧急…
text.en: Ugh, isn't it always? I've told you before: Fixing the tracks and transporting ice blocks does not constitute an emergency...

text.zh: 彩冰镇的设备急需维护，推测是大量积雪导致了设备长期超重。
text.en: The equipment in Svetloledovka is in urgent need of maintenance. With how the weather's been recently, we suspect that the cause is a buildup of snow, exceeding the maximum weight limit.

text.zh: 其中一台设备的支架已经断裂坠落，惊醒了沉睡的魔兽，很多采冰工人被它困在了附近的冰洞之中。
text.en: The supports on one of the machines broke and fell, awakening a dormant beast and leaving many of the ice miners trapped in a nearby ice cave.

text.zh: 奥黛塔的小队正巧在现场附近，已经参与救援，可是目前施救人数和工程师人数都严重不足。
text.en: Luckily, Odette's team was nearby and launched a rescue operation. But we're still facing a severe manpower shortage for both the rescue and engineering teams.

text.zh: #没办法，{NICKNAME}，看来我们的茶会必须到此为止了。工程师我一个就够。
text.en: I guess that's it, then. Our tea party will have to end here. I'm the only engineer you'll need.

text.zh: 我也想去…
text.en: I kinda wanna go with you...

text.zh: 但我答应了派蒙不去太远。
text.en: But I promised Paimon I wouldn't go too far.

text.zh: 你真想去？
text.en: Do you actually want to come with, or are you just saying that?

text.zh: 算是对你分享「茶点」的报答。
text.en: I owe you for the "tea" you shared with me.

text.zh: 我不想对危难坐视不管。
text.en: I can't just stand by when people are in danger.

text.zh: 呵，礼尚往来，算你有心。派蒙我叫两个人去照顾她，顺便告诉她你要出去一趟。事态紧急，她应该会理解的。
text.en: Hmph. Nice of you to return the favor... I'll have a couple of people look after Paimon. They can let her know that you had to step out for a while. Given how urgent this is, I'm sure she'll understand.

text.zh: 你经验丰富，实力非凡，实在想不到还有谁比你的帮助更加可靠了。
text.en: And honestly, I'd rather have your help than anyone else's. Between your skills and experience, you'd be reliable help.

text.zh: 嗯，谢谢你，就这样吧。
text.en: Great, thanks. Sounds like a plan.

text.zh: #那我们走吧。你带两个人去「老庭院餐厅」，盯好{M#他}{F#她}住的那间房，等我们回来。
text.en: #Then let's go. You, take two people to Podvorye Restaurant. Find {M#his}{F#her} room and watch it like a hawk until we get back.

text.zh: 要是派蒙有什么闪失，拿你们是问。
text.en: If anything happens to Paimon, you'll be answering to me.

text.zh: 收到，「木偶」大人！
text.en: Yes, Lady Marionette!

text.zh: 交给你就好…
text.en: No problem...

text.zh: （其实只是你想吃吧…）
text.en: (Though I'm sure you mostly ordered for yourself...)

text.zh: 嗯，是这样的…
text.en: Yup, you got it... But how's he doing, anyway?

text.zh: 他最近在忙什么？
text.en: What's he been up to lately?

text.zh: 议员…一下子有点难接受…
text.en: Tartaglia, a councilor... Sorry, it's just a little hard to imagine...

text.zh: 和他给人的印象差距太远了。
text.en: He doesn't exactly strike me as pen-pusher.

text.zh: 怎么突然问这个？
text.en: What makes you ask that?

text.zh: 不会是嫉妒了吧？
text.en: You're not... jealous, are you?

text.zh: 有这部分原因吧。
text.en: I guess that's part of the reason.

text.zh: 不然感觉会不太尊重你…
text.en: I wanted to make sure I wasn't being disrespectful...

text.zh: 我也想去…
text.en: I kinda wanna go with you...

text.zh: 但我答应了派蒙不去太远。
text.en: But I promised Paimon I wouldn't go too far.

text.zh: 算是对你分享「茶点」的报答。
text.en: I owe you for the "tea" you shared with me.

text.zh: 我不想对危难坐视不管。
text.en: I can't just stand by when people are in danger.

text.zh: 的确很危险啊，所幸现在坏掉的只有一台…
text.en: They weren't exaggerating — this is really dangerous. It's a good thing only one of them broke...

text.zh: 根据报告里的信息，现在被困者主要集中在那个方向。
text.en: From what I've been told, most of the trapped miners are over in that direction.

text.zh: 我去救人。
text.en: I'll go rescue them.

text.zh: 嗯，我去检查其他设备的情况，顺便疏散周围的人。
text.en: Yeah, you do that while I check the rest of the equipment. I'll evacuate the people around here as I go.

text.zh: 等下就在这里会合吧。
text.en: Meet me back here as soon as you're done.

title.zh: 前往事发现场解救被困者
title.en: Go to the scene of the incident and rescue the trapped people

text.zh: （应该…就在这里吧。）
text.en: (I have to be getting close...)

text.zh: 别再往里面走了。
text.en: Don't go any further.

text.zh: 现在有危险的魔物在活动，很危险，尽快离开这里。
text.en: It's too dangerous here. There's a highly aggressive monster on the prowl. You need to leave, now.

text.zh: 我是来救人的。
text.en: I'm here to help with the rescue effort.

text.zh: 跟桑多涅一起。
text.en: I'm with Sandrone.

text.zh: 原来是至冬堡派来的支援，我是奥黛塔，幸会。
text.en: Ah, I see — you're the backup from Snezhnograd. Well, I'm Odette. Good to meet you.

text.zh: （她就是奥黛塔，先行前来营救的愚人众成员…）
text.en: (Ah, so this is Odette. She was the first member of the Fatui on the scene...)

text.zh: 被困洞内的一共有五人，魔物类型未知，位置也未知。
text.en: There are five people trapped in the cave. Monster type is unknown, and so is its location.

text.zh: 走吧，时间宝贵。
text.en: Let's go, every second counts.

text.zh: 我是来救人的。
text.en: I'm here to help with the rescue effort.

text.zh: 跟桑多涅一起。
text.en: I'm with Sandrone.

text.zh: 谢谢你们来救我们，不然估计现在我们已经被吃掉了。
text.en: Thank you for saving us... We'd have been monster-fodder otherwise.

text.zh: 谢谢，谢谢…
text.en: Thank you, thank you...

text.zh: #不用客气，它应该不敢回来了，你们快从这个方向撤离吧，我和{M#他}{F#她}会留下来殿后。
text.en: #Welcome. You should be safe now. Follow this route out. {M#He}{F#She} and I will stay behind to watch the rear.

text.zh: 路上已经清理过了。
text.en: The path's been cleared.

text.zh: 都是安全的。
text.en: It's safe now.

text.zh: 谢谢，快，走吧，这边。
text.en: Thank you... C'mon, let's go. This way.

text.zh: 四处看了下，那个魔物应该是撤离了。
text.en: I've searched the area. Pretty sure the monster made a tactical retreat.

text.zh: 这里原本是它的巢穴？
text.en: Was this its lair?

text.zh: 嗯，有我们在，短时间不敢回来了。
text.en: Yeah, but with us here, it won't be coming back anytime soon.

text.zh: 别看它小小一只，这种魔物生性凶恶，普通人在它眼里都是食物…
text.en: It may be small, but don't be fooled — it's a ferocious beast. People are just food in its eyes...

text.zh: 幸好我们来得还不算晚。
text.en: It's lucky we got here when we did.

text.zh: 被困者已经撤离完毕了，我们也出去吧。
text.en: The trapped miners have been successfully evacuated. Time for us to leave.

text.zh: 等等，这个领域…好像有点特别。
text.en: Wait, this place... There's something unusual about it...

text.zh: （CS逃离冰洞）
text.en: (Cutscene, Escape from the ice cave)

text.zh: 逃离冰洞之后，魔物总算放弃了追击。救援顺利完成，你们也有惊无险地回到了彩冰镇…
text.en: After escaping the cave, the monster finally gives up the chase. With the rescue complete, you return safe and sound to Svetloledovka...

text.zh: 路上已经清理过了。
text.en: The path's been cleared.

text.zh: 都是安全的。
text.en: It's safe now.

text.zh: 人数没有问题，都救出来了。冰洞门口也放置了警告牌，避免有人再接近那里。
text.en: Everyone's accounted for — we managed to rescue them all. We also placed a sign at the entrance to the cave, warning people to stay away.

text.zh: 你的身手不错，还不知道你的名字。
text.en: ...You really held your own today. I... still don't know your name.

text.zh: #我叫{NICKNAME}，是个冒险家。
text.en: #It's {NICKNAME}. I'm an adventurer.

text.zh: 之前没有见过你，记下了。
text.en: Hmm. Don't think I've seen you before. I'll remember the name.

text.zh: 那…回见。
text.en: Alright then... see you around.

text.zh: 「木偶」大人您好。
text.en: Hello, Lady Marionette.

text.zh: 我听说了，救援很成功，交给你们果然是对的。
text.en: I hear the rescue operation was a great success. I knew I could count on you.

text.zh: 奥黛塔，你是过来演出的吗？
text.en: What brings you here, Odette? Here for a performance?

text.zh: 不，是愚人众的任务，正巧在附近，听见了倒塌的声响。
text.en: No, a Fatui mission. I happened to be nearby and heard the crash.

text.zh: 演出？
text.en: Performance?

text.zh: 看来她没有介绍过啊，呵呵，这位是至冬堡备受瞩目的首席芭蕾舞者。
text.en: She hasn't introduced herself, then. Hehe, Odette is the prima ballerina of Snezhnograd. She's quite the celebrity.

text.zh: 科洛列夫茨基剧团的两大明珠，就是指她，以及首席女高音沃雅妮莎。
text.en: If you ever hear people mention the "two crowning jewels of the Korolevskiy Troupe," they're talking about Odette and the prima donna, Vodyanitsa.

text.zh: 除此之外，奥黛塔还是非常有潜力的愚人众成员，目前最有希望继承「女士」这一头衔。
text.en: On top of that, Odette's also a rising Fatui star. It's looking likely she'll inherit the title of "The Fair Lady."

text.zh: 她曾经是罗莎琳最器重的部下之一，她的身手也基本是从罗莎琳那里学来的。
text.en: She learned all her combat skills from Rosalyne herself. Used to be one of her most valued subordinates, too.

text.zh: …「木偶」大人过奖。
text.en: ...You flatter me, Lady Marionette.

text.zh: （罗莎琳器重她，那我岂不是…算了，没必要主动提起这件事，感觉会有点尴尬。）
text.en: (If she's Rosalyne's protegee, that makes me... Never mind, there's no need to bring it up. No point making things awkward.)

text.zh: 怪、怪不得身手如此出色…
text.en: N—No wonder you're such a keen fighter...

text.zh: 「木偶」大人那边的进展如何？
text.en: How's progress on your end, Lady Marionette?

text.zh: 同样很完美，设备的加固已经完成了，没有普隆尼亚之后确实会多花一些时间，哼，不过结果是一样的。
text.en: Equally successful — I've finished reinforcing all the equipment. Took me a little longer without Pulonia's help... Hmph, but the outcome is the same, of course.

text.zh: 就算魔物引发的大雪再下三个月，这些设备都不会被压垮了。
text.en: Even if the heavy snowfall summoned by that monster lasts for another three months straight, this equipment won't give way.

text.zh: 既然圆满解决，我们也不必在风雪中逗留。
text.en: Alright — now that we're done here, it's time to get out of this blizzard.

text.zh: 这里的善后怎么办？
text.en: That's it? Isn't there more work to be done here?

text.zh: 至冬堡会派人来调查，再制定补偿方案…哎，这次估计要我来出事故报告了，毕竟和大型设备的故障有关。
text.en: Sure, but Snezhnograd will send someone to investigate and draw up a relief plan... Ugh, and I guess I'll have to write the incident report myself this time, since it involves a mechanical malfunction.

text.zh: 先过潘塔罗涅确定预算，再过普契涅拉敲定方案，等两边吵出一个都能接受的结果，就能实施…
text.en: First, Pantalone needs to approve the budget, then Pulcinella has to sign off on the plan. Once they've argued it out and reached a compromise, we can move forward...

text.zh: 大概是这么个流程，快可能半个月，慢要两个多月。
text.en: That's the rough process, anyway. Could take anywhere from a couple of weeks to a couple of months, depending on how smoothly it goes.

text.zh: 这段时间里他们只能等着？
text.en: And in the meantime, the people here just have to wait?

text.zh: 嗯，没办法，办公室里类似的报告堆得和山一样高了。
text.en: Yup. Nothing we can do about it. There's a whole stack of incident reports like this back at the office.

text.zh: （虽然现在雪变小了，但受到魔物的影响，不知何时又会下起来…）
text.en: (The snow has eased a little for now, but there's no telling when that will change with that monster still at large...)

text.zh: （缺少取暖的能源，补偿来得也很慢，虽然不是严重到致命的问题，但是…）
text.en: (Fuel for heating is in short supply, and relief is weeks away. There's no immediate threat to life, but still...)

text.zh: （总觉得现状不应该是这样的。）
text.en: (It just feels like there should be a better way.)

text.zh: 走吧，回至冬堡，别发愣了。
text.en: Hey, quit daydreaming. Let's get back to Snezhnograd.

text.zh: 嗯？这不是评议会的大红人，达达利亚议员吗？
text.en: Ah. Well, if it isn't Councilor Tartaglia. Mr. Big Shot himself.

text.zh: 呵呵，我刚从各位「精英名流」的质问中抽身，你就别揶揄我了。
text.en: Heh, go easy on me, alright? I'm still recovering from the interrogation the real big shots put me through.

text.zh: 哟，伙伴，好久不见。我知道你来找过我了，真是惊喜啊。
text.en: Hey, comrade. It's been too long! I heard you came looking for me earlier. Nicest surprise I've had in a while.

text.zh: 还有奥黛塔，你好啊，看来你们是一起从彩冰镇回来的。如何，解决了吗？
text.en: Good to see you too, Odette. I'm guessing you guys just got back from Svetloledovka? How'd it go? Crisis averted?

text.zh: 挺顺利的。
text.en: It went fine.

text.zh: 你那边呢？有什么比较特别的状况吗？
text.en: How about you? Any new developments?

text.zh: 还是老样子，反对「严冬计划」延续的声音不断抬头，老对策都快撑不住了。
text.en: Not really, same as ever. Growing opposition to Project Stuzha, and the usual rebuttals are starting to ring hollow.

text.zh: 模拟投票的结果非常不乐观，就连普契涅拉老爷子都很罕见地在座位上吹胡子。
text.en: The results of the mock vote were pretty dire. Pulcinella was fuming... I've never seen the old man so angry.

text.zh: 相当糟糕啊，他这个样子可不多见。
text.en: That's not good news... It takes a lot to rattle him.

text.zh: 是啊，想要压住这种势头，用些强硬的手段肯定是最简单的，可是…
text.en: Yeah. Obviously, if push comes to shove, there are ways to crack down on dissent, but...

text.zh: 抱歉，我有个无论如何都想问的问题，可能会有点不顾情面，可以说吗？
text.en: Sorry, I have to ask something. This is going to sound blunt, but may I?

text.zh: 哦？当然可以。
text.en: Huh? Of course, fire away.

text.zh: 听起来，你们还在苦恼如何应对这些反对「严冬计划」的声音。
text.en: It sounds to me like everyone's tearing their hair out trying to figure out how to deal with opposition to Project Stuzha.

text.zh: 究竟「严冬计划」是为了什么，才让你们两个人也不愿意站在至冬的普通人这一边？
text.en: But what exactly is this project's purpose? And how can it be so important that even people like you two refuse to stand up for the ordinary people of Snezhnaya?

text.zh: （不愧是我最欣赏的伙伴，真敢说啊，哈哈，有意思。）
text.en: (Haha. Interesting. I gotta hand it to you, comrade — you sure don't mince your words...)

text.zh: #（{M#他}{F#她}在说什么？！什么叫我不站在普通人这一边？！）
text.en: #(Excuse {M#him}{F#her}!? What does {M#he}{F#she} mean, refuse to stand up for ordinary people!?)

text.zh: #（{M#他}{F#她}…怎么敢这样对执行官说话？）
text.en: #(Oh my gosh... How does {M#he}{F#she} dare speak to the Harbingers like that?)

text.zh: 你这是在质问我们吗？
text.en: Are you interrogating us now?

text.zh: #别急，桑多涅，让我来解释吧，我能理解{M#他}{F#她}。
text.en: #It's okay, Sandrone. Let me explain. I think I understand where {M#he}{F#she}'s coming from.

text.zh: 如果可以，我现在就想站到你这一边。
text.en: ...If I could, I'd take your side right now.

text.zh: 事实上，我和你的立场非常接近，只差在评议会里直接投出反对票——那样的话，女皇陛下是不会放过我的。
text.en: In fact, my position's very similar to yours. I've only held back on casting a dissenting vote in the Veche because the Tsaritsa would never let me get away with it.

text.zh: 愚人众的武装部队成员很多都来自至冬堡之外的小城镇，我为他们发声，需要为他们负责。
text.en: Still, I have a responsibility to the Fatui armed forces, so I do what I can to make their voices heard. Most of them are just regular folks from small towns far from the capital.

text.zh: 而那些地方的状况，你应该也见过了。哦，对了，我来自海屑镇，那边的情况也不太好。
text.en: I'm sure you've seen how much those kinds of places are struggling right now. Oh, and for what it's worth, I'm from Morepesok myself. Things aren't going so swell there, either.

text.zh: 既然这样，我更好奇了。
text.en: Right, so this affects you directly. Hence my question.

text.zh: 女皇陛下正在为至冬人民谋划更长远更安全的未来，可能在你看来「严冬计划」确实引起了一些问题。
text.en: The Tsaritsa wants to create a better, safer future for the people of Snezhnaya, but she's thinking long-term. I don't doubt that from where you're standing, Project Stuzha seems to be creating all sorts of issues for everyone.

text.zh: 但和女皇期许的未来相比，目前的付出尚可接受——我知道这种话有点冷血，但很多事也不是这么非黑即白的。
text.en: But considering the Tsaritsa's vision for the future, these are sacrifices worth making. Sounds cold, I know. But I promise it's not as black-and-white as it seems.

text.zh: 即便我和桑多涅不能反对「严冬计划」，但我们在议会上，都在持续不断地提出质疑。
text.en: Maybe Sandrone and I can't oppose Project Stuzha outright, but we're constantly raising our concerns in Veche meetings.

text.zh: 就算不停止「严冬计划」，我们还有很多事可以尝试，我们在做，普契涅拉老爷子也在做。
text.en: And even though we can't put an end to it, there are plenty of other ways to make a difference. We're trying everything we can think of, and so is Pulcinella.

text.zh: 我尊重女皇陛下，信任他们的决策，但我同时也是深爱这片土地的普通人，我的家人也生活在这里。
text.en: I respect Her Majesty the Tsaritsa and trust her decisions. But at the end of the day, I'm still just a normal guy who cares deeply about my homeland... and my family, who all live here.

text.zh: 我绝不可能弃他们于不顾。
text.en: There's no way I would ever abandon them.

text.zh: 归根结底，引起评议会分歧的并不是私欲或恶意，大家都想要平稳顺利地度过这段时期。
text.en: As contentious as things can get within the Veche, there's no selfishness or malice behind it. Everyone wants to get through this period as smoothly as possible.

text.zh: 只是现状看来很难两全其美，所以很多时候我们都是在做两害取其轻的选择，难免看上去不太体面。
text.en: The issue is that there's no way of pleasing everyone under the present circumstances. Most of the time, we're trying to decide on the lesser of two evils, which obviously isn't a great look.

text.zh: 但这绝非代表我们在对女皇陛下献上愚忠，对至冬的现状充耳不闻——我们都已经在尽最大的努力了。
text.en: But that is not the same thing as being blindly loyal to the Tsaritsa. No one's got their head in the sand here. We're all well aware of the way things are — we're just doing our best to make it work.

text.zh: （听闻彩冰镇发生意外，桑多涅的救人之心非常急切。）
text.en: (In fairness to Sandrone, she rushed to Svetloledovka's aid the moment she heard that people were in danger.)

text.zh: （像达达利亚这样在过去只想要追求死斗的人，也承担起了议员的职责，在城里忙东忙西…）
text.en: (And even Tartaglia, who used to only care about the thrill of the fight, is clearly doing his best to rise to the demands of his new role as councilor...)

text.zh: 抱歉，问得有些冲动了。
text.en: Sorry, maybe my question was a bit rude.

text.zh: 但至于女皇究竟在做什么…
text.en: But I'd still like to know what exactly the Tsaritsa is up to...

text.zh: 这就不要为难我们了吧。我知道，无法理解女皇陛下的动机，就一定没办法支持她的立场。
text.en: Hey, come on. There's only so much we can say, so don't press us too hard. Look, I know how untenable the Tsaritsa's position looks if you don't understand her motives.

text.zh: 你或许已经知道，女皇陛下现在率军向东方出征，打算征讨那只让风雪骤然变强的魔物。
text.en: Maybe you've heard already, but she's currently leading her army on a campaign to the east to defeat the monster that's been causing these brutal blizzards.

text.zh: 一旦她将魔物斩落，眼前的能源危机就能缓和许多。
text.en: Striking that monster down will be a significant step in dealing with the present energy crisis.

text.zh: 即便她现在一心想要达成自己多年来的愿望，她还是分出了精力去讨伐这只强大的魔物。
text.en: As laser-focused as she is on realizing her lifelong ambitions, she's still putting time and energy into taking down this powerful monster.

text.zh: 假如在她的未来规划中，至冬与此地的人民无足轻重的话，她现在就没必要做这件事了，不是吗？
text.en: To me, that says a lot. If she thought Snezhnaya and its people didn't matter in the grand scheme of things, why would she waste her time on something like this?

text.zh: 有道理…
text.en: You have a point...

text.zh: 你现在能说会道了很多。
text.en: You've become quite the smooth talker.

text.zh: 哈哈，我刚刚说的句句由衷，可不是什么漂亮话，这种东西今天在评议会早就用得精光了。
text.en: Haha, thanks. I meant every word I said, though. I wasn't just trying to placate you — I've already done more than enough diplomacy for one day.

text.zh: 但我认为，这位冒险家的想法很值得肯定。
text.en: ...I still think this adventurer raises a very important point.

text.zh: 虽然两位执行官大人的态度很明确，但在评议会之中，还存在许多受困于立场之人，做出了违背本心的抉择。
text.en: Our two Harbingers have made their positions very clear. But there are many others in the Veche who must feel trapped and forced to vote against their conscience.

text.zh: 哪怕会冒犯到大人物，也愿意直言心中是非，我觉得是一种很珍贵的品行。
text.en: I think it's a very valuable quality to be willing to speak one's mind despite the risk of offending powerful figures.

text.zh: 我觉得更多是因为比较熟了吧…
text.en: It's mostly because we know each other quite well...

text.zh: 哼，是啊，要不是知根知底，对普通人，我们估计也不愿意解释这么多。
text.en: Hmph, you can say that again. I highly doubt we'd feel the need to explain ourselves so much if we didn't know you so well.

text.zh: 敢问这位冒险家，是否还有其他的身份？竟然能和两位执行官大人谈笑风生…
text.en: Forgive me, Adventurer, but might I be so bold as to ask about your background? How is it that you can converse so openly with two Harbingers?

text.zh: 这个…
text.en: Umm...

text.zh: 嗯，还没有介绍过吗？
text.en: Oh, haven't you been properly introduced?

text.zh: 这要怎么介绍啊…我又不是那种故意戳别人伤疤的人！
text.en: Easier said than done... I like to think I'm not the kind of person who goes around busting open people's old wounds!

text.zh: #之前只是知道了这位冒险家的名字，还没有详细了解过{M#他}{F#她}的事迹，怎么了吗？
text.en: #I've only learned {M#his}{F#her} name so far, no details of {M#his}{F#her} experiences. Is... something wrong?

text.zh: （完了，还是绕不开罗莎琳的话题吗…）
text.en: (Uh oh... is there no avoiding the subject of Rosalyne...?)

text.zh: 没有。哎，算了，估计也瞒不下去。
text.en: No, it's just... *sigh* Alright, I guess there's no getting around it.

text.zh: 这就是那位诸国知名的旅行者，帮蒙德解决了龙灾，又在璃月收拾了我引起的麻烦，然后在稻妻…
text.en: This is the world-renowned Traveler, who helped resolve the Stormterror threat in Mondstadt, cleaned up after the mess I made in Liyue... and then went to Inazuma, where...

text.zh: 参与了御前决斗，战胜了罗莎琳。
text.en: ...There was a duel before the throne, in which the Traveler defeated Rosalyne.

text.zh: 啊…
text.en: Oh...

text.zh: 抱歉，原以为你们两个不会有太多交流，我觉得没必要特地把这件事点出来…
text.en: I'm sorry, I didn't think you two would be seeing much of each other, so I figured it wasn't worth bringing up...

text.zh: 没关系的，已经是很久之前的事了…没关系的。
text.en: It's fine, it was a long time ago... It's fine.

text.zh: 我只是刚好想起来剧团接下来还要排练，抱歉，请允许我先行离开。
text.en: Sorry, I just remembered that we have a rehearsal coming up. Please excuse me, I should get going.

text.zh: 唉…
text.en: *sigh*

text.zh: 之前我和你介绍过吧，她是罗莎琳最器重的部下，但她们的关系并不好。
text.en: I've mentioned this to you before, remember? She was Rosalyne's most valued subordinate... but they didn't actually get along.

text.zh: 虽然罗莎琳就是个没什么朋友的人吧，但…一个人的死，总能化解大部分的矛盾。
text.en: Not that Rosalyne was really the type of person to make friends, but... death has a way of resolving a lot of conflicts.

text.zh: 不用有什么心理负担，就像她说的，已经是过去的事了。
text.en: Don't let it weigh on you. Like she said, it was a long time ago. It's in the past now.

text.zh: 奥黛塔和罗莎琳性格很不一样，给她一段时间吧，我觉得她会自己调整过来的。
text.en: Odette has a very different personality from Rosalyne. Give her some time. I'm sure she'll work through it.

text.zh: 嗯…
text.en: Hmm...

text.zh: 欸，对了伙伴，派蒙呢？没见到她啊。
text.en: Oh, by the way, where's Paimon? It's not like her to hide away.

text.zh: 生病了，正在「老庭院餐厅」休息，我们离开的时候我找了两个人去看护她。
text.en: She hasn't been feeling well, so she's resting at Podvorye Restaurant. I got a couple of my people to look after her while we were gone.

text.zh: 原来如此，真是不容易啊，让我想起了冬妮娅小时候，她也吹不得冷风，总是生病…
text.en: Oh, right. Sorry to hear that. Poor thing — reminds me of when Tonia was little. She really felt the cold back then, used to get ill all the time...

text.zh: 看她躺在床上咳嗽，我就觉得辛苦，不过她是个懂事的孩子，只要有人去看她，她就会笑，从来不抱怨。
text.en: I felt so bad for her, seeing her lying in bed, coughing... She was so mature for her age, though. Whenever someone came to visit her, she'd greet them with a smile and would never complain.

text.zh: 派蒙肯定也是个懂事的孩子，哈哈。
text.en: I'm sure Paimon's a good kid too, haha.

text.zh: 你现在人手紧缺对吧，我找两个身手好，又很可靠的部下来接班，保证派蒙能安全养病。
text.en: You're a little short on manpower, right? Lemme have a couple of my people take over for yours. I'll send my most capable and reliable — they'll make sure Paimon can recover in peace.

text.zh: 嗯，那就太好了，你的人更专业。
text.en: Well, that would be great. Your people are more qualified.

text.zh: 谢谢。
text.en: Thanks.

text.zh: 不用客气，你应该有想要做的事情吧，放心去做就好了。
text.en: Hey, don't mention it. I'm sure you have things to do. Hopefully this takes a load off your mind.

text.zh: 到时候可不要再说，我不愿意站在你这一边了，哈哈。
text.en: So no more accusing me of not being on your side, alright? Hahaha.

text.zh: 对了，我还想起来一件事…
text.en: One last thing... I just remembered something.

text.zh: 刚来至冬的时候见到了「丑角」。
text.en: So... I met The Jester when I first arrived in Snezhnaya.

text.zh: 原来你们见过了？
text.en: Already? That was quick...

text.zh: 他好像认识派蒙…
text.en: He seemed to know who Paimon was...

text.zh: 我想再见他一次问问清楚。
text.en: I want to see him again to clear things up.

text.zh: 这个嘛…「统括官」近期的行踪对我们都是保密的，没法帮你引荐。
text.en: Hmm... I'm afraid I can't help you there. Our director's recent movements are confidential — even we're not in the loop.

text.zh: 要不是你告诉我，我还以为他这些天都在格鲁波夫，没去过南方呢。
text.en: If you hadn't told me, I never would've known he'd gone south. I assumed he'd been in Glupov this whole time.

text.zh: 原来如此…知道了。
text.en: Oh, I see... Got it.

text.zh: 那我现在就去安排照顾派蒙的保镖，正好还有别的事要回格鲁波夫处理。
text.en: Well, I guess I'd better go sort out Paimon's security situation. I have some other work to catch up on at Glupov anyway.

text.zh: #我也是，得马上写事故报告了…那就在这里分别吧，{NICKNAME}。
text.en: Me too. I have an incident report to write up... Let's leave it there for now.

text.zh: 嗯，再见。
text.en: Sure thing. See you.

text.zh: （只能说大家都不容易。但达达利亚说得没错，我有想要做…并且应该去做的事。）
text.en: (I guess everyone's in a difficult position. But Tartaglia's right — I have things to do... things I want to do, and things I ought to do.)

text.zh: （对了，去问问阿罗夏，有没有能够帮到彩冰镇的办法吧。）
text.en: (...To start with, I should ask Alyosha if he knows any way to help Svetloledovka.)

text.zh: 抱歉，问得有些冲动了。
text.en: Sorry, maybe my question was a bit rude.

text.zh: 但至于女皇究竟在做什么…
text.en: But I'd still like to know what exactly the Tsaritsa is up to...

text.zh: 有道理…
text.en: You have a point...

text.zh: 你现在能说会道了很多。
text.en: You've become quite the smooth talker.

text.zh: 对了，我还想起来一件事…
text.en: One last thing... I just remembered something.

text.zh: 刚来至冬的时候见到了「丑角」。
text.en: So... I met The Jester when I first arrived in Snezhnaya.

text.zh: 他好像认识派蒙…
text.en: He seemed to know who Paimon was...

text.zh: 我想再见他一次问问清楚。
text.en: I want to see him again to clear things up.

text.zh: （奇怪了，这把剑好像自己在振动？）
text.en: (How strange... This sword seems to be vibrating of its own accord.)

text.zh: （距离七天神像越近，这种振动越明显，虽然也是肉眼无法分辨的程度…）
text.en: (It's a very faint vibration, but it's getting stronger as I get closer to the Statue of The Seven...)

text.zh: （难道这把剑和七天神像有什么关联吗？可是，就算触碰，也只是在振动而已…）
text.en: (Does this sword have some connection to the statue? But all it does is vibrate, even when I touch it...)

text.zh: （当时我是从一片特殊的领域中得到了这把剑，要不然，驱使冰元素的力量试试看？）
text.en: (That place I got this sword from was definitely out of the ordinary. Maybe I should try channeling the power of Cryo?)

title.en: Make contact with the Statue of The Seven

text.zh: （虽然不明白发生了什么，但总之这把剑的力量好像稍微变强了一点。）
text.en: (I don't really understand what just happened, but I'm pretty sure this sword just got a little more powerful.)

text.zh: （遇到其他七天神像的时候，再试试看吧。该去找阿罗夏了。）
text.en: (I'll have to try the same thing again when I come across another Statue of The Seven. In the meantime, I'd better go find Alyosha.)

title.en: Go to Zolnyy and meet Alyosha

text.zh: 你好，请问有什么需要吗？
text.en: Hello there, how can I help?

text.zh: 我是来找阿罗夏的。
text.en: I'm looking for Alyosha.

text.zh: 好的好的，你稍等，我现在联系他。
text.en: Ah, sure thing. Gimme a second, I'll go fetch him for ya.

text.zh: 见到阿罗夏后，你将彩冰镇发生的事，以及目前无人善后的困境告诉了他。
text.en: When Alyosha arrives, you tell him about what happened in Svetloledovka and the lack of emergency relief.

text.zh: 哎，这种事我有经验。虽然至冬堡的支援不会刻意拖延或克扣，但等待的这几天往往是最难熬的几天。
text.en: *sigh* It's a familiar story. I've had similar experiences. Although Snezhnograd doesn't deliberately delay or withhold relief, those first few days of waiting for help are always the hardest.

text.zh: 这就是核心的矛盾——如果紧急救援物资不能及时送到，那还谈什么「紧急」救援呢？
text.en: It's a fundamental contradiction: If emergency relief can't be delivered in time, what's the point in even calling it emergency relief?

text.zh: 你有什么办法吗？
text.en: So that's it? They'll just have to wait?

text.zh: 现在至冬全境能源都不够用。
text.en: Nowhere in Snezhnaya has enough energy right now.

text.zh: 唔，不一定，我想，凝露镇很可能会有克什尼克晶矿流向市场。
text.en: Hmm, not necessarily. I think there's a good chance that Kresnik Kristall from Sretomorozsk will start flowing into the market.

text.zh: 凝露镇？为什么？
text.en: Really? Why?

text.zh: 我们解决了凝露镇的能源问题，这就像是打开了先前一直封闭的水闸。
text.en: When we resolved Sretomorozsk's energy issue, it's like we opened the floodgates.

text.zh: 流向镇民的晶矿，是此前一直亏欠的份量，一时半会儿想用都用不完。
text.en: A huge backlog of Kristall is now available to the townspeople. There's no way they can use it up at once.

text.zh: 虽然晶矿囤起来慢慢使用也没什么关系，能源价格看上去还会持续走高，但…总有别的急需用钱的情况。
text.en: A lot of them will probably stockpile it and slowly work their way through — probably a good idea, since energy prices are only gonna keep rising. But there'll always be people who urgently need Mora.

text.zh: 所以会流通到市场…
text.en: So they'll sell it to the highest bidder...

text.zh: 没错，目前的晶矿价格也足够普通人大赚一笔了。
text.en: Exactly. At the current prices, selling Kristall is an easy way for an ordinary person to make a fortune.

text.zh: 老板，我账面上的货款还有多少？
text.en: Hey Boss, how much do I have left in my account?

text.zh: 稍等啊，我看看，听你的意思，你是打算自掏腰包买晶矿？
text.en: One second, let me check... So you're planning on buying the Kristall out of your own pocket?

text.zh: 嗯，不一定够用，我打算再贴一些，能买多少算多少。
text.en: Yeah. I dunno if I have enough, so I'll chip in a little extra and buy as much as I can afford.

text.zh: 那这部分我来出吧。
text.en: Let me cover this.

text.zh: 不能让你一个人掏钱。
text.en: I can't let you pay for all of it yourself.

text.zh: 不用不用，你才刚到至冬这里，吃穿用度也得开销。待会儿这些矿石，还要借你的列车一用。
text.en: No, no, it's fine. You're new to Snezhnaya, and you have your own living expenses to worry about. Besides, you're already providing the train.

text.zh: 没关系，我自愿的。
text.en: It's okay, I volunteered for this.

text.zh: 来，钱都在这里，你们去市场看看吧，我猜晶矿也不会剩下太多。
text.en: Here's your mora. See what you can find at the market, but I doubt there'll be much Kristall left.

text.zh: 确实，先去看看吧。
text.en: Yeah. Well, can't hurt to take a look.

text.zh: 我看看…欸？
text.en: Let's see... Huh?

text.zh: 奥黛塔怎么在这里？
text.en: What's Odette doing here?

text.zh: 是阿罗夏，还有…
text.en: Oh, Alyosha and...

text.zh: 你、你好…
text.en: H—Hello...

text.zh: 你好。
text.en: Hello.

text.zh: 没想到你们认识啊。
text.en: I didn't realize you two knew each other.

text.zh: 我们一起在彩冰镇帮了忙。
text.en: We teamed up in Svetloledovka.

text.zh: 没想到你们也认识。
text.en: I also didn't realize that you two knew each other.

text.zh: 除了打猎的收入，我还在城里打些零工，比如去剧院干点清扫和运送道具的活计。因此，和大明星奥黛塔女士见过几次。
text.en: Yeah, I take on some odd jobs in the city to supplement my hunting income. Sometimes I work as a cleaner or prop hand at the theater, where Odette is one of the big stars, so I've met her a few times.

text.zh: 眼下这天寒地冻的日子，学会变通比四处找猎物更重要。
text.en: When the weather's as bad as this, it's better for a hunter to adapt than to keep looking for game.

text.zh: 嗯，我们人手有时候也不太够。
text.en: Yes, and we sometimes need extra help.

text.zh: （不是说彩冰镇那边挺顺利的吗？方才就感觉气氛有点尴尬…）
text.en: (Wait, why's the atmosphere so awkward? I thought things went pretty smoothly in Svetloledovka...)

text.zh: 奥黛塔女士是来挑选小道具的吗？
text.en: So, what brings you here, Miss Odette? Looking for some new props?

text.zh: 不是，回了剧院之后，脑海中依然会浮现彩冰镇的事，感觉心神不宁，没法集中在舞蹈上。
text.en: No. After I got back to the theater, I couldn't stop thinking about the situation in Svetloledovka. It bothered me so much, I couldn't focus on my dancing.

text.zh: 既然如此，就还是过来看看，有没有自己能做到的事。
text.en: So I decided I'd come here and see if there's anything I can do.

text.zh: 你也有点不甘心？
text.en: Couldn't let it go either?

text.zh: 嗯，你也是吗？怪不得你也会出现在这里。
text.en: Mm. You too, I presume? I suppose that's why you're here.

text.zh: 在执行官大人面前我不方便表达自己的态度…像我这样愚人众的普通成员，没法知道「严冬计划」所为何事…
text.en: I didn't feel comfortable expressing my true opinions in front of the Harbingers... Not least because ordinary Fatui like me don't even know what Project Stuzha is all about.

text.zh: 无法知晓就无法理解，无法理解，就不能放任自流。
text.en: Without knowing the full picture, I can't make sense of it. And at some point... if things aren't making sense to me, I can't just keep going along with it.

text.zh: 哎，这也是很多人现在的想法，想要帮忙，却有各种顾虑，所以才会有「呼啸社」这样的组织。
text.en: *sigh* So many people feel the same way. They wish they could do something, but all kinds of reservations hold them back. Explains why groups like the Rokot are springing up to fill the gap.

text.zh: 嗯，是种办法，但这样的组织也有别的风险，愚人众并不提倡。
text.en: Yes. Well, that's one option, but there are risks to consider with organizations like that. The Fatui does not encourage their activities.

text.zh: 容易失控，失控后难以追查，对吧…也是，已经听过几起事件了。
text.en: Right, 'cause things can get out of hand, and it's hard to hold the right people accountable when they do... I've heard about a few cases like that.

text.zh: （桑多涅说奥黛塔最有希望继任「女士」这一头衔，如果顺利继任，她就能知道「严冬计划」背后的东西…）
text.en: (Sandrone said Odette was on track to inherit the title of "The Fair Lady." If so, she'll be able to find out what Project Stuzha is really about...)

text.zh: （但…暂时还是别这么问吧，或许她另有苦衷。）
text.en: (Still... It's probably a little soon to ask her about that. There may be more to the story.)

text.zh: 在想什么？
text.en: What's on your mind?

text.zh: 没什么…只是突然发呆。
text.en: Nothing... I just spaced out for a moment.

text.zh: 我想，至少你我都认可，立场不应成为限制自身行为的理由。只要想做，总是有办法去做的。
text.en: I think we can both agree that, no matter which side you're on, it can't stop you from doing the right thing. Where there's a will, there's a way.

text.zh: 嗯。
text.en: Mm-hmm.

text.zh: 我知道罗莎琳在别的国家做了什么，你的判断也是正确的，不用放在心上。
text.en: I know what Rosalyne did while she was abroad. You made the right decision, so no hard feelings.

text.zh: 你们现在打算怎么做？
text.en: So. What's your plan?

text.zh: 啊，打算来这边采购一些晶矿，听说市场上现在有货。
text.en: Oh, we were gonna buy some Kristall. I heard there's some on the market right now.

text.zh: 巧了，我也是为了这个来的。既然这样，由我来出钱吧，我可以用任务预算的名义向上申报。
text.en: Funny — I had the same idea. In that case, let me pay. I can claim it back as mission expenses.

text.zh: 本质上这属于救援不及时才会出现的问题，让公家掏钱，比自掏腰包更合理对吧。
text.en: The real issue here is that government relief is behind schedule. Surely it makes more sense for the state to cover these costs than for us to pay out of our own pockets.

text.zh: 确实，这是一笔很高昂的支出。
text.en: True. It's a huge expense, after all.

text.zh: 谢谢你愿意帮忙。
text.en: Thanks for helping.

text.zh: 我看看…那就全要了，麻烦给我一份票据。
text.en: Let me see... I'll take it all, please. And I'll be needing a receipt.

text.zh: 对，申报的类型填任务预算，但是在说明里要写清楚是紧急救援，否则仅适用正常的报销额度。
text.en: Right. Choose "mission budget" under the expense category, but be sure to specify "emergency rescue operation" in the description. Otherwise, the normal reimbursement limit will apply.

text.zh: 那就安排这辆列车吧，按照规定「严冬计划」期间，如要运送克什尼克晶矿，可在发车一小时前增加车厢。
text.en: Let's book this train. Regulations say that if we need to transport Kresnik Kristall during Project Stuzha, extra carriages can be added one hour before departure.

text.zh: 这样应该就没问题了，列车会由愚人众的看守送往目的地。
text.en: That should do it. The train will be escorted to its destination by Fatui guards.

text.zh: 还是第一次见奥黛塔女士处理愚人众事务，没想到和舞台表演一样轻车熟路。
text.en: This is my first time seeing you handle Fatui affairs, Miss Odette. It seems you're as skilled an officer as you are a dancer.

text.zh: 过奖了，只是因为从小到大。我花在愚人众事务上的时间和跳舞一样多而已。
text.en: You flatter me. It's only because I've been doing both my whole life.

text.zh: 这下可以安心了。
text.en: Well, I'm glad we're in safe hands.

text.zh: 你应该在外面跑了一天对吧？派蒙呢，情况怎么样？
text.en: Anyway. I bet you've been non-stop today, am I right? Any idea how Paimon's doing?

text.zh: 太忙了，现在就回去看她。
text.en: I've had my hands full, but I'm gonna go back to check on her now.

text.zh: 怎么了，派蒙是谁？
text.en: What's wrong? Who's Paimon?

text.zh: #是{M#他}{F#她}的旅伴，刚来至冬着了凉，身体有些不舒服。
text.en: #{M#His}{F#Her} travel buddy. Hasn't been feeling well. She caught a cold right after they got to Snezhnaya.

text.zh: 她应该是你很重要的人吧…原来发生了这种事，你还愿意为了至冬人的问题忙东忙西…
text.en: Sounds like she's important to you... I... I can't believe you've been dealing with this on top of everything you've been doing to help the people of Snezhnaya...

text.zh: 不能装作视而不见吧。
text.en: I couldn't just turn a blind eye to their suffering.

text.zh: 派蒙也不希望我这样。
text.en: Paimon wouldn't want that either.

text.zh: 反正接下来我没什么事，我也去看看她吧，不知道她好点了没。
text.en: I've got nothing going on right now, so I'll join you. I wanna see how she's doing.

text.zh: 我也能去吗？正好之前在彩冰镇的时候，有人送了我一些糖果。如何缓解着凉的症状，我也有些心得。
text.en: May I come too? I have some candy that someone gave me back in Svetloledovka. Plus, I know a little bit about relieving cold symptoms.

text.zh: 好啊，她喜欢热闹。
text.en: Sure, she'll appreciate the company.

text.zh: 也很爱吃零食。
text.en: And she'll definitely enjoy the candy.

text.zh: 嗯，那就走吧。
text.en: Alright then. Let's go.

text.zh: （虽然不是很明白，但这两个人的隔阂好像已经消失了…应该是件好事吧。）
text.en: (I still don't know what the deal is between these two, but at least the tension seems to have vanished... A good sign, hopefully.)

text.zh: 你有什么办法吗？
text.en: So that's it? They'll just have to wait?

text.zh: 现在至冬全境能源都不够用。
text.en: Nowhere in Snezhnaya has enough energy right now.

text.zh: 那这部分我来出吧。
text.en: Let me cover this.

text.zh: 不能让你一个人掏钱。
text.en: I can't let you pay for all of it yourself.

text.zh: 我们一起在彩冰镇帮了忙。
text.en: We teamed up in Svetloledovka.

text.zh: 没想到你们也认识。
text.en: I also didn't realize that you two knew each other.

text.zh: 不能装作视而不见吧。
text.en: I couldn't just turn a blind eye to their suffering.

text.zh: 派蒙也不希望我这样。
text.en: Paimon wouldn't want that either.

text.zh: 好啊，她喜欢热闹。
text.en: Sure, she'll appreciate the company.

text.zh: 也很爱吃零食。
text.en: And she'll definitely enjoy the candy.

text.zh: 你好，不好意思，房间里有病人正在休息，请问有什么事吗？
text.en: Hello. Sorry, but there's a sick person recovering in this room. Can I help you?

text.zh: 什么情况？
text.en: What happened?

text.zh: 没事，不用紧张。
text.en: It's okay, no need to worry.

text.zh: 是达达利亚安排的人吗？
text.en: Are you one of Tartaglia's guys?

text.zh: #啊，抱歉，请问你就是{NICKNAME}吗？那能否出示一下冒险手册，「公子」大人说这能够验明身份。
text.en: #Oh, please excuse me — are you {NICKNAME}? Hmm. Could I take a quick look at your Adventurer Handbook? Master Childe said I should verify your identity.

text.zh: 给。
text.en: Here.

text.zh: 真的是您，失礼了，因为「公子」大人交代这个房间需要严加看守。
text.en: Ah, it's really you. Sorry for the inconvenience. We're under strict orders from Master Childe to keep this room well guarded.

text.zh: 同时我们也不能打扰「老庭院餐厅」的生意，那样反而会显得这个房间很蹊跷，引来不必要的注意。
text.en: At the same time, we can't interfere with Podvorye Restaurant's business. That would only seem all the more suspicious and draw unwanted attention to this room.

text.zh: 目前除了我以外，还有几位同事分散在餐厅内外，都穿便衣，请放心吧。
text.en: Besides myself, a few of my colleagues are stationed in and around the restaurant — in plain clothes, of course. Rest assured, you're in safe hands.

text.zh: 没想到居然有这么高规格的待遇。
text.en: I didn't expect such a high standard of protection.

text.zh: 因为是「公子」大人亲自委派的特殊任务，我们一定会履行好职责。
text.en: Well, Master Childe handpicked us for this special assignment. We're not about to let anything go wrong.

text.zh: 不多打扰了，请进吧。
text.en: Anyway, I won't keep you any longer. Please, head inside.

text.zh: #{NICKNAME}，阿罗夏！你们回来了！还有…这是新的伙伴吗？
text.en: #{NICKNAME}, Alyosha! You're back! ...Oh hey, who's our new friend?

text.zh: #嗯，我叫奥黛塔，今天和{M#他}{F#她}共同行动了一段时间。
text.en: #Hi, I'm Odette. {NICKNAME} and I crossed paths a few times.

text.zh: 是很可靠的愚人众成员。
text.en: She's a member of the Fatui, but she's solid. We can trust her.

text.zh: 原来是愚人众的人啊，你和这个组织真是有数不尽的缘分。
text.en: Another friend from the Fatui, huh? You're practically a member yourself by this point.

text.zh: 身体如何了？
text.en: Heh. How are you feeling?

text.zh: 我觉得正在好转，估计再过个几天就能一起行动了，那个医生判断很准！
text.en: Paimon's definitely on the mend! We should be back to our usual travels in a few days' time. Seems like that doctor was right!

text.zh: 只不过现在，嘿嘿…四肢还有一点点冷啦。
text.en: It's just, uh... Hehe... Paimon's limbs are still feeling a little chilly.

text.zh: 我有个好东西。
text.en: I have just the thing.

text.zh: 哇，这是什么？包在冰块里的…火焰？欸，这是真的冰吗？怎么都不会化的，火也能一直烧…
text.en: Whoa, what's this? Is that... a flame inside an ice cube? Wait, is this real ice? How's it not melting? And how does the fire keep on burning...

text.zh: 看来你的观察力挺敏锐的，你说的没错，这个叫「燃珀」。
text.en: All keen observations. You're right, this is called Cor Ignis.

text.zh: 以前我也有着凉的时候，把这个放在床头，就会好得很快。先借你用用吧。
text.en: Whenever I've caught a cold in the past, I've found I recover much more quickly if I place this by my bed. You're welcome to borrow it.

text.zh: 我明白！它感觉暖暖的，嘿嘿，真神奇…
text.en: Awesome! Wow, it's so nice and warm... Hehe, it's like magic...

text.zh: 欸，你叫奥黛塔对吧，你们是怎么认识的呀？
text.en: Um, your name was Odette, right? How did you two meet again?

text.zh: 看来她的精神是挺不错的，我放心了。
text.en: Looks like she's in pretty good spirits. That's a relief.

text.zh: 你要调查的事，有什么进展吗？
text.en: Any progress with your investigation yet?

text.zh: 没有…
text.en: Nope...

text.zh: 看来执行官这个方向是走不通了。
text.en: I couldn't get anything out of the Harbingers.

text.zh: 嗯，这应该在你的预期之内吧，他们不会透露多少风声。
text.en: Mm. No surprises there, I'm sure. They're not likely to let anything slip.

text.zh: 我想换个方向。
text.en: I need to try a different approach.

text.zh: 从你说的「呼啸社」入手。
text.en: I want to look into this "Rokot" organization.

text.zh: 「呼啸社」…
text.en: The Rokot, huh...

text.zh: 他们可能知道背后的秘密。
text.en: They might know what's really going on.

text.zh: 你知道应该怎么接触他们吗？
text.en: Do you know how I can contact them?

text.zh: …我想想。
text.en: Hmm... Let me think...

text.zh: 「呼啸社」的成员都会把真实身份隐藏起来，但…说不定我真能引荐给你一个人。
text.en: ...Members of the Rokot keep their true identities hidden, but... I think there might be someone I can introduce you to.

text.zh: 我先去准备，明天来科洛列夫茨基剧团吧，到时候告诉你结果。
text.en: Leave it with me. Meet me at the Korolevskiy Troupe tomorrow, and I'll tell you how it goes.

text.zh: 几位要喝些什么吗，我去吧台一趟。
text.en: Would anyone like a drink? I'm gonna head to the bar.

text.zh: 我要…呃，热牛奶吧，今天还是喝热的好啦。
text.en: Paimon will have, ummm... maybe some hot milk? Yeah, Paimon's in the mood for something warm.

text.zh: 你们两个不要说悄悄话啦，等会儿一起来讲故事，把今天遇到的事都讲给我听！
text.en: Enough with the secret chat, you two! Let's catch up properly in a minute — Paimon wants to know everything that's happened today!

text.zh: 好的好的。
text.en: Yes, Ma'am.

text.zh: 这就和「桌上剧团」差不多嘛，谁说听故事就不是一种冒险呢。
text.en: It'll be kinda like Tabletop Troupe. No reason why listening to a story can't be an adventure!

text.zh: 没事，不用紧张。
text.en: It's okay, no need to worry.

text.zh: 是达达利亚安排的人吗？
text.en: Are you one of Tartaglia's guys?

text.zh: 没有…
text.en: Nope...

text.zh: 看来执行官这个方向是走不通了。
text.en: I couldn't get anything out of the Harbingers.

text.zh: 我想换个方向。
text.en: I need to try a different approach.

text.zh: 从你说的「呼啸社」入手。
text.en: I want to look into this "Rokot" organization.

text.zh: 他们可能知道背后的秘密。
text.en: They might know what's really going on.

text.zh: 你知道应该怎么接触他们吗？
text.en: Do you know how I can contact them?

description.zh: 妥善解决彩冰镇的事件后，你对至冬的现状和「严冬计划」产生了越来越多的疑问。为了获得更多信息，你想要和神秘的「呼啸社」接触…
description.en: After settling the incident in Svetloledovka, your questions about the current situation and Project Stuzha only increase. To gain more intel, you decide to make contact with the mysterious Rokot...

title.zh: 前往「科洛列夫茨基剧院」

text.zh: 你来了啊，票我安排好了，「呼啸社」的事也已经准备妥当。
text.en: Ah, you made it. I've got some tickets, and I managed to set something up with the Rokot.

text.zh: 不过需要等到演出之后，应该没关系吧？我想你还没看过科洛列夫茨基剧团的节目。
text.en: It'll have to wait until after the show, though. Happy to stay and watch? I doubt you've seen the Korolevskiy Troupe on stage before.

text.zh: 当然没关系。
text.en: Of course, no problem!

text.zh: 谢谢你准备这么多。
text.en: Thank you for sorting everything out.

text.zh: 不用客气，来吧，从这边入场。
text.en: Pleasure. Here, this is the way in.

text.zh: 请配合剧院规章，接受例行检查，谢谢。
text.en: Please present yourself for a routine inspection in accordance with theater regulations. Thank you.

text.zh: （这个人…是愚人众吗？看样子，好像是在等什么…）
text.en: (Uhh... Is that guy with the Fatui? Looks like he's waiting for something...)

text.zh: 好的，检查完毕，感谢您的配合，请从这边入场。
text.en: Okay, all done. Thank you for your cooperation. Please proceed through to the theater.

text.zh: 怎么了吗？
text.en: What's up? Everything okay?

text.zh: 没想到看守会如此严格。
text.en: I wasn't expecting such strict security here...

text.zh: 至冬的许多富商政要都会在此出入，检查严格一点也很正常。
text.en: Snezhnaya's business and political leaders are always passing through here, so it makes sense that security's tight.

text.zh: 不过这次连愚人众的军械宫直卫部队都来了…看到了吧，最后面那个一直板着脸不说话的，他叫瓦列里。
text.en: Still, it's a little unusual to see the Fatui's Armory Palace guard here... You saw him, right? The guy right at the back — strong, silent type. His name's Valeriy.

text.zh: 他隶属于「特殊任务营」，但我每次见到他在这里只会干一件事，那就是找一个叫米提亚的人。
text.en: He's part of the Special Assignments Battalion, but I only ever see him here for one thing — to look for a guy named "Mitya."

text.zh: 那又是谁？
text.en: Mitya? Who's that?

text.zh: 好像是个研究员，但从来不安心待在办公室里，剧院是他最青睐的偷闲场所之一。
text.en: Supposedly a researcher, though he never seems to put much time in at the office. The theater is one of his favorite places to hang out when he's playing hooky from work.

text.zh: 不过这跟我们也没什么关系，走吧，演出就要开始了。
text.en: But that's not for us to worry about. Let's go, the show's about to start.

text.zh: 当然没关系。
text.en: Of course, no problem!

text.zh: 谢谢你准备这么多。
text.en: Thank you for sorting everything out.

text.zh: 怎么样，还算气派吧？
text.en: What do you think? Pretty impressive, huh?

text.zh: 让我想起了欧庇克莱歌剧院。
text.en: It reminds me of the Opera Epiclese.

text.zh: 哦，你是说枫丹的那个，名声很响，只是我还没见过长什么样。
text.en: Oh, the one in Fontaine? I hear it's iconic. Never seen it for myself, though.

text.zh: 就在这里，演出马上就开始了。不好意思，打扰一下。
text.en: Here we are, just in time. Sorry, coming through.

text.zh: 打扰了。
text.en: Excuse us.

text.zh: 哼，来晚了就别出声。
text.en: Hmph, if you're gonna show up late, keep your mouths shut.

text.zh: （这人怎么回事…算了，不跟他一般见识。）
text.en: (What's his problem!? ...Whatever, no point arguing with people like that.)

text.zh: 你看，来了，那个就是今天要引荐给你的人——剧团的首席歌唱家，沃雅妮莎女士。
text.en: Look, there she is. That's who I'm introducing you to later. She's the lead singer of the troupe, Vodyanitsa.

text.zh: 这里直通休息室，我已经联系过了，沃雅妮莎女士会在那边等我们。
text.en: This leads directly to the greenroom. They're expecting us. Vodyanitsa will be waiting for us there.

title.zh: 随阿罗夏前往演员休息室

text.zh: 你好，打扰了。
text.en: Hey there, excuse me.

text.zh: 哎，真是的，一肚子气。请进！
text.en: Ugh, can you believe it? I am so mad right now... Come in!

text.zh: 啊，居然是你们。
text.en: Oh... it's you two.

text.zh: 没想到会在这里见到。
text.en: I wasn't expecting to see you here.

text.zh: 嗯？你们认识啊？啊，不会就是你给我讲的，昨天让你印象深刻的那个人吧？
text.en: Huh? You know each other? Oh, wait. Is this who you were telling me about? The one you met yesterday and couldn't stop thinking about?

text.zh: 我没这么说过。
text.en: I never said that.

text.zh: 你怎么能突然不认账呢？在我抱怨那个阴沉的工厂长之前，你明明就…
text.en: Yes, you did! Why are you denying it? It was right before I went on that rant about the moody factory owner! Oh, I remember it so clearly...

text.zh: 请问两位到这里来有什么事吗？
text.en: Might I ask what brings you two here?

text.zh: #哦，本来是邀请{M#他}{F#她}来剧院看演出，演出之后{M#他}{F#她}很喜欢沃雅妮莎女士的表演。
text.en: #Oh, I just brought {M#him}{F#her} here to see the show, and when it finished, {M#he}{F#she} was full of praise for Vodyanitsa's performance.

text.zh: 就想看有没有机会能聊上两句，顺便要个签名…
text.en: So, I thought I'd try my luck, see if we could get the chance to chat for a bit... maybe get an autograph...

text.zh: 你在剧院工作，应该知道这是违反规章的，休息室不是用来做这种事的地方。
text.en: You work here... You of all people ought to know that's against the rules. It's not what the greenroom is there for.

text.zh: 有什么关系嘛，来来来，签名是吧，现在就可以，留影也可以哦。
text.en: Oh, what's the big deal? Come on, don't be shy. I can give you an autograph. You can take a picture too if you want.

text.zh: …你开心就好。
text.en: ...Do as you please.

text.zh: 我今天的演出全都结束了，你们慢聊。
text.en: I've finished all my shows for the day. I'll leave you to chat.

text.zh: 我可没有胡言乱语，奥黛塔只是好面子而已。
text.en: I wasn't making that stuff up, you know. Odette's just too proud to admit it.

text.zh: 她对你的评价高，我也一样，彩冰镇的事你做得很对。
text.en: She thinks very highly of you. And so do I. You did the right thing in Svetloledovka.

text.zh: 没问题，奥黛塔已经走远了，那我先把门锁上。
text.en: ...We're good. Odette's out of earshot — I'll lock the door.

text.zh: 怎么了？
text.en: What?

text.zh: 当然是因为「呼啸社」的事要严格保密。
text.en: Confidentiality, of course. The Rokot is very strict on that.

text.zh: 哇，阿罗夏你怎么就说出来了！这还有外人呢！
text.en: Whoa, Alyosha! Not out loud! Not with an outsider here!

text.zh: 别急，自然是有备而来，你看看这个。
text.en: Relax, I've taken care of it. Look at this.

text.zh: #是社长的回信，今天早上寄来的…批准加入，{M#他}{F#她}？！
text.en: #The president's reply, sent this morning... Wait, so... {M#he}{F#she}'s been approved to join!?

text.zh: 我？
text.en: ...As in, me?

text.zh: 昨晚你告诉我想要从「呼啸社」这边获得情报，很遗憾，「呼啸社」的所有情报都只在内部流通。
text.en: You told me last night that you wanted to get intel from the Rokot. Unfortunately, Rokot intel is only available to members.

text.zh: 但自从你踏入至冬我们就一起行动，你的做事风格，你的为人，你的动机，我都看在眼里。
text.en: But ever since you set foot in Snezhnaya, we've been working together. I've seen the way you work, your character, and your motives.

text.zh: 这些都和我们「呼啸社」想做的事非常契合，所以我就在想，干脆用一种更直接的方法…
text.en: Everything about you is perfectly in alignment with what we're trying to achieve in the Rokot. So I figured I might as well cut to the chase...

text.zh: 我写了封信，把你的情况详略得当地和社长说明了一下，他很快就回复并认可了。
text.en: I wrote a letter to the president explaining your situation, including just the right amount of detail. His approval came very quickly.

text.zh: 当然是否愿意加入，我们会尊重你的意愿。
text.en: Of course, it's still your decision whether you want to join or not. We'll respect your choice.

text.zh: 也就是说，你和沃雅妮莎…
text.en: So that means you and Vodyanitsa...

text.zh: 都是「呼啸社」的成员？
text.en: You're both members?

text.zh: 如果奥黛塔说的都是实话，她也没看走眼的话，确实不用担心你会暴露我们的身份…
text.en: Well, assuming Odette was telling the truth and she didn't misjudge you, I guess we don't need to worry about you blowing our cover...

text.zh: 吓了我一跳，原来找我是这么一回事啊。
text.en: Still, you gave me a real fright! I didn't know that's why you came looking for me.

text.zh: 所以…刚刚那些话只是因为奥黛塔在，说说而已的？其实你也没那么喜欢我唱的歌…
text.en: Hmm... So that stuff you said about admiring my performance... was that just because Odette was here? Did you actually mean it?

text.zh: 不不不，很喜欢。
text.en: No, no, I meant every word. I loved your singing.

text.zh: 嘿，我就说嘛，这才对。
text.en: Hehe, now you're talking! That's what I like to hear.

text.zh: 我还是为你简单介绍一下，之前提过，「呼啸社」是个隐藏身份秘密行动的组织。
text.en: Anyway, lemme give you a quick rundown of how things work. Like I said, the Rokot is a covert organization, and we hide our identities.

text.zh: 组织成员通常不会面，也不知道彼此的身份，具有高度的独立性和保密性。
text.en: Members typically don't meet in person or even know each other's identities. This helps us maintain a high level of independence and secrecy.

text.zh: 正因如此，只要行动结果不违反组织的原则，成员可以自由决定执行手段，不受任何约束。
text.en: Because of this, members are basically free to decide their methods without constraints, so long as the outcome of any activity doesn't violate the organization's principles.

text.zh: 毕竟，在明面上大家都没有任何联系，出了事也不会牵连到别人。
text.en: After all, we don't have any ostensible contact with each other. This way, if anything goes wrong, no one else will be implicated.
