text.zh: 有怎么做的自由，当然也有做与不做的自由，「呼啸社」也有相当部分的成员至今没有采取过任何行动。
text.en: Beyond the freedom to choose how you operate, it's also your choice whether to act at all. We have plenty of members who have yet to take any action.

text.zh: 所以加入这个组织本身，不会对你在至冬的行动产生任何限制。
text.en: In short, joining the Rokot in and of itself won't place any restrictions on your activity in Snezhnaya.

text.zh: 如果你有兴趣，也可以阅读所谓的组织原则，但只要你不打算借隐姓埋名之便去作恶，就没什么问题。
text.en: There's a code of conduct you can read if it interests you. But basically, as long as you don't plan on using your anonymity to go around doing evil, you'll be fine.

text.zh: 我试过五六次了…一次都没读完过，比三流作家写的剧本还要无聊。
text.en: I tried reading it five or six times... never made it all the way through. Even the most lackluster script makes for more interesting reading.

text.zh: 听上去还不错。
text.en: Sounds good to me.

text.zh: 我答应了。
text.en: I'm in.

text.zh: 好的，那我去准备正式的申请表。稍等一下。
text.en: Great. Then, I'll go grab an official application form. Be right back.

text.zh: 既然身份互相保密…
text.en: Since you keep your identities secret...

text.zh: 为什么你们知道彼此？
text.en: How come you two know each other?

text.zh: 这个嘛，阿罗夏养了条狗，你知道吗？就是图加林。有次阿罗夏把它带到了剧院的后台来。
text.en: Hah... Well, Alyosha has this pet dog, you see. His name's Tugarin, and this one time, Alyosha brought him backstage.

text.zh: 图加林好像很喜欢我，我就陪它玩了会儿，还给它吃了点肉。
text.en: Tugarin took quite a liking to me, so I played with him for a little bit and fed him some treats.

text.zh: 结果有次「呼啸社」在行动的时候，虽然我们都有伪装，但图加林一下子就把我认出来了。
text.en: Then, the Rokot was out on a mission one day, and even though we were all in disguise, Tugarin recognized me right away.

text.zh: 算是巧合吧，但这件事我们没有往上汇报，为了不处理一系列衍生出来的麻烦事。
text.en: Just a coincidence, really. We didn't report it to the higher-ups, though, to avoid dealing with the fallout.

text.zh: 比如…哎，为了生计，我还是很需要剧院这份工作的。
text.en: Like... *sigh* my job at the theater, for instance. I really need it to make ends meet.

text.zh: 对了，来的时候听你在抱怨，和楚古诺夫的接触还顺利吗？
text.en: By the way, what were you complaining about just before we came in? Did everything go okay with Chugunov?

text.zh: 顺利的话，我就不至于生那么大的气了。上台演出之前，我找他寒暄，想套些「伊泽卡设备制造厂」的情报。
text.en: Hmph, everything did not go okay. That's why I was so mad! I tried to make some small talk with him before I went on stage to fish for intel about the Iskra Manufacturing Plant.

text.zh: 结果他完全不上套，我怎么说，他就怎么躲。
text.en: But he wouldn't take the bait. No matter what I said, he kept dodging the question.

text.zh: 而且他的怨言也很大，问我平时都是包厢，为什么这次只安排了普通的座位，位置还不好…
text.en: And then he started complaining! He said he didn't appreciate his second-rate seat in the stalls because he usually gets a private box...

text.zh: 那不是理所当然的吗？想坐包厢就提前买票啊，提前一天才写信过来，票早就卖完了！
text.en: I mean, what did he expect? Everyone knows that if you want a box seat, you buy a ticket well in advance! But instead, he sends me a letter the day before the show, when we're practically sold out!

text.zh: 就连他那张票都是我好不容易协调出来的，就为了让他心情好点，结果还是什么都没告诉我。
text.en: I had to juggle things around just to get him a half-decent seat, hoping he would appreciate the gesture enough to share some information. But nope! He didn't give me anything!

text.zh: 谁知道真正接触之后，楚古诺夫会是这么一个人…
text.en: *sigh*... Yeah, meeting Chugunov in person has definitely been a disappointing experience...

text.zh: 啊，你应该还不知道是谁，就是今天坐你旁边的那个大叔。你对他印象应该也不好吧。
text.en: Oh, you probably don't know who we're talking about, do you? Chugunov was that older guy you were sitting next to today. I'm sure he didn't make a great first impression on you, either.

text.zh: 原来是他…
text.en: Oh. THAT guy...

text.zh: 嗯，很不友善。
text.en: Yeah. Seemed like a real grouch.

text.zh: 在市民的印象里，他是个热心又顾家的好老板。
text.en: To the citizenry, he's a family man and a kind boss.

text.zh: 但实际上我们接触下来，他根本分不清善意和权利，好像一切优待都是理所应当的。
text.en: But our interactions with him tell a very different story... It's one thing to ask for a favor, but he acts like it's his right. He always expects special treatment.

text.zh: 就拿票的事来说，我也给他安排过包厢，他非但不感激，这次还觉得是我亏待了他。
text.en: Take the ticket situation, for instance — I've actually gotten him a private box in the past. But not only was he not even grateful, now he's acting like I've sold him short this time!

text.zh: 还更别说他不付钱了，一次都不付，哼。
text.en: Not to mention that he's never paid for a single one of his tickets! Hmph.

text.zh: 确实挺过分的…
text.en: That's pretty outrageous...

text.zh: 顾家，顾家，那你倒是把妻子和女儿一起带来啊，一次都没见过。
text.en: And another thing! If he's such a big family man, why doesn't he bring his wife and daughter to see the show once in a while? I've never seen them here, not even once.

text.zh: 消消气，沃雅妮莎女士，既然软的不吃，那就来硬的。
text.en: Calm down, Vodyanitsa. If he won't do it the easy way, we'll have to try the hard way.

text.zh: 在那之前，申请表准备好了，你先填下这个吧。
text.en: But first things first — here's your application form. Go ahead and fill it out.

text.zh: 也就是说，你和沃雅妮莎…
text.en: So that means you and Vodyanitsa...

text.zh: 都是「呼啸社」的成员？
text.en: You're both members?

text.zh: 听上去还不错。
text.en: Sounds good to me.

text.zh: 我答应了。
text.en: I'm in.

text.zh: 既然身份互相保密…
text.en: Since you keep your identities secret...

text.zh: 为什么你们知道彼此？
text.en: How come you two know each other?

text.zh: 原来是他…
text.en: Oh. THAT guy...

text.zh: 嗯，很不友善。
text.en: Yeah. Seemed like a real grouch.

text.zh: 很好！那申请表我们就收下了。
text.en: Excellent! We'll hold onto this for you.

text.zh: 有些地方填得不是太合适，我稍微改改…总之，这份申请表我们收下了。
text.en: Uh... Hmm, looks like I'll need to make a few little tweaks here and there... But other than that, you're good to go. We'll hold onto this for you.

text.zh: 那现在我们就同为「呼啸社」成员了，我告诉你，那个楚古诺夫就是我们现阶段的行动目标。
text.en: Alright! Now that we're officially Rokot comrades, I can tell you... Chugunov is the target of our current operation.

text.zh: 之前「呼啸社」在伊泽卡设备制造厂进行了踩点调查，基本确定了他们存在严重的能耗超标情况。
text.en: Recently, we've done some recon work at the Iskra Manufacturing Plant, which pretty much confirmed that their energy consumption is way beyond the legal limit.

text.zh: 只要能找到直接证据，我们就能举报到评议会，要求工厂停产。
text.en: All we need now is some direct evidence to present to the Veche, so we can demand that they shut the plant down.

text.zh: 这样一来，克什尼克晶矿就能被分配到更需要它的地方去。
text.en: That way, the Kresnik Kristall can be allocated to where it's needed most.

text.zh: 本来我想在日常聊天中抓到漏洞，可是他嘴太严了，现在只好采取另一个办法。
text.en: I was hoping he might let slip during one of our chats, but he's too tight-lipped. We'll have to find another way.

text.zh: 我今晚约见了另一位剧院的常客，米提亚。
text.en: I'm meeting another regular theater-goer tonight. Mitya.

text.zh: 之前阿罗夏提到过这个名字。
text.en: Alyosha mentioned that name earlier.

text.zh: 啊，不过瓦列里也来了，应该是在找米提亚。那他今晚能不能赴约可能要打个问号了。
text.en: Ah... but Valeriy's here too, and he's probably looking for Mitya. So he may end up being a no-show.

text.zh: 呵呵，放心吧，他要是没有躲开瓦列里的本事，就不可能每次演出都准时出现。
text.en: Hehe, don't you worry. He must know how to dodge Valeriy, or he wouldn't be showing up on time for every performance.

text.zh: 这个人是位著名的能源专家，虽然我们拿不到能耗超标的直接证据，但是我们可以把消息不经意间放给他。
text.en: Mitya is a renowned energy expert. Although we can't get any direct evidence of the excessive energy consumption at the plant, we can "accidentally" let the information slip to him.

text.zh: 如果能由他出面指出伊泽卡设备制造厂的问题，官方一定会重视并进行调查。
text.en: The authority should take someone like him seriously. So, if he starts raising questions about energy use at the Iskra Manufacturing Plant, there'll be a proper investigation.

text.zh: 我们不能去现场，但他有这个权限——所以我们只需要争取到他的合作就行了。
text.en: Also, we're not allowed on site, but he has clearance. So all we need is his cooperation.

text.zh: 能源专家是不是有可能…
text.en: Since he's an energy expert, does that mean...

text.zh: 知道「严冬计划」的内幕？
text.en: ...He might know the inside story of Project Stuzha?

text.zh: 对，这就是我们想弄清的另一件事…虽然相比起前一件事，这个的成功率就要低多了。
text.en: Yeah, so that's the other thing we're trying to figure out... though I think we're far less likely to make any progress on that front.

text.zh: 但据说米提亚的口风不是很严，说不定他一开心，就说漏了呢？
text.en: Still, I hear that Mitya is a bit of a chatterbox. So, who knows? Maybe if we catch him in the right mood, he'll let something slip.

text.zh: 怎么样，对你来说应该也是有价值的事吧？
text.en: What do you think? Sound like something worth your time?

text.zh: 嗯，一起去吧。
text.en: Definitely. I'd love to join you.

text.zh: 好，那你们就坐在附近假装用餐，帮我记录关键的信息。
text.en: Okay. In that case, you guys find a seat somewhere nearby, pretend you're a couple of buddies there to eat, and keep your ears peeled for useful information.

text.zh: 他是剧迷，不会防备我，但你们一定要伪装好。他要是发现你们，可能什么都不会说了。
text.en: He's a huge fan, so I doubt he'll have his guard up around me. But you two need to be convincing. If he suspects anything at all, he might stop talking.

text.zh: 嗯，放心，我们也很熟了。
text.en: Sure. Don't worry, we'll make a believable pair of buddies.

text.zh: 就像和朋友聊天一样。
text.en: I'm sure we can manage a bit of friendly chit-chat.

text.zh: 没错，很好的状态！那帮我收拾好休息室里的杂物，我们就出发吧。
text.en: Perfect, you've sold me already! Now, help me tidy this room up a bit before we head out.

text.zh: 好，具体是哪些？
text.en: Okay, what needs tidying?

text.zh: 全部。
text.en: Everything.

text.zh: 能源专家是不是有可能…
text.en: Since he's an energy expert, does that mean...

text.zh: 知道「严冬计划」的内幕？
text.en: ...He might know the inside story of Project Stuzha?

text.zh: 我们都经常出入这里，应该不显眼。就坐这里吧。
text.en: We come here often, so we shouldn't stand out. Let's sit here.

text.zh: 接下来，就看沃雅妮莎女士怎么谈了。
text.en: Now, it's up to Vodyanitsa. Let's see how the conversation goes.

text.zh: 啊，这里这里！米提亚先生！
text.en: Ah, Mr. Mitya! Over here, over here!

text.zh: 路上稍微耽误了一下，抱歉，原本时间就不够用…
text.en: Ah, sorry, I got a little held up on my way here. Now we have even less time than we planned...

text.zh: 随便点一些你感兴趣的点心和饮品吧，我看看，按照我的设计…应该还剩下二十五分钟。
text.en: Go ahead and order some snacks and drinks — whatever you'd like. Let me see, according to my schedule... we still have twenty-five minutes left.

text.zh: 今天这么赶时间吗？原本也只是想随便聊聊，换一个时间充裕的下午也没关系。
text.en: Hmm, you're really pressed for time today, huh? I was imagining this would be a leisurely chat... If you'd prefer, we can always reschedule for another afternoon when you have more time.

text.zh: 呵呵，和首席歌唱家见面的机会非常宝贵，我可不想错过。
text.en: Hehe, no need. Getting to meet the lead singer is a very precious opportunity for me — I'm not about to pass it up.

text.zh: 你已邀请我数次，可惜日程总是凑不上，要是没抓住这个窗口，也不知何时才会再有。
text.en: I've already had to decline your invitations several times because our schedules rarely align. If I don't grab this chance while it's here, who knows when the next one will come around.

text.zh: 太客气了，能为我特地抽出时间。
text.en: Well, it's very kind of you to make time just for me.

text.zh: 他的围巾是怎么回事？
text.en: What's going on with his scarf?

text.zh: 就像是活物…
text.en: It's like it's alive...

text.zh: 我也不清楚，但在至冬这种神奇的东西很多，大家一般都见怪不怪。举例的话，「灰眸」与派蒙应该都算。
text.en: I'm not too sure, to be honest. But Snezhnaya's full of weird and wonderful things like that, so people tend not to bat an eye. I'm sure the same will go for the Eye of Graeae and Paimon.

text.zh: 四处行动倒是方便了。
text.en: That'll make getting around easier.

text.zh: 今天邀请你来喝茶聊天，是为了得到剧团拥趸的意见与反馈。
text.en: The reason I invited you out for tea and a chat today was to get some feedback from a true fan of the theater.

text.zh: 我很满意，真的。我觉得每次听你唱歌，都会有种全新的感受。
text.en: Well, I genuinely have nothing bad to say. No matter how many times I hear you sing, it never gets old. It always seems fresh and new somehow.

text.zh: 可能是听得多了，我能注意更多的细节，也可能是每次表演的时候你都有进步，演绎得更出色了。
text.en: Maybe it's because the more times I listen, the more details I notice. Or maybe you simply improve with every performance, delivering it better each time.

text.zh: 谢谢夸奖，可以举一些详细的例子吗？
text.en: Thank you, I'm delighted to hear that! Could you give me any specific examples?

text.zh: 嗯，就说今天那首「冰淞之下」吧…
text.en: Oh! Yeah, that, uh... the piece you sang today, for example. Uh, "Beneath the Frozen River"...?

text.zh: 怎么了？对于好的演出，就是要表达赞美啊。
text.en: Hey, what's with you? I'm just praising a good performance.

text.zh: 我原以为这是首冰冷与寂寞的歌曲。但听着听着，就会觉得这种「冷」传达的并不是虚无，最底层好像又生长出了一点点希望。
text.en: I always used to find that such a bleak and lonely song. But the more you listen, the more you realize that it's not as cold and nihilistic as it appears. When you really dig down into it, there's a certain level where you're surprised by the emergence of hope.

text.zh: 没想到你会听出这一层，很厉害。我也是和作曲家聊过之后，才尝试了这样的唱法。
text.en: Wow, I'm impressed. I didn't expect you to pick up on that. Actually, I only tried out that angle after talking with the composer.

text.zh: ——可是「冰淞之下」不在今天的节目单里。
text.en: ...Still, Beneath the Frozen River wasn't on today's program.

text.zh: 啊，是吗？！那可是名曲…每次都会有的。
text.en: Oh, really!? But it's a classic... You sing it every time...

text.zh: 大部分时间会有。
text.en: Almost every time.

text.zh: 啊…哈哈，那…那我们聊那一首，「随风飞翔」，歌剧「山与雀」里很经典的曲目。
text.en: Oh... haha, um... well then, let me say a few words about that other all-time classic, "Flying in the Wind" from "The Mountain Sparrow."

text.zh: 今天也没唱那一首，嗓子状态不太好，临时换掉了。
text.en: I didn't sing that one today either. My voice wasn't quite up to it, so I switched it out at the last minute.

text.zh: 呃这…怎么会…
text.en: Oh... but... uhh...

text.zh: 不好意思，米提亚先生，今天你在剧场的对吧？
text.en: Sorry, Mr. Mitya, but... You were at the theater today, yes?

text.zh: 当然在了，开场之前我不是还和剧团成员都打了招呼吗？你，还有奥黛塔她们。
text.en: Of course I was. Remember? I said hello to all the troupe members before the show started. You, Odette, and the others.

text.zh: 那奥黛塔今天演了什么？
text.en: So what did Odette sing today?

text.zh: 「雪翅雁的挽歌」，对了吧！
text.en: ..."Elegy of the Snow-Winged Goose," of course!

text.zh: 回答正确，原来如此，原来如此。
text.en: Correct. I see... I see.

text.zh: 原来只是觉得我的演唱无趣，所以一首也没有记住，看来下次需要减少几首歌呢。
text.en: You find my singing boring, don't you? That's why you don't remember a single song... Hmm. Looks like I'll need to cut a few from the program next time.

text.zh: 你误会了，真误会了！
text.en: No, that's not it! I swear!

text.zh: 算了，我老实说吧，对不起，你今天上台的时候我走神了。
text.en: Ah... Alright, I'll be straight with you. I'm sorry. My mind was wandering as you took the stage today.

text.zh: 我喜欢来剧团看演出的原因是，你们的表演精妙绝伦，引人思绪万千，所以总是能激发我的研究灵感。
text.en: I enjoy watching your shows because the exquisite performances stimulate the mind. It always sparks some inspiration for my research.

text.zh: 一旦手里的工作陷入僵局，我就会来剧院换换心情。
text.en: So, whenever I get stuck at work, I come to the theater for a change of pace.

text.zh: 今天奥黛塔那段「雪翅雁的挽歌」跳得实在太好了，我在想是不是因为她最近有了些新的感悟…
text.en: Odette's dance during the Elegy of the Snow-Winged Goose today was simply incredible. It got me wondering what she's been going through recently...

text.zh: 看到她极度悲伤，却又拒绝低头的样子，我一下子有了灵感，就开始在笔记本上涂写。
text.en: That look of sheer defiance in the face of utter tragedy... It was so inspiring, I started scribbling in my notebook right away.

text.zh: 虽然最后的进展不是很大吧，但还是有收获的。回过神来的时候，整场演出已经结束了…
text.en: Not that I made a ton of progress in the grand scheme of things, but I still think it was productive. By the time I snapped out of it, the entire show had finished...

text.zh: 所以我的歌全都没有用心听，对吧？
text.en: So what you're saying is, you didn't listen to my singing at all...?

text.zh: 我知道很多时候我享受的不是剧目本身，所以我也不知道这种态度，和错过了你的表演，哪个更失礼一点…
text.en: Unfortunately not... I'm sorry, I don't know which is more disrespectful: the fact that I don't always come for the show itself, or the fact that I missed your performance...

text.zh: （气氛好像不太好的样子…嗯？）
text.en: (Seems like things are getting a little awkward... Hmm?)

text.zh: 为什么你看上去很紧张？
text.en: You look nervous. What's up?

text.zh: 米提亚先生这可是正好踩到了沃雅妮莎女士的雷区上，她向来不喜欢不尊重她表演的人…
text.en: Mitya just stepped into a conversational minefield. If there's one thing Vodyanitsa doesn't like, it's people who show disrespect for her performance...

text.zh: 好不容易安排的会面，不会聊不下去了吧…
text.en: Ugh, this meeting was so hard to set up... Don't tell me it's already falling apart...

text.zh: 他的围巾是怎么回事？
text.en: What's going on with his scarf?

text.zh: 就像是活物…
text.en: It's like it's alive...
...Hmph.

text.zh: 没关系，我觉得这也算是…一种肯定，至少说明我们的表演，很…深入人心，对吧？
text.en: It's fine. I suppose this is... affirming in its own way. At least it shows that our performance really... touches people's hearts, right?

text.zh: 我觉得你不用介意，我也…不介意的哦。
text.en: Don't let it bother you. It... certainly doesn't bother me.

text.zh: 她居然控制住了…
text.en: She's showing a lot of restraint...

text.zh: 真不容易。
text.en: Must be tough.

text.zh: 关于你的喜爱，我会如实传达给奥黛塔的。
text.en: Well, I'll be sure to let Odette know how much you adored her performance.

text.zh: 别这么说啊，我也很喜欢你的表演，只是今天灵感造访得不是时候，平时我都听得很认真。
text.en: Please don't say that. I always love your performances too, it's just that inspiration struck at the wrong time today... I'm usually all ears.

text.zh: 我知道的，我能看出来，所以我才重视你的意见。
text.en: I know, I can tell. That's why I value your opinion.

text.zh: 我也不是那种容不得别人在我面前夸奖同事的人，当然不是了。
text.en: I'm sure some people can't stand it when others praise their coworkers right to their face, but not me. No sir.

text.zh: 好吧，但我还是要说句抱歉…
text.en: Fair enough. I still feel kinda bad, though...

text.zh: 比起这个，还是那些只为了附庸风雅的人更难交流，更让我反胃。
text.en: Ah, but you know what I really can't stand? People who only show up to the theater to pretend that they're cultured. Makes me sick to my stomach.

text.zh: 对对对，这样的人有很多，甚至还没有走出剧院，就已经忘记舞台上演过什么了。
text.en: Oh yeah, a hundred percent. There are too many of those people around. By the time they're walking out the door, they've forgotten all about the show.

text.zh: 怎么了，看你似乎充满怨念的样子。
text.en: W—What's wrong? You look furious...

text.zh: 不知道你听说过没有，伊泽卡设备制造厂的老板明明不是剧院的出资方，却总是要求和资方成员一样的特权。
text.en: I don't know if you've heard about the boss of the Iskra Manufacturing Plant... He isn't even a theater investor, but he always demands the same privileges as actual investors.

text.zh: 无条件的包厢票，上等的酒水…甚至还要点选指定曲目的权力。
text.en: Box tickets only, premium drinks... Even the right to request specific songs!

text.zh: 不愧是沃雅妮莎女士，居然借着刚刚的情绪，把话题引入了正轨…
text.en: Well played, Vodyanitsa... seems like she's harnessing her rage to steer the conversation back on track...

text.zh: 你这么一说，我接触过那个人，怎么说呢…虽然大家说他是善良企业家的代表，但从他的身上真的感受不到。
text.en: Now that you mention it, I've interacted with that guy before. I gotta say... everyone holds him up as an example of a benevolent businessman, but... I dunno. I don't see it.

text.zh: 是啊，完全就不在乎舞台上在演什么，只是想彰显自己的社会地位罢了，而我必须为这样的人准备节目单。
text.en: Yeah, he couldn't care less about what's happening onstage. He's just there to flaunt his social status. I hate that I have to prepare programs for guys like that.

text.zh: 他经营的工厂真的就这么厉害吗？稍微打听了一下，就有好多负面消息，简直就是个黑心资本家。
text.en: What's the big deal with that factory he runs, anyway? I asked around a bit and heard some pretty shocking stories. Sounds like he's just another greedy capitalist.

text.zh: 居然是这样吗？
text.en: Oh, really?

text.zh: 嗯！有各种传闻，工资低不说，工时还长得要命，设备彻夜运转…他还明令禁止员工接受任何形式的采访。
text.en: Yep! The things people are saying are pretty damning. Low wages, insanely long working hours, equipment running around the clock... And as if that's not bad enough, he also strictly forbids his employees from giving any kind of interview.

text.zh: 「严冬计划」延期一次又一次，生活用的晶矿捉襟见肘，他却连这部分都想要染指，用于提升自己的利润…
text.en: Project Stuzha has now been extended so many times, we're at the point where Kristall rations for the common folk are barely enough to survive on. Yet he even wants to get his greedy hands on them, just to boost his own profits...

text.zh: 要是这些传闻属实的话，已经是严重违规了。
text.en: If the rumors are true, he's in serious violation of the law.

text.zh: 这样啊，原来你也听说了。
text.en: Interesting. So you've heard about it too.

text.zh: 怎么，真的有这回事？
text.en: What? So it's really true?

text.zh: 哈哈，没有，我也只是听了些传闻，但好像这不是凭空杜撰啊。
text.en: Haha, who knows? I've only heard the same rumors you have. But there's no smoke without fire.

text.zh: 「公鸡」大人最近给了很大压力，要求审核每一笔晶矿的流向，能源部门的同事为此焦头烂额…
text.en: The Rooster's been coming down on us hard lately, demanding that we track and trace every single batch of Kristall. My coworkers in the Department of Energy have been tearing their hair out over it...

text.zh: 居然是「公鸡」大人在关心吗？
text.en: The Rooster? I didn't realize he cared that much.

text.zh: 是啊，虽然晶矿是自由流通的资源，但如果放任有钱人无限采购，那被冻死的可都是穷人啊，这显然不公平。
text.en: Yeah. Even though there are no restrictions on Kristall trading, the poor will wind up freezing to death if we let the rich buy as much as they want. That's clearly unfair.

text.zh: 看来，调查伊泽卡设备制造厂这件事要尽快安排了。
text.en: Looks like we'll need to arrange an investigation into the Iskra Manufacturing Plant as soon as possible.

text.zh: 没想到沃雅妮莎女士还会关注这些剧院之外的事，真是心地善良。
text.en: I never knew you kept up with current affairs beyond the theater, Miss Vodyanitsa. You really have a heart for the common person.

text.zh: 大多数离群的妖精，对人类早就是漠不关心的态度了。
text.en: Most fae in your position have long been indifferent to the plight of humans.

text.zh: 既然还愿意生活在人类的城市中，就会关注世态的动荡，「公鸡」大人不也是妖精吗？
text.en: Well, those of us who choose to live in human cities are naturally going to pay attention to any significant upheaval. Isn't The Rooster a fae himself?

text.zh: 只是我也难以想象，像他这么有经验的人，也会因为「严冬计划」焦头烂额。这个计划到底是为了什么啊…
text.en: I'm just surprised to learn that even someone with as much experience as him is getting so stressed out over Project Stuzha. What is the end goal of this project, anyway...

text.zh: （好像终于要进入重点了…）
text.en: (This is it... We're finally going there...)

text.zh: 米提亚大概也能感觉到这是试探，但两个人谈话的状态很放松，说不定他会透露一些东西。
text.en: I'm sure Mitya can sense on some level that she's fishing for information. But since their conversation is so relaxed, he might just let something slip.

text.zh: 哎，我也焦头烂额啊，要是我的研究进展更快的话，严冬计划也不至于延续到今天了。
text.en: *sigh* It's stressing me out, too. If I'd only made better progress with my research, things wouldn't have dragged on this long.

text.zh: 原来和你的工作有关系？
text.en: Oh, so your work is related to Project Stuzha?

text.zh: 对啊，军械宫需要一种全新的能源，不是光界力，也不是元素力。
text.en: That's right. The Armory Palace needs a brand-new energy source — not the power of the Light Realm, and not elemental energy.

text.zh: 能满足这个要求的，目前也就是「星之楔」里蕴含的力量了。
text.en: Right now, the only thing that meets the requirements is the power contained within Stellar Linchpins.

text.zh: 从提取，到量化，再到试图转化，每一步都需要海量的克什尼克晶矿支持。
text.en: But harnessing that power is costly. Each step of the process requires enormous amounts of Kresnik Kristall, from extraction to quantification, to attempts at conversion.

text.zh: 研究举步维艰，随着研究推进，参与项目的人状态也越来越差，时常会处于恍惚的状态。
text.en: Progress has been painfully slow, and the team is getting burned out as time goes by. Sometimes I see people staring into space, as if in a trance...

text.zh: 会不会是因为能量本身就有副作用啊？
text.en: Could it be that this new energy source has side effects?

text.zh: 不是不是，对我们不会有影响，因为这能量是用来…
text.en: No, no. It doesn't affect us, because the energy is used for—

text.zh: 啊啊啊，知道了知道了，别勒我，咳咳…抱歉抱歉，这个不能讲。
text.en: Argh... Okay, okay, I got it! Stop choking me... Ahem... Sorry. I can't talk about that.

text.zh: 我想我们只是太累了，毕竟研究了很久，进展很缓慢，也难怪大家没办法振作吧。
text.en: I think we're all just... exhausted. We've been working ourselves to the bone for so long, with so little progress to show for it. It's no wonder people are struggling to stay motivated.

text.zh: 抱歉，之前还因为你没有认真听剧而生气。
text.en: ...Seems like I owe you an apology. I shouldn't have gotten so mad at you for not paying attention during the show.

text.zh: 哈哈，没关系的，比起那些离女皇陛下更近的人，我更喜欢现在的位置，至少不用承担什么重大的责任。
text.en: Haha, don't worry about it. I count myself lucky, to be honest. I don't envy the people who work closely with the Tsaritsa herself — I'd much rather be in my current position. At least I don't have to shoulder any major responsibilities.

text.zh: 原来是要转化出一种全新的能源？
text.en: So they're trying to develop a completely new kind of energy...

text.zh: 可惜，没听到更多。
text.en: It's a shame we didn't get to hear more.

text.zh: 嗯，没想到那围巾还有阻止泄密的作用。
text.en: Yeah. Censored by his scarf. Who would've thought...

text.zh: 完了，居然已经过去了这么久，我必须要离开了。
text.en: Oh dear, it looks like my time is up. I'm afraid I have to leave.

text.zh: 抱歉啊，结果完全没怎么聊剧院的事。
text.en: So sorry, we ended up barely talking about the theater...

text.zh: 没关系，我聊得很开心。
text.en: That's okay. It was a pleasure chatting with you, really.

text.zh: 下次再说吧，嗯…等工作压力小一点，我认认真真听一场演出再说。
text.en: Let's make up for it next time. Hmm... Yeah, hopefully once the work pressure eases up a little, I'll be able to focus more on the performance, and then we'll have more to discuss.

text.zh: 今天在这里说的事，记得保密。
text.en: We touched on some confidential issues today... I'd be grateful if you could keep it between us.

text.zh: 还不错。
text.en: That could have gone worse.

text.zh: 干得漂亮。只是不知道米提亚为什么走得这么匆忙…
text.en: Nice job. Why was Mitya in such a hurry to leave, though?

text.zh: 抱歉，例行检查。
text.en: Sorry, routine inspection.

text.zh: 这是…瓦列里？
text.en: Is that... Valeriy?

text.zh: 我们走。
text.en: Okay. Let's go.

text.zh: 原来不是为了工作，而是算好了瓦列里二十五分钟之后会找到他在这里？这算得太准了吧…
text.en: So he wasn't rushing to get back to work... He must have calculated that Valeriy would find him here in exactly twenty-five minutes. That's frighteningly accurate...

text.zh: 「特殊任务营」的一项重要的工作，便是确保重要人物「始终」按日程行动。
text.en: One of the main duties of the Special Assignments Battalion is to ensure that important figures stick to their schedules.

text.zh: 听上去就像是米提亚的「天敌」。
text.en: Sounds like Mitya's archenemy, then.

text.zh: 好啦，那我们也该走了。你好，麻烦结一下账。
text.en: Alright, time for us to get going too. Excuse me, check please.

text.zh: 那正好我们也付一下吧。
text.en: We'll settle our check too, then.

text.zh: 你们好，米提亚先生走之前已经把账单付清了。
text.en: Hello there. Mr. Mitya paid the check before leaving.

text.zh: 并且他还委托我转告，很荣幸能和沃雅妮莎女士以及两位朋友共享茶歇时光。
text.en: He also asked me to pass on a message. He said it was an honor to share his tea break with Miss Vodyanitsa and her two friends.

text.zh: 这…
text.en: Wait...

text.zh: （原来察觉到我们的存在了。看来这个人不简单啊，能源的事，难道是故意说给我们的？）
text.en: (So he knew we were here all along? Hmm, this raises a lot of questions... Did he deliberately mention the new energy source so that we'd overhear it?)

text.zh: （可能他的工作内容本身并不属于机密，这种新能量的用途才是关键…嗯，至少有了查下去的方向。）
text.en: (Maybe his work isn't confidential after all — maybe the key here is the purpose of this new energy... I guess that's the next thing to look into.)

text.zh: （沃雅妮莎和阿罗夏都离开了，今天就先回去休息吧。）
text.en: (Hmm... Vodyanitsa and Alyosha have left. Time to head back and call it a day.)

title.en: Return to your room and sort out the intel

text.zh: 你回来啦，今天还挺早的嘛。
text.en: You're back! You're pretty early today.

text.zh: 身体情况怎么样？
text.en: How are you feeling?

text.zh: 我正想告诉你呢，今天睡醒之后，我觉得我的体温已经完全恢复了，但那种没力气的感觉还是没有消失…
text.en: Paimon was just gonna mention that! After she woke up today, Paimon felt like her temperature was completely back to normal, but her strength still hasn't returned...

text.zh: 不过也有好消息，我好像能感觉到一点这种不舒服的来源了。
text.en: Still, there's some good news. Paimon thinks she might've figured out the source of the problem.

text.zh: 就好像是…有种神秘的力量在影响我，我在其他地方旅行的时候，都完全没有这种感受。
text.en: It's like there's... some kind of mysterious power affecting Paimon. Paimon's never felt this way before during any of her travels.

text.zh: 但一来至冬，这种感觉就出现了…
text.en: She only started feeling this way since we arrived in Snezhnaya...

text.zh: 某种…力量…？
text.en: Some kind of mysterious power, you say...?

text.zh: 对啊，军械宫需要一种全新的能源。
text.en: That's right. The Armory Palace needs a brand-new energy source.

text.zh: （难道说，是因为这个？）
text.en: (Could that have something to do with this?)

text.zh: 怎么了，每次你想到什么的时候，就会是这个表情。
text.en: What is it? You're making that face again. Y'know, the one you get whenever you have a lightbulb moment.

text.zh: 我把今天知道的事告诉你。
text.en: Let me tell you what I found out today.

text.zh: 原来，至冬正在研究一种新能源…你觉得我会不舒服，是这种研究导致的？
text.en: ...So, they're trying to develop a new energy source here... And you think that might be why Paimon's feeling unwell?

text.zh: 嗯。
text.en: Yes.

text.zh: 虽然说米提亚否认了这种能源存在副作用，但也确实说参与研究的人会有注意力涣散，短暂记忆缺失的情况…
text.en: Hmm. Well, Mitya denied that the energy they're researching has any side effects — although he did say that people working on the project have been having issues with their concentration and short-term memory...

text.zh: 不过这些症状又和我的不一样啊。
text.en: But even so, those are completely different symptoms from Paimon's.

text.zh: 你能感觉到这种力量…
text.en: This power you mentioned...

text.zh: 是从什么方向来的吗？
text.en: ...Can you sense where it's coming from?

text.zh: 太弱了，只能感觉到一点点，但我觉得，好像和军械宫是差不多的方向。
text.en: It's pretty faint, so it's kinda hard to tell... But if anything, it seems like it's coming from roughly the same direction as the Armory Palace.

text.zh: 那我们就更有必要知道研究目的了。
text.en: All the more reason to find out the purpose of their research.

text.zh: 有道理，我也赞同，可是，「呼啸社」掌握的情报也有限…
text.en: Sure, Paimon's with you there. But how, though? The Rokot only has a limited amount of intel...

text.zh: 还有一个地方没有去过…
text.en: There's still one avenue we haven't explored...

text.zh: 皇都评议会。
text.en: ...The Snezhnograd Veche.

text.zh: 对啊，那里天天都在吵严冬计划的问题，如果能参与一次，说不定能听到很多有价值的线索。
text.en: Oh, great point! They argue about Project Stuzha every day. If we could sit in on one of their sessions, we might pick up some new leads.

text.zh: 那我给阿罗夏写封信。
text.en: Okay. I need to write a letter to Alyosha.

text.zh: 好呀，哦对了，趁你出去的时候，我把老庭院餐厅感兴趣的甜点都尝了一遍。
text.en: Good idea. Oh yeah — while you were out, Paimon tried all the yummiest-looking desserts in the Podvorye Restaurant.

text.zh: 我觉得这个肯定很对你的口味，就帮你留了一份！写完信就来吃吧。
text.en: This one seemed right up your alley, so Paimon saved some for you! Come try it once you've finished writing your letter.

text.zh: 你能感觉到这种力量…
text.en: This power you mentioned...

text.zh: 是从什么方向来的吗？
text.en: ...Can you sense where it's coming from?

text.zh: 还有一个地方没有去过…
text.en: There's still one avenue we haven't explored...

text.zh: 皇都评议会。
text.en: ...The Snezhnograd Veche.

text.zh: 没想到能在这里见到科洛列夫茨基剧团的首席女高音沃雅妮莎女士，请问今天是来旁听评议会的吗？
text.en: Ah, Miss Vodyanitsa, prima donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe! What a surprise, meeting you here. Will you be sitting in on a session of the Veche?

text.zh: 抱歉，今天没有接受采访的打算…
text.en: Sorry, I'm not taking interviews today...

text.zh: #{NICKNAME}，你来了。评议会即将开始，我们快进去吧。
text.en: Oh good, you're here. The session's about to begin — let's get inside.

text.zh: 请留步，沃雅妮莎女士…！能否为我介绍一下这位新朋友！
text.en: Please wait, Miss Vodyanitsa...! Could you introduce me to your new friend?

text.zh: 你落座后不久，皇都评议会正式开始，关于「严冬计划」是否应当延续的讨论被放在了最后。
text.en: Shortly after you take your seat, the meeting of the Snezhnograd Veche officially begins. Discussions on whether to extend Project Stuzha are saved until the end.

text.zh: 「公鸡」普契涅拉公布了多项有关能源的数据，现场也一改前期的沉闷，变得十分活跃。
text.en: As "The Rooster," Pulcinella shares various energy-related statistics, the dull and lifeless room suddenly becomes very animated.

text.zh: ——综上所述，上个周期关于能源管理的承诺基本兑现，晶矿的生产与消耗趋于平稳。
text.en: In summary, the energy management commitments made for the outgoing period have been delivered upon. Furthermore, both the production and consumption of Kresnik Kristall show clear signs of stabilizing.

text.zh: 经由专业机构评估，现状可维持至下一周期，详细数据请查阅下发至各位手中的产业报告。
text.en: The relevant agencies have assessed the present circumstances and determined that the status quo can be sustained until the next period. For detailed statistics, I would refer you to the industry reports that have been distributed to all persons present.

text.zh: 需要指出的是，远方魔物引发的暴雪大幅增加了人民的能源开销，但这属于短期影响。
text.en: It should also be noted that while the recent blizzards have led to a significant increase in people's energy expenses, this is strictly a short-term phenomenon associated with a remotely located monster.

text.zh: 女皇大人会尽快处理此事，我们应该对此保持充足的信心。
text.en: Her Majesty the Tsaritsa is giving her full attention to this matter. We should have every confidence that it will be dealt with swiftly and conclusively.

text.zh: 赈灾财务说明也披露在本期报告之中，由潘塔罗涅出具。
text.en: A financial report on disaster relief is also present in this report, courtesy of Pantalone.

text.zh: 为什么现场好像越来越嘈杂？
text.en: Why does it keep getting noisier in here?

text.zh: 唉，每次都要讲的东西，只有「公鸡」大人不厌其烦，谁会有耐心啊。
text.en: *sigh* They cover the same old ground every single time. The Rooster never seems to mind, but everyone else is getting tired of it.

text.zh: 大家缺少的是信任，以及直接落到自己头上的利益，这都不会写在桌上那几份报告里。
text.en: There's a general lack of trust. People aren't seeing any tangible benefits that affect them directly. Of course, none of that will be reflected in any of the reports on the table.

text.zh: 是啊，要是没有这些纸质文件，我还能编一编。
text.en: Yeah, if it weren't for these hard-copy documents, I could've at least made something up...

text.zh: 早就想问了，你怎么还在？
text.en: I've been meaning to ask... why are you still here?

text.zh: 而且非常自来熟的样子…
text.en: And why are you acting so chummy?

text.zh: 别在意啦，有一些采访的指标而已。「来杯格瓦斯！」看过吗？销量第一的报纸。
text.en: Don't mind me, I'm just out here trying to hit my interview quotas. "Bring Out the Kvass!" Ever read it? Best-selling newspaper in town.

text.zh: 我记得你们连销售许可都没有，只能在地摊上卖…
text.en: If I remember correctly, you guys don't even have a sales permit... You have to sell from stalls on the street...

text.zh: 地摊第一也是第一啊，名副其实。
text.en: Okay then, "best-selling street stall newspaper in town." Still counts!

text.zh: 肃静。
text.en: Order.

text.zh: 接下来进入代表发言环节，若无更多有效讨论，将会展开针对此议题的投票。
text.en: We will now open the floor to the representatives. If there are no further substantive issues to discuss, we will then proceed to a vote on this motion.

text.zh: 至冬向来有优待愚人众部队成员和其家属的传统。
text.en: Snezhnaya has a long tradition of treating members of the Fatui armed forces and their dependents favorably.

text.zh: 但最新的调查结果显示，出身偏远的成员家中可购买的晶矿数量，比居住在至冬堡的普通人少百分之十五。
text.en: But recent survey shows that Fatui families in remote areas have access to 15% less Kristall than the average civilian family in Snezhnograd.

text.zh: 这也是老生常谈的问题了，每一份晶矿的分配都要做到有理有据，否则民怨就会迅速积累。
text.en: It's been said many times before, but it bears repeating now: There needs to be a clear and consistent rationale behind how Kristall is allocated, or we will soon face immense public backlash.

text.zh: 看来每次你都没有听进去…世间没有绝对的理据，公平也是相对的。
text.en: Perhaps you wouldn't need to keep repeating yourself if you would hear me out for once... I say again, true consistency exists only in principle. In the real world, fairness is relative.

text.zh: 在你眼里分配的过程只是产量与人口的简单计算，那你考虑过生产设备出现故障的可能性吗？
text.en: You appear to treat resource allocation as a simple function of production and population. So what about when the equipment used in production breaks down? Have you factored that into your equation?

text.zh: 你又知道至冬距离上一次统计人口，已经过去多久了吗？
text.en: And do you even know how long it's been since Snezhnaya last conducted a census?

text.zh: 我不打算在专业问题上和你纠缠，不然我就是「富公子」了。
text.en: If I knew the answers to questions like that, I'm sure I'd be a very wealthy man — and I doubt I'd be going by "Childe."

text.zh: 我关注的是问题本身，除非你要否认我们一直以来推行的优待政策。
text.en: I'd like to bring the focus back to the specific issue I raised. Or do you wish to deny that favorable treatment for Fatui dependents is our longstanding policy?

text.zh: 所以说…唱反调的人通常都更不负责，就和那些整天叫嚷着要停止「严冬计划」的人一样。
text.en: Ah, it's easy to be a critic when there's no accountability. That seems to be a running theme in the anti-Project Stuzha cohort.

text.zh: 似乎只要打倒一个「罪魁祸首」，所有的问题都能迎刃而解。
text.en: Defeat the ringleader, and all other problems will magically resolve themselves. That's what they seem to think.

text.zh: 以防你不知道，无论「严冬计划」持续与否，我都不会因此在报告里少写任何一页。
text.en: But in case you aren't aware, not one jot in my report would change, whether Project Stuzha continues or not.

text.zh: 所以你压根不想解决这个问题？
text.en: So you have no intention whatsoever of finding a solution to this problem?

text.zh: 从来都只有我在解决问题。
text.en: On the contrary, I'm the only one here who ever brings solutions.

text.zh: 「公子」率先为士兵发声，「富人」优雅回击，唇枪舌剑由此展开！
text.en: Childe opened by speaking up for the armed forces. Regrator struck back with style, and a war of words ensued!

text.zh: 本报当即在现场向观众进行采访：请问你更支持谁？
text.en: Our reporter was live on the scene to get the audience's reaction as it all unfolded: Who do you support?

text.zh: 「公子」提出的质疑理应被解决…
text.en: I think Childe raised some issues that need addressing...

text.zh: 正是如此！「公子」博得全场喝彩，连续诘问将「富人」逼至绝境，真是少见，真是少见。
text.en: The people have spoken! Childe received raucous applause from the crowd as he pushed Regrator onto his back foot with a relentless barrage of questions. It had to be seen to be believed.

text.zh: 「富人」的反驳情有可原…
text.en: I think Regrator's rebuttal makes sense...

text.zh: 正是如此！「富人」干净利落驳倒了「公子」，正如往常一样。啊，可「公子」又怎么会善罢甘休？
text.en: The people have spoken! Regrator delivered a deft rebuttal to Childe, as we've seen so many times before. Ah, but how could Childe take this lying down?

text.zh: 你现在理解为什么这张报纸没有销售许可了吧？
text.en: Now you see why they don't have a sales permit.

text.zh: 嗯…
text.en: Hmm...

text.zh: （抛开离谱的报道不谈。在印象中，第一次在璃月见到达达利亚的时候，他代表的是「北国银行」。）
text.en: (However this reporter wants to spin things, I haven't forgotten that Tartaglia was representing the Northland Bank when we first met in Liyue.)

text.zh: （至少在那个时候，这两个人的关系还不至于如此紧张…）
text.en: (So surely their relationship can't always have been this strained...)

text.zh: 你们两个跑题了吧，数据的事就回到数据上。
text.en: You two are getting off-topic. Let's focus on what the data is saying.

text.zh: 潘塔罗涅先生，由我代为解释，可以吗？
text.en: Mr. Pantalone, may I speak on your behalf?

text.zh: 嗯，麻烦你了。最近我想少说点话。
text.en: Oh, please do. I'm more than happy to save my breath.

text.zh: 分配的迭代每个周期都在进行，最终目的也是为了找到最合理的分配方式，这点和达达利亚先生所言一致。
text.en: Kristall distribution policy undergoes modifications with each new period, the ultimate goal being to find the most reasonable method of allocation, which I believe is what Mr. Tartaglia also seeks.

text.zh: 可是许多人都遭受了某些极端人士的误导。我必须澄清，「严冬计划」并非导致问题的症结，它只是一种分配框架。
text.en: But I fear many may have been misled on this topic by extremist activists. To clarify, Project Stuzha is not the root cause of the problem. It is merely a framework for resource distribution.

text.zh: 近期的各项报告都显示，至冬拥有顽强的韧性和适应力，这套分配框架也逐渐成熟。
text.en: The most recent reports all point to Snezhnaya's resilience and adaptability during this period of fine-tuning, and give clear indications that the distribution framework is improving with each iteration.

text.zh: 如果不考虑风险进行大幅度的调整，恐怕会适得其反，让先前摸索出的一些经验再度失效。
text.en: To make drastic adjustments without first considering the risks would likely do more harm than good. It would be a waste of the hard-won experience we've gained to date.

text.zh: 知名金融学者阿莱波夫起身发言，叙述财务逻辑，话语显然在影射「呼啸社」等社会组织。
text.en: Renowned scholar of finance, Arapov spoke up to clarify the fiscal logic, clearly alluding to social organizations like the Rokot in his words.

text.zh: 尤其是争议巨大的「莱莱可」现今依旧活跃，「呼啸社」应该为此负责吗？不，该负责的另有其人！
text.en: With the notorious Lelek still active to this day, should the Rokot be held responsible? No, there is someone else to blame!

text.zh: 为什么会突然提到「呼啸社」？
text.en: Where did you get "Rokot" from?

text.zh: 「莱莱可」又是谁？
text.en: And who is this "Lelek"?

text.zh: 因为他只是把潘塔罗涅先生的话换了个说法——「呼啸社」就是他口中「不负责任的反对者」。
text.en: She's just rephrasing what Mr. Pantalone said. The Rokot are the critics he accuses of taking no responsibility for their actions.

text.zh: 而「莱莱可」…你还不知道，他是目前「呼啸社」最声名远扬…或者说臭名昭著的成员。
text.en: As for Lelek... You won't have heard of him yet. He's currently the most famous member of the Rokot... Well, more like infamous.

text.zh: 他想叫停「严冬计划」已经到了偏执的程度，而且和我们这些体面人不同，他觉得议会重要的环节只有投票。
text.en: Ending Project Stuzha has become an obsession for him. Unlike the more decent ones among us, he believes that votes in the Veche are all that matter.

text.zh: 那无论是威胁也好，怂恿也好，贿赂也好，只要能让人改票不就行了？
text.en: So whether it's threats, coercion, or bribery, he'll use whatever means necessary to get people to change their vote.

text.zh: 原来还有这种人…
text.en: Wow. There's more to the Rokot than I thought...

text.zh: 正好，都聊到这里了，你会支持「莱莱可」吗？
text.en: And since we're already on the subject, what do you think of Lelek's methods? Are you for or against?

text.zh: 可以理解吧。
text.en: I can sympathize with him.

text.zh: 正是，正是，「莱莱可」的支持者越来越多，我们就是他坚实的后盾！
text.en: Yes, don't we all! Lelek's supporters grow in number by the day. We stand with Lelek!

text.zh: 或许有内情。
text.en: Hard to say. I suspect there's more to his story.

text.zh: 无论内情如何，他做的事对我们有利，我们就是他坚实的后盾！
text.en: Well, whatever the story is, his actions benefit us all. We stand with Lelek!

text.zh: 有点太极端了。
text.en: He seems a little extreme.

text.zh: 虽然有个别观众发出了反对的声音，但无法动摇整体的支持，我们就是他坚实的后盾！
text.en: Despite a handful of detractors among the audience, the people overwhelmingly support Lelek. We stand with Lelek!

text.zh: 看来还是有人能好好说话啊。正好我也考虑过这个问题，对你们来说，需要的就是更精确的地方数据吧。
text.en: At least someone here wants to take this discussion seriously. I've been considering that issue myself — what you really need is more precise regional data, right?

text.zh: 我觉得可以直接由愚人众负责，因为他们原本就负责运输晶矿，再兼任一些数据采集工作也无妨。
text.en: I think it would be easiest to let the Fatui handle it. Since they're already in charge of Kristall shipments anyway, we may as well get them to collect some data while they're at it.

text.zh: 你们需要什么，就委托愚人众去查什么。至于监督，我觉得冬契军就很合适，本来想和薇斯纳女士讨论这件事的，但她不在。
text.en: Whatever you need, you can ask the Fatui to look into it for you. In terms of supervision, I think the Druzhna would be a good fit. I had hoped to discuss this with Miss Vesna, but sadly she's not present.

text.zh: 可以先由我整理意见，待薇斯纳长官归来再做判断。
text.en: I will be happy to take a note of your suggestions and present them to Commander Vesna for a decision upon her return.

text.zh: 「严冬计划」一事，薇斯纳长官始终关切。但冬契军分内事务本就繁重，恐怕难以给予实际支持。
text.en: The Commander has always taken a keen interest in Project Stuzha. However, given the Druzhna's demanding workload, I'm afraid it may prove difficult for them to provide any practical support.

text.zh: 在有确切可执行方案前，请不要轻率地表达猜想。
text.en: Let us refrain from jumping to conclusions until a concrete and actionable plan is in place.

text.zh: 是我失言，「公鸡」大人。
text.en: My apologies, Lord Rooster.

text.zh: 如何分配人力，如何把握时效，如何建立汇报制度，即便还存在很多问题…
text.en: There are numerous issues to address here, including manpower, time-sensitivity, and reporting lines.

text.zh: 但我支持起草一份方案，走正常的政务流程吧，届时另起议题各方进行评判。
text.en: Nevertheless, I support drafting a proposal. Follow the usual procedure, and it can be raised as a new motion for all parties to evaluate at the appropriate time.

text.zh: 既然如此，在拿出方案之前，我有个想法，刚刚有提到现存的报告缺乏时效性，指的应该是官方报告。
text.en: In that case, I'd like to share one thought before the proposal is drafted. The issue of time-sensitivity was raised just now, which I presume relates to the official reports.

text.zh: 而我们能源协会也会根据各城镇及周边情况，定期产出一些统计结果，我们能不能用上这个？
text.en: In fact, the Energy Commission already collects regular statistics on each urban center and its surrounding area. Would these be of any use?

text.zh: 好主意，彩冰镇的报告每期我都会看，虽然我关注的是设备运行的部分，但基于能耗就能反推出很多数据。
text.en: That's a good idea. I read every issue of Svetloledovka's report, and although my focus is mostly on the section about equipment operation, the energy consumption statistics also yield a lot of insights.

text.zh: 可是，用地方数据来决定给他们的晶矿份额…远期风险很高。
text.en: Be that as it may, does no one see an issue with using local data to determine Kristall quotas? In the long-term, it seems like a very risky solution...

text.zh: 有北国银行总部的报告作对比，骗不了我。而且这也只是参考。
text.en: Not if they are used purely for reference. So long as we have the report from the Northland Bank's headquarters to corroborate it, no one will be able to fool me.

text.zh: 行，看来如此处理，各方都没有意见。
text.en: Very well then. It appears that this arrangement is acceptable to all parties.

text.zh: 嗯，我同意。
text.en: Yeah, sounds good to me.

text.zh: 各位官员就改善愚人众士兵待遇这一议题达成初步共识…哈啊…
text.en: The members reached a provisional consensus on the issue of improving treatment for Fatui soldiers... *yawn*

text.zh: （你注意到记者写了几笔之后突然划去所有内容，新起了一行——）
text.en: (You notice the reporter jot down a few words before suddenly crossing everything out and starting a fresh paragraph...)

text.zh: #今日「科洛列夫茨基剧团」首席女高音与某位{M#风度翩翩的先生}{F#风姿绰约的女士}出席了皇都评议会，二人关系非同一般…
text.en: #Today, the prima donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe attended a session of the Snezhnograd Veche in the company of a {M#dashing young man}{F#most charming young lady}. The question on all of our minds is: What is the true nature of their relationship?

text.zh: 如果再写这种东西，连进入剧团采访的许可都会被取消哦？
text.en: Write anything like that again and I'm revoking your permission to interview the troupe, got it?

text.zh: 接下来的讨论涉及能源，医疗，科技，工业等方方面面，各方都在借机表达对「严冬计划」的态度。
text.en: The remaining discussion covers everything from energy to healthcare, technology, and industry. All parties take the opportunity to express their stance on Project Stuzha.

text.zh: 米洛诺娃依旧在撰写添油加醋的报道，你虽不再理睬她，但你也开始觉得，看她写的新闻或许比亲临现场更有意思。
text.en: You ignore Mironova as she carries on writing her sensationalist report. But after a while, you start to feel that reading the news from her might actually be more interesting than being here in person...

text.zh: 那么，若无其他代表发言，就进入最后的投票环节。
text.en: Now then, if there are no further contributions from those present, we shall proceed to the final vote.

text.zh: 喂，你看你看！
text.en: Hey, check it out!

text.zh: 那是…楚古诺夫？
text.en: Is that... Chugunov?

text.zh: 他为什么现在，就选择了反对…
text.en: What made him vote against? Why now...?

text.zh: 计票结束，同意延续「严冬计划」的票数为百分之六十一，已过半数。
text.en: The votes have been tallied. Those in favor of continuing Project Stuzha total sixty-one percent, securing a clear majority.

text.zh: （这次真的好险…比上次又少了几个百分点，楚古诺夫的改票分量很重…）
text.en: (That was too close... The margin has shrunk yet again. Chugunov was a huge loss...)

text.zh: （应该是那个「莱莱可」干的…不知道普契涅拉还有什么办法。）
text.en: (I'll bet Lelek is behind this... I wonder how Pulcinella will respond this time.)

text.zh: （楚古诺夫。原来如此，是「莱莱可」吧。）
text.en: (Chugunov... I see. Lelek strikes again.)

text.zh: （「莱莱可」真厉害！等驳倒了「严冬计划」，坚持为他摇旗呐喊的「来杯格瓦斯！」就能翻身了！哈哈，要赢了！）
text.en: (Yes, go Lelek! Once Project Stuzha is defeated, our unwavering support at "Bring Out the Kvass!" will finally pay off when we make our comeback! Haha, I can taste our victory already!)

text.zh: 依照得票结果，「严冬计划」将会延续，直到下个评议会周期。请诸位谨记——
text.en: In accordance with the result of this vote, Project Stuzha will remain in effect until the next Veche period. Finally, may I remind us all:

text.zh: 「我们的争论，只为延续极光与冻土，只为铸造荣耀与团结。」
text.en: "We debate only for the greater glory and solidarity of our nation. May the aurora shine ever on and the tundra always stand firm."

text.zh: 散会。
text.en: The session is concluded.

text.zh: 早就想问了，你怎么还在？
text.en: I've been meaning to ask... why are you still here?

text.zh: 而且非常自来熟的样子…
text.en: And why are you acting so chummy?

text.zh: 「公子」提出的质疑理应被解决…
text.en: I think Childe raised some issues that need addressing...

text.zh: 「富人」的反驳情有可原…
text.en: I think Regrator's rebuttal makes sense...

text.zh: 为什么会突然提到「呼啸社」？
text.en: Where did you get "Rokot" from?

text.zh: 「莱莱可」又是谁？
text.en: And who is this "Lelek"?

text.zh: 可以理解吧。
text.en: I can sympathize with him.

text.zh: 或许有内情。
text.en: Hard to say. I suspect there's more to his story.

text.zh: 有点太极端了。
text.en: He seems a little extreme.

text.zh: 没想到在议会上，楚古诺夫就投出了反对「严冬计划」的一票。
text.en: I have to say, I really wasn't expecting Chugunov to vote against Project Stuzha.

text.zh: 这很奇怪吗？
text.en: Why? What's so strange about that?

text.zh: 嗯，按道理来说，至冬的这帮富商政要是最不可能反对「严冬计划」的人。
text.en: Well, in principle, Snezhnaya's business and political elites ought to be the ones least likely to oppose it.

text.zh: 你刚刚也听到了，「严冬计划」本质只是一种分配框架，要求所有人一起过冬。
text.en: As we heard, Project Stuzha is basically just a resource distribution framework that requires everyone to cut back during the winter.

text.zh: 哪怕是这个政策取消了，女皇陛下依然会消耗那么多能源，那能源的缺口，就只能让工厂来填了。
text.en: But even if the policy got canceled, the Tsaritsa's energy needs wouldn't suddenly go down. The extra demand from the public would have to be filled from somewhere, so logically, the factories would have to take the hit.

text.zh: 原来如此…
text.en: This explains a lot...

text.zh: 米提亚先生在评议会前给我写了封信，说查到了伊泽卡设备制造厂果然存在超时生产与能耗过高的问题。
text.en: I got a letter from Mr. Mitya just before today's session. He said he's confirmed that there are issues around overtime and excessive energy consumption at the Iskra Manufacturing Plant.

text.zh: 按理来说，在「公鸡」大人收到报告之后，就会要求工厂停产接受审查，并给予处罚。
text.en: In a situation like this, once The Rooster receives the report, he'll order the factory to halt production and submit to an investigation, before issuing a penalty.

text.zh: 但这至少需要一周的时间，赶不上这次评议会，目前我们应该也没有打草惊蛇。
text.en: But that's a week-long process, and thus didn't make it onto the Veche agenda this time. I don't think he suspects anything so far.

text.zh: 懂了，要在停产和减产里选…
text.en: Got it, so for him it's a choice between reducing production and stopping entirely...

text.zh: 嗯，你知道他是个很自私的人。
text.en: Exactly. And as you know, he's a very selfish person.

text.zh: 原本我打算在官方下达制裁通知后去煽动他，让他认为这件事很不公平。
text.en: I was originally gonna try and flip him after he received notice of the official sanctions. My plan was to convince him that the whole thing was completely unfair.

text.zh: 与其只是自己停产利益受损，不如让「严冬计划」停下来，这样所有工厂的耗能都会被限制，大家都没钱赚。
text.en: Rather than just sit back and take the hit while his factory stopped production, he'd be better off voting to end Project Stuzha. At least that way, no one else would be able to make any money either, because all the factories would suddenly have more limited energy to work with.

text.zh: 可是，他现在就投出了反对票…就意味着有人用了更直接的手段，让他不得不改票，就像其他人那样。
text.en: But now, he's already voted against it... which means, someone must've used more forceful means to change his vote. Just like with everyone else who flipped.

text.zh: 你是说，「莱莱可」？
text.en: You mean, Lelek?

text.zh: 嗯。谁也不知道「莱莱可」为什么对严冬计划如此执着，而且现在看来，他正在一步步接近成功。
text.en: Yeah. No one knows why Lelek is so obsessed with ending Project Stuzha, but by the looks of it, he's inching closer and closer to success.

text.zh: （有这么强的行动力，一定有同等强硬的动机，说不定他就是知道「严冬计划」内情的人。）
text.en: (Lelek must have strong motivations, given how he'll stop at nothing to achieve his goal. Maybe he knows the full truth of Project Stuzha.)

text.zh: （或许接下来，我应该把调查注意力放到这个人身上。）
text.en: (Maybe my next step should be to focus on him.)

text.zh: 好了，接下来你有什么打算，要一起离开吗？
text.en: Alright, what're your plans for the rest of the day? Shall we head out?

text.zh: 嗨，伙伴，我在台上就看到你了。
text.en: Hey, comrade. I noticed you were here during the debate.

text.zh: 没想到你还热衷于政治呢。
text.en: I didn't take you for a political enthusiast.

text.zh: 二位执行官大人，你们好。我只是今天正好有空闲，刚巧这位新朋友也对评议会感兴趣。
text.en: Greetings, Harbingers. I just happened to have some free time today, and my new friend here thought it might be fun to check out the Veche.

text.zh: 我知道了，一定是奥黛塔介绍的吧，哈哈，看来你们相处得还不错。
text.en: Ah, Odette must've introduced you. Haha, looks like you two are getting along pretty well.

text.zh: 那各位慢聊，我先回剧团了。
text.en: I'll leave you to catch up. I should head back to the troupe.

text.zh: 嗯，祝你接下来演出顺利。
text.en: Sure. Break a leg, and all that.

text.zh: #感兴趣，感兴趣，呵呵，{NICKNAME}可不是一盏省油的灯，不会因为兴趣而跑来跑去，我说的对吗？
text.en: #"Thought it might be fun to check out the Veche," did you? Heh, things are never that simple with you, {NICKNAME}. There's no way you're here for kicks and giggles. Tell me I'm wrong.

text.zh: 听到了很有趣的东西。
text.en: I learned an interesting tidbit today.

text.zh: 那个「莱莱可」。
text.en: Some guy called "Lelek."

text.zh: 有些人觉得他神秘莫测，有些人恨他到咬牙切齿。
text.en: Oh, yeah. To some, he's a captivating enigma. To others, he's the bane of their existence.

text.zh: 当时谁能想到一个在「呼啸社」中名不见经传的人，能掀起这等风浪。
text.en: No one ever thought that some anonymous nobody from the Rokot could cause such a stir.

text.zh: 我想知道他的真实身份。
text.en: I want to find out his true identity.

text.zh: 能让我去调查吗？
text.en: Is it okay if I start digging around?

text.zh: 嗯？你想调查，呵呵，那我觉得他是藏不了多久了。你觉得呢，桑多涅？
text.en: Huh? You want to look into Lelek? Haha, then I'm sure his days of anonymity are numbered. What do you think, Sandrone?

text.zh: #没关系吧，如果{NICKNAME}真能把「莱莱可」揪出来，也算是帮普契涅拉省了心。
text.en: #Fine by me, I guess. If {NICKNAME} actually manages to expose Lelek, it'll be doing Pulcinella a favor.

text.zh: #作为报酬，让{M#他}{F#她}知道「莱莱可」手里的那些情报，好像也说得过去。
text.en: #In return, it seems fair to let {M#him}{F#her} in on what we've learned so far.

text.zh: 我也这么想，不然也显得我们两个有点不近人情。
text.en: My thoughts exactly. Sharing is caring, after all.

text.zh: 你回一趟格鲁波夫，把关于「莱莱可」的资料取过来吧。比起办理通行手续，还是调用资料比较简单。
text.en: Head back to Glupov and grab the files on Lelek. It's easier to just pull the records than go through the rigmarole of getting the Traveler a visitor's permit.

text.zh: 遵命，公子大人。
text.en: As you command, Childe, Sir.

text.zh: 那我也让人准备一壶红茶好了，反正等着也是等着。
text.en: In that case, since we're going to be waiting anyway, I'll have someone brew a pot of black tea.

text.zh: 听到了很有趣的东西。
text.en: I learned an interesting tidbit today.

text.zh: 那个「莱莱可」。
text.en: Some guy called "Lelek."

text.zh: 我想知道他的真实身份。
text.en: I want to find out his true identity.

text.zh: 能让我去调查吗？
text.en: Is it okay if I start digging around?

text.zh: 在「莱莱可」参与的众多事件中，当事人都不太敢聊及他的情报，应该是受到了某种威胁。
text.en: One common thread among the many incidents Lelek has been involved in is that the victims are all too scared to share any real information about him. Clearly, he must have threatened them in some way.

text.zh: 他悄无声息潜入现场，留下恐吓信，而无论信件还是现场都没有留下可供追查的线索。
text.en: His modus operandi is to silently infiltrate the scene and leave a threatening letter behind. But neither the letters nor the crime scenes ever yield any clues to his identity.

text.zh: 所以这些资料基本只是记录了简单的当事人描述，能挖掘的东西很有限。
text.en: So all these files have to offer are short statements by the people affected. They don't give us a lot to go on.

text.zh: 至少能说明是个高手，知道该怎么反侦察。
text.en: If nothing else, it shows we're dealing with a trained professional who's versed in counter-surveillance.

text.zh: 嗯，而且有相当比例的事件，都发生在安全等级很高的地方，本来那些位高权重的人就很看重安全这件事。
text.en: Yes, and to that point, he often strikes in highly secure locations. The victims are high-ranking and influential people who take their personal security very seriously.

text.zh: 但「莱莱可」就是能悄无声息地进入他们的房间，从来没被目击过，也不留下哪怕一点侵入的痕迹。
text.en: Somehow, Lelek slips right into their rooms without making a sound. There's never any eye-witnesses, nor the slightest trace of a break-in.

text.zh: 既然有潜入能力，当然也有动手的能力…这种事虽然从未发生过，但已经能让这帮人吓得睡不着觉了。
text.en: If he can get in and out undetected, it means he can strike without warning... Not that that's ever happened so far. But the thought is enough to scare these people sleepless.

text.zh: 对人类来说，实现这种完美潜入有点匪夷所思，后来的调查方向也转向了妖精，可惜还是没有收获。
text.en: It's hard to believe that a human being could pull this off flawlessly every time, so they switched the focus of the investigation to fae. Unfortunately, no one's found anything yet.

text.zh: 连你都做不到吗？
text.en: Are you saying even you couldn't pull it off?

text.zh: 喂，你这有点小看我了。不过我的风格一向很直接，估计难在「不露馅」这件事上吧。
text.en: Careful — don't underestimate me... Heh, although truth be told, I'd probably find it hard not to blow my cover. Direct confrontation is more my style.

text.zh: 所以也没完全否定人类的可能性，只是能拥有如此身手的人在全提瓦特也找不出几个。妖精虽有异能，但往往缺乏动机…
text.en: We haven't ruled out the possibility of Lelek being human. It's just, there can only be a handful of people in all of Teyvat who'd fit the profile. Fae, on the other hand — plenty would have the ability, but few would have the motive...

text.zh: 和达达利亚一样强…
text.en: So it's someone as strong as Tartaglia...

text.zh: 而且还更缜密…
text.en: And even more meticulous...

text.zh: 是「不比我弱太多」。以你现在的标准根本找不出来。
text.en: No, no, not as strong as me — you'll never find the culprit with criteria like that. Let's go with... "a little weaker than me."

text.zh: 那维莱特？
text.en: ...Neuvillette?

text.zh: 别戳我伤口啊。我承认他实力强也很缜密，但我们是不是至少应该选个和至冬有关的人？
text.en: Argh, you hit me right where it hurts... I'll admit, he's strong and meticulous. But can we at least limit this to candidates who have something to do with Snezhnaya?

text.zh: 丝柯克？
text.en: ...Skirk?

text.zh: 师父很强是没错，但她最好真的是个缜密的人…
text.en: There's no denying that master is strong, but meticulous? We can only hope...

text.zh: #{M#他}{F#她}只是想描绘一个大概的画像，别纠结在谁强谁弱这件事上。
text.en: #{M#He}{F#She}'s just trying to find a reference point. Stop getting fixated on who's stronger than who.

text.zh: 这可是最重要的事啊，对我来说。
text.en: But that's the most important thing! In my opinion, anyway.

text.zh: 好好好，降两档。
text.en: Alright, alright, let's take it down a notch or two.

text.zh: 用奥黛塔做参考呢？
text.en: How about Odette as a reference point?

text.zh: 你们都认识，我也见过她身手。
text.en: She's someone we all know, and I've seen her in action.

text.zh: 奥黛塔？嗯，好像真差不多，身手没问题，人也很沉稳。
text.en: Odette? Yeah, that seems about right. Her skills are solid, and she's always calm under pressure.

text.zh: 只不过是愚人众，立场上不太可能。嗯，至少比之前的例子精确多了。
text.en: Except she's Fatui, so the likelihood of her working against us is pretty low... But yeah, much more accurate than your previous example, at least.

text.zh: …不，等等，假如暂时忽略这个前提呢？
text.en: ...No, wait a moment. Maybe we should interrogate that assumption.

text.zh: 忽略？你是说…
text.en: What do you mean? Which assumption?

text.zh: 愚人众这层身份并不是完美的挡箭牌，而且你们想想看，「呼啸社」恰好能为她隐藏身份。
text.en: Her Fatui identity doesn't necessarily exonerate her. And when you think about it, the Rokot would be precisely what she needs to conceal her identity.

text.zh: 所以不是手段高超到不会留下痕迹，而是得知了愚人众内部的动向，能选择最恰当的时机行动…
text.en: Hmm... plus, she wouldn't need to be such a pro at covering her tracks. She'd already know where the Fatui will be and when, so she could choose the perfect time to act...

text.zh: 糟了，本来只是随便一说，怎么还越说越真啊？
text.en: Yikes. I was just thinking out loud... Why is this starting to sound like such a convincing theory?

text.zh: 不过，奥黛塔真有这么强的想要叫停「严冬计划」的理由吗？
text.en: Still... What reason could Odette possibly have for trying to call off Project Stuzha?

text.zh: 可惜了，最熟悉奥黛塔的人是阿蕾奇诺，但她现在还没回来。
text.en: Arlecchino would be the best person to ask — she knows Odette best. Unfortunately, she isn't back yet.

text.zh: 阿蕾奇诺？
text.en: Arlecchino?

text.zh: 曾经罗莎琳也很苦恼怎么和奥黛塔相处，所以和阿蕾奇诺单独聊过。
text.en: Rosalyne used to open up to her in private about her struggles with Odette.

text.zh: 你也知道，和罗莎琳相比，阿蕾奇诺算是很会和孩子打交道的人了。
text.en: As I'm sure you can imagine, Arlecchino is quite a lot better with children than Rosalyne was.

text.zh: 阿蕾奇诺给罗莎琳支了招，罗莎琳在临行前和奥黛塔达成了和解，这才算没有留下永远的遗憾。
text.en: She gave her some tips on how to handle the situation, and Rosalyne managed to reach a settlement with Odette before leaving. So I suppose there were at least no lifelong regrets left behind.

text.zh: 当然这里面的详情我就不了解了，但奥黛塔确实有记恨「严冬计划」的理由。
text.en: Beyond that, I don't know the details about that side of things. But I do know that Odette definitely has a motive to hold a grudge against Project Stuzha.

text.zh: ——因为她的父亲就是死在「严冬计划」的前期行动中。
text.en: The reason being, her father passed away during the early stages of the project.

text.zh: 那时还处于准备阶段，还没有「严冬计划」这个名字，但内容是一直延续下来的。
text.en: That was back before it'd been named Project Stuzha, when things were still being worked out. But in essence, it's remained the same ever since.

text.zh: 原来是这样啊…罗莎琳是个以自我为绝对中心的人，当她关注起奥黛塔的时候，我也有点纳闷…
text.en: Huh, the more you know... Rosalyne was always so self-centered. I never understood why she started paying so much attention to Odette.

text.zh: 你不知道这段故事？
text.en: Oh, even you didn't know about this?

text.zh: 哈哈，就算以你经历过的事来看，我和罗莎琳也算不上熟络吧？只是碰巧喝过几次茶的关系而已。
text.en: Hah, is that such a surprise? If you cast your mind back, you may remember that Rosalyne and I weren't exactly close... We had tea together a few times, but that was about it.

text.zh: 奥黛塔的过往不算秘密，当时她的父亲是愚人众的成员，母亲是非常知名的芭蕾舞演员。
text.en: Odette's past is no secret. Her father was a Fatuus, and her mother was a very famous ballerina.

text.zh: 听起来是个完美继承了父母事业的孩子对吧…实际上完全不是这么回事。
text.en: On the surface, it looks like she followed right in her parents' footsteps... But the truth is quite a different story.

text.zh: 在她的父亲因为任务去世之后，母亲过度悲伤，在表演的时候摔断了腿，再也无法跳舞。
text.en: After her father passed away on a mission, her mother was overcome with grief. She broke her leg during a performance and could never dance again.

text.zh: 奥黛塔原本只对芭蕾舞感兴趣，但是这场变故之后，家里的两个顶梁柱都没了，连生活都难以维持…
text.en: Odette was only interested in ballet at the time, but this tragedy left the family with both breadwinners gone. They could barely make ends meet...

text.zh: 因为卡皮塔诺的主张，因任务而牺牲的愚人众成员，他们的家属都应得到妥善的安置，被施以足够的帮助。
text.en: Per Capitano's policy, family members of Fatui who died in the line of duty had to be appropriately accommodated and provided with adequate assistance.

text.zh: 所以哪怕罗莎琳不情愿，她还是要解决奥黛塔一家的生计问题，最后的办法就是让奥黛塔加入愚人众。
text.en: So, regardless of how Rosalyne may have felt about it, it fell to her to resolve the issue of Odette's family's livelihood. In the end, the solution they agreed upon was to have Odette join the Fatui.

text.zh: 我懂了，如果奥黛塔不加入的话，就只会有一笔一次性的抚恤金…这么看确实是加入愚人众更好。
text.en: Right, because the alternative would have been a one-off compensation payment, I guess? In that sense, joining up was definitely the better option.

text.zh: 但听上去，这件事违背了奥黛塔的意愿对吧？因为她不喜欢愚人众…
text.en: Still... She must have had mixed feelings about it, right? If she doesn't even like the Fatui...

text.zh: 这只是猜测，我只是说有这种可能，作为奥黛塔成为「莱莱可」的动机，它是成立的。
text.en: It's just a theory. A possibility. But as a motive for Odette to become Lelek, it holds up.

text.zh: 奥黛塔现在究竟怎么想，她和罗莎琳的矛盾是什么，这我就不知道了。
text.en: That said, I have no idea where Odette's head is at right now, or what her conflict with Rosalyne was about.

text.zh: 和罗莎琳关系不好的人有那么那么多，我可没打算把这些都搞清楚。
text.en: Plenty of people were on bad terms with Rosalyne. I have no intention of trying to figure it all out.

text.zh: 「女士」原本打算修复这段关系…
text.en: So Signora actually wanted to mend her relationship with Odette...

text.zh: 是啊，但现在说这些也没什么意义了。
text.en: Yes, but there's not much point in discussing that now.

text.zh: 回到「莱莱可」的话题上，既然所有的调查都收效甚微，试一试新的方向也没什么损失。
text.en: Yeah, back to Lelek. Since our investigations so far have turned up next to nothing, we've got nothing to lose by trying a new angle.

text.zh: 正好，本来我和冬妮娅约好了，明天要去剧院看奥黛塔的彩排，可惜因为「莱莱可」的事，我又要加班了。
text.en: Funnily enough, Tonia and I had actually made plans to go to the theater tomorrow to watch Odette's rehearsal. Unfortunately, thanks to this Lelek situation, I'll be stuck working overtime again.

text.zh: 这下就由你替我去吧，不然这票也是浪费，顺便你还能见一见冬妮娅。
text.en: Which means you can go in my place. No point wasting the ticket, plus you'll get to meet Tonia.

text.zh: 彩排？
text.en: What's the rehearsal for?

text.zh: 嗯，「寻灵」的彩排，这是相当经典的芭蕾舞剧，由奥黛塔母亲的家族世代传承下来，已经停演好多年了。
text.en: "Spirit Seeker," quite the classic ballet. It was passed down through Odette's mother's family for generations, though it hasn't been performed in years.

text.zh: 在奥黛塔的努力练习之下，它终于能重新回归舞台，大家的观看热情都非常高，正式演出的票早就售罄了。
text.en: But Odette's been practicing it diligently, and it's finally ready for a return to the stage. Excitement is through the roof. Tickets for the official performance sold out long ago.

text.zh: 冬妮娅也非常感兴趣，说什么也想看，虽然我是不懂这种东西啦，但既然妹妹想看，总还是要想想办法。
text.en: Tonia's excited for it too. She's desperate to see it, no matter what. Personally, it's not really my kind of thing, but since she's my little sister, I had to figure something out.

text.zh: 我倒是看过几次，故事也比较简单，就是主角顺着灵魂留下的踪迹，一点点找回记忆。
text.en: I've actually seen it several times before. The story's pretty straightforward: The lead character follows a trail of clues left behind by a spirit, gradually recovering her memories along the way.

text.zh: 把「爱与遗憾」作为主题，用现在的眼光看倒不算新奇…
text.en: It's a tale of love and regret — so not exactly reinventing the wheel, at least by today's standards...

text.zh: 但每当熟悉的旋律响起，主角起舞的时候，还是会觉得那个画面很美。
text.en: But when that classic melody kicks in and the lead character begins to dance, it always gets me. It really is beautiful.

text.zh: 想要跳出那个感觉很不容易，我知道表演这个剧目是奥黛塔的梦想，但我也不确定她是不是真的准备好了。
text.en: Not an easy dance to do justice to, though. I know it's always been Odette's dream to perform this piece, but I'm not sure she's really ready.

text.zh: 那我觉得，就算她真的是「莱莱可」，也等她表演完成之后再处理吧。
text.en: ...In that case, I think that even if she is Lelek, we should wait until her performance is over before we respond.

text.zh: 这件事就交给你了，伙伴。
text.en: I'll let you take it from here, comrade.

text.zh: 和达达利亚一样强…
text.en: So it's someone as strong as Tartaglia...

text.zh: 而且还更缜密…
text.en: And even more meticulous...

text.zh: 那维莱特？
text.en: ...Neuvillette?

text.zh: 丝柯克？
text.en: ...Skirk?

text.zh: 用奥黛塔做参考呢？
text.en: How about Odette as a reference point?

text.zh: 你们都认识，我也见过她身手。
text.en: She's someone we all know, and I've seen her in action.

text.zh: 没想到今天居然有这么多进展，嘿嘿，还真是顺利啊。
text.en: Sounds like you made a ton of progress today! Hehe, it's good that everything's going so smoothly.

text.zh: 接下来，就是再去一趟剧院，找奥黛塔问清楚。
text.en: Next step is to head back to the theater and get a clear answer from Odette.

text.zh: 不确定性还是比较高…
text.en: It could be easier said than done...

text.zh: 就算是她，她不一定会承认。
text.en: Even if she's the one, she won't necessarily admit it.

text.zh: 但我感觉她不像是个坏人，就算做了很多激进的事，我想她应该是有自己的理由的。
text.en: Either way, Paimon doesn't get the sense that she's a bad person. Sure, she might have done some pretty extreme things, but Paimon bets she has her reasons.

text.zh: 这么说可能有点太凭感觉了，但…唔，既然能做到那些事，理论上来说，下手再重一点效果更好吧？
text.en: Maybe this is going too far, but like... With everything she's managed to do so far, wouldn't it make more sense in theory to be even more... y'know, heavy-handed?

text.zh: 比如，不只是信件，而是…呃，反正就是避免对方出尔反尔，但她并没有这么做…
text.en: Why leave a letter when she could... um... well, we know there are plenty of other ways to keep people in line, right? The point is, she could've gone further, but she didn't.

text.zh: 这就说明，她还是有自己的原则的。
text.en: So if it is her, she's got some principles, at least.

text.zh: 我也想要去相信她。
text.en: I want to believe in her, too.

text.zh: 嗯，不管怎么说，尊重事实就好了。
text.en: Yeah... Well, all you can do is follow the facts wherever they lead.

text.zh: 你今天的身体怎么样？
text.en: How are you feeling today?

text.zh: 没什么变化，只是我昨天告诉你的那种感受好像更明显了。
text.en: No change, really. But that thing Paimon told you about yesterday... Paimon feels like she can sense it more clearly now.

text.zh: 哎，每天听你讲完，我心里都痒痒的，好想跟你一起去冒险，一起经历这些事啊。
text.en: *sigh* Hearing you talk about your day makes Paimon itch for an adventure! If only she could be there with you so we could experience it all together...

text.zh: 放心，我会搞明白的。没有你我也很不习惯。
text.en: Yeah, I wish you could be there too. I'm not used to adventuring alone. But don't worry, we'll get to the bottom of this.

text.zh: 嘿嘿，没办法，我就继续乖乖休息好啦。
text.en: Hehe, guess it's just one of those things. Never mind — Paimon will behave herself and keep resting!

text.zh: （如果奥黛塔就是「莱莱可」，她手里很可能有严冬计划的详细情报…）
text.en: (If Odette is Lelek, she may well have inside information on Project Stuzha...)

text.zh: （她的父亲参加过「严冬计划」的前期行动并不幸遇难，而她现在又致力于推翻「严冬计划」…）
text.en: (Her father was involved with the project's early implementation and tragically died in the process. Now, she's dedicated herself to bringing it to an end...)

text.zh: （如果对女皇在做什么一无所知的话，这些事都是很难做到的。）
text.en: (It's hard to imagine she could have gotten this far without knowing anything at all about the Tsaritsa's true intentions.)

text.zh: （她在用愚人众的身份和我们交谈的时候，说了多少，又藏了多少呢？）
text.en: (When she spoke to us as a member of the Fatui... how much did she let on, and how much was she hiding?)

text.zh: （…等明天吧，说不定一切都会得到答案。）
text.en: (...Only time will tell. Maybe tomorrow, everything will be answered.)

text.zh: 你看，外面下雪了。明天说不定不好过呢，你要注意保暖哦。
text.en: Hey look, it's snowing... Could be a tough day ahead. Make sure you wrap up warm tomorrow!

text.zh: 不确定性还是比较高…
text.en: It could be easier said than done...

text.zh: 就算是她，她不一定会承认。
text.en: Even if she's the one, she won't necessarily admit it.
